scripts.text:
[Allen]
*Groooooan~*
Arrrgh, my back hurts...
And my stomach... Why do
I have to suffer like this
while other people get to
live happy, luxurious lives?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
*呻吟声~*
啊...我的背好痛...
还有我的胃...为什么我要遭受这样的痛苦，
而其他人却能过着幸福奢华的生活？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
My son is the only family
I've got. He used to be such
a good obedient kid, but now
I doubt whether he cares about
his father! I told that lazy kid to hurry and bring me my meds...
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我儿子是我唯一的家人。
他以前是个很听话的好孩子，
但现在我不确定他是否还关心他的父亲！
我让那个懒散的家伙赶紧把我的药拿来...

scripts.text:
[Allen]
But does he worry about
his father's suffering?! No!
I bet you he's hanging out with
his no good hoodlum friends!
Argh! The pain is getting worse! I... I need my medication!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
但他关心他父亲的痛苦吗？！不！
我敢打赌他正和那帮不三不四的朋友混在一起！
啊！疼痛越来越厉害了！我...我需要我的药！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Oh! I can definitely feel
it getting worse! Please,
adventurer, would you help
a sick man? I need you to
find my son Postell and to
tell him to bring my medicine!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
哦！我确实感觉到越来越严重了！
冒险者，请帮帮这个生病的人吧。
我需要你去找我的儿子波斯特尔，
告诉他把我的药带过来！

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text: No, I'm sorry.
scripts.translation: 不，对不起。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Th-thank you so much!
Please head east, go
outside of town, and
you should be able to
find Postell. Tell him that
I need my ''Kolbun A'' now!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
谢...谢谢你！
请往东走，出镇子，
你应该就能找到波斯特尔。
告诉他我现在需要我的“Kolbun A”！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
And let him know that
if he doesn't shape up...
Well, I just might have
to disown my own son!
He's dead to me if he
doesn't love his father!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
还有，让他知道，
如果他再不收敛...
我可能会断绝父子关系！
如果他不爱他的父亲，
他就别想活了！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I... I don't understand...!
How can you leave a sick
man alone with his suffering?
I-I desperately need help!
No! Please, d-don't go away!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我...我不明白...！
怎么能把一个生病的人独自留在这里受苦？
我...我急需帮助！
不！请，别...别走开！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Postell... My son...
Why have you forsaken me?
I'm lying here at the brink
of death, and the boy won't
even come to see his father!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
波斯特尔...我的儿子...
你为什么抛弃我？
我躺在死亡的边缘，
那个男孩甚至不肯来看看他的父亲！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
But you... I can count on you.
Even in Lighthalzen, I'd never
find anyone as dependable as
you. This time, I've decided to
discipline my degenerate son.
Will you help me once more?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
但是...你可以依靠。
即使在里希塔乐镇，
我也找不到比你更可靠的人了。
这次，我决定管教一下我那个堕落的儿子。
你愿意再帮帮我吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, wait...
Lighthalzen?
Did you used to
live there or something?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，等等...
里希塔乐镇？
你以前住在那里吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Uh? Er, well, that's just
an expression I use. You
know, like an example.
I-I--^333333*Cough!*^000000 Oh, oh no.
My ^333333*Hack!*^000000 pancreas! Or liver!
I'm having another attack!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
呃？嗯，那只是我常用的一个表达。
你知道的，就像举个例子。
我...我--^333333*咳嗽！*^000000 哦，不。
我的^333333*咳！*^000000胰腺！或者是肝脏！
我又发作了！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Oh, everything's getting
so dark! P-please, if you
have any mercy at all, any
shred of human decency,
would you please let me
have a White P-Potion?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
哦，眼前越来越黑了！
请...如果你还有一点点怜悯，
哪怕是一丝人性，
请给我一瓶白色药水好吗？

scripts.text: Give White Potion
scripts.translation: 给予白色药水

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Oh... Oh no...! You
don't have any White
Potions either?! Wh-what
what am I gonna--?! Help me,
please! Bring me a White Potion
as soon as you can! ^333333*Cough!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
哦...不...！你
也没有白色药水吗？！我...我该怎么办...？！帮帮我，
求你了！尽快给我弄一瓶白色药水来！^333333*咳嗽！*^000000

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Oh, thank you!
I-It hurts so much...
A White Potion just has
to help. I-It has to work!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
哦，谢谢你！
我...好痛...
白色药水一定能帮上忙。
它...它一定会起效的！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Ah, that... *Whew*
Thank you so much. Now,
all I need to do is wait for
my son to bring my medicine.
Wait. What if he takes too long
to get here. No, no, what if...
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
啊，那个... *呼*
非常感谢。现在，
我只需要等我的儿子把药带过来。
等等。万一他花太长时间才到怎么办。不，不，万一...

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Wh-what if I have another
ulcer attack before Postell
can bring my meds?! I might
not survive! A-adventurer, would you please stay by my side until
my son arrives? P-please?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
万...万一波斯特尔把药带过来之前
我又发作了怎么办？！我可能活不下去了！
冒...冒险者，请在我儿子到来之前
留在我身边好吗？求...求你了？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
W-wait! A-are you just
going to let me d-die?
Noo! ^333333*Cough*^000000 Arrgh! A plague!
A plague on both your houses!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
等...等等！你...你就要让我死在这里吗？
不！^333333*咳嗽*^000000 啊！该死的瘟疫！
愿瘟疫降临你们两家！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
*Gasp* I... I can
feel it! I think I'm
gonna have another
neutron attack! Argh, it's
already effecting all of the
neutrons in my nervous system!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
*喘息* 我...我感
觉到了！我觉得我
又要神经发作了！啊，它已经
影响了我神经系统里的所有神经元！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
C-can't... Lift...
Legs and fingers...
But... Must... Get...
''Withstander'' medicine...
from... Drawer... H-heeelp me!
Adventurer! H-Heeeeelp~!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我...动不了...
腿和手指...
但是...必须...去拿...
“Withstander”药...
从...抽屉里...帮...帮帮我！
冒险者！帮...帮帮我~！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
No...!
There's a light at the
the end of the tunnel!
Please, adventurer! C-come
a little closer to me! Don't
let me step into the light!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
不...！
隧道尽头有光！
求求你，冒险者！请...请靠近我一点！
别让我走进那道光里！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou have given the
Withstander medicine
to Allen who guzzles
it down very quickly.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你给了艾伦Withstander药，
他咕咚咕咚地一口气喝了下去。^000000

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Blood... circulating...
through limbs... Clarity...
of thought... returning...
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
血液...在四肢...循环...
思绪...逐渐...清晰...

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Ah, wh-what a relief. It looks
like I-I live to see another
day. Th-thank you so much...
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
啊，谢...谢天谢地。
看来我...还能再活一天。
太...太感谢你了...

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I... I can't...!
I can barely breathe!
A-adventurer, I need you
again! Please, c-come closer
to me! I-I think I need CPR!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我...不行了...！
我几乎...无法呼吸了！
冒...冒险者，我又需要你帮忙了！
请...请靠近我一点！我...我觉得我需要心肺复苏！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou give another dose
of Withstander to Allen.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你又给了艾伦一剂Withstander。^000000

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Oh... Thank you...
I feel much b-better now.
My son Postell, he should
be coming soon. Thank you
for being so patient with me...
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
哦...谢谢你...
我现在感觉好多了。
我的儿子波斯特尔应该快到了。
谢谢你这么耐心地照顾我...

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Oh... Thank you...
Y-you're an angel, a regular
Florence Nightingale. Please
stay with m-me until my son
arrives. You wouldn't abandon
this sick man now, would you?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
哦...谢谢你...
你真是位天使，简直是南丁格尔再世。
请在我儿子到来之前留在我身边。
你不会现在就把这个病人丢下吧，对吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(^333333Your son Postell
better get here soon!^000000)

[Allen]
Arrrgh! My ligaments!
They're in such pain!
Oh, oh no! I think my
bones are infected!
Help me, oh help me!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
啊！我的韧带！
好痛啊！
哦，天哪！我觉得我的骨头感染了！
帮帮我，求求你们帮帮我！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Oh...
My son...!
P-Postell!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
哦...
我的儿子...！
波...波斯特尔！

scripts.text:
[Postell]
Uh... Hey, dad.
I brought that
medicine you're
supposed to
need so badly.
scripts.translation:
[波斯特尔]
呃...嘿，爸爸。
我带了那种你急需的
药来了。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Thank goodness...
G-give it to me!
^333333*Gulp gulp gulp*^000000

[Allen]
W-wait...
Something's not
right. Bunkoll A
doesn't taste like this...
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
等...等等...
感觉不对劲。Bunkoll A
的味道不是这样的...

scripts.text:
[Postell]
Bunkoll A...?
I thougt you said that
you wanted Kolbun A?
scripts.translation:
[波斯特尔]
Bunkoll A...？
我记得你说你要的是Kolbun A啊？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
My own son, lying to
me! Are you trying to
trick me, Postell?!
I told you get Bunkoll A!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我亲生的儿子，竟然骗我！
波斯特尔，你想骗我？！
我明明让你去拿Bunkoll A！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(^333333Wait, wait...
Allen did say that
he wanted Kolbun A...^000000)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(^333333等等，等等...
艾伦明明说他要的是Kolbun A...^000000)

scripts.text:
[Postell]
Right. Okay, I guess
I made a mistake? Um,
Dad, I'll be right back with
the medicine that you want.
It won't take long, so don't
stress yourself about it.
scripts.translation:
[波斯特尔]
好吧。好吧，看来是我搞错了？
呃，爸爸，我马上就去拿你想要的药。
不会花太久的，你别太担心。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
*Sniff* I should have known
that Postell really does care
about me deep down inside.
I wish I had never gotten
myself sick in Lighthalzen...
Then we both wouldn't suffer...
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
*吸鼻子* 我就知道，波斯特尔内心深处
其实很在乎我。
我真希望自己在里希塔乐镇没有生病...
那样我们俩就不会受苦了...

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Don't worry, adventurer.
I haven't forgotten about
you. Please take a look inside
the medicine drawer, and help
yourself to whatever you like~
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
别担心，冒险者。
我可没忘记你。
请看看药柜里面，
随便拿点你喜欢的吧~

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Don't worry, adventurer.
I haven't forgotten about
you. Please take a look inside
the medicine drawer, and help
yourself to whatever you like~
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
别担心，冒险者。
我可没忘记你。
请看看药柜里面，
随便拿点你喜欢的吧~

scripts.text:
[Allen]
So did you find the
Old Blue Box I put in
my medicine drawer? It's
not much, but I hope you
like it. Consider my way
of thanking you for your help~
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
你找到我放在药柜里的神秘箱子了吗？
虽然不是什么贵重物品，但希望你能喜欢。
就当是我感谢你的帮助吧~

scripts.text:
[Allen]
*Groooooan~*
Arrrgh, my back hurts...
And my stomach... Why do
I have to suffer like this
while other people get to
live happy, luxurious lives?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
*呻吟声~*
啊...我的背好痛...
还有我的胃...为什么我要遭受这样的痛苦，
而其他人却能过着幸福奢华的生活？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
*Groooooan~*
Arrrgh, my back hurts...
And my stomach... Why do
I have to suffer like this
while other people get to
live happy, luxurious lives?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
*呻吟声~*
啊...我的背好痛...
还有我的胃...为什么我要遭受这样的痛苦，
而其他人却能过着幸福奢华的生活？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
^333333*Cough cough!*^000000
W-Withstander...!
I need m-my Withstander!
P-please! ^333333*Cough cough!*^000000

[Allen]
^333333*Whew*^000000
I... I can breathe again!
B-but what if I have another
attack?! Please, g-get me
another dose of Withstander,
just to be on the safe side!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
^333333*呼*^000000
我...我又能呼吸了！
但如果我再犯病怎么办？
求求你，再给我拿一份维斯坦德吧，
以防万一！

scripts.text:
[Postell]
Hey, uh...
I'm in the middle
of something here.
scripts.translation:
[波斯特尔]
嘿，那个...
我现在正忙着呢。

scripts.text:
[Postell]
I really like living
in Hugel. Fresh air,
clean water, everyone's
friendly and nice. What
more could I want?
scripts.translation:
[波斯特尔]
我真的很喜欢住在毁葛。
空气新鲜，水质干净，
大家都友好又亲切。
我还能想要什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Postell]
Oh, what's that?
My dad wants me to
bring him some medicine?
Again? Well, he was really
sick a long time ago, but
nowadays, I'm not so sure.
scripts.translation:
[波斯特尔]
哦，那是怎么了？
我爸爸又要我给他带药？
又是这样？虽然很久以前他确实病得很重，
但现在嘛，我不太确定了。

scripts.text:
[Postell]
I mean, I'm pretty sure
his illnesses are all, you
know, psychosomatic.
Besides, I'm worried that
all the medicines he's taking
are habit forming, you know?
scripts.translation:
[波斯特尔]
我是说，我相当确定他的病都是，
你知道的，心因性的。
而且，我很担心他吃的那些药
会产生依赖性，你懂吧？

scripts.text: But your father needs you!
scripts.translation: 但你爸爸需要你！

scripts.text: Habit forming?
scripts.translation: 依赖性？

scripts.text:
[Allen's Voice]
Yeah, I guess you're right.
Even if I think he's nuts,
and I don't agree with him,
I should at least show that
I care about my dad. What
medicine did he say he needed?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦的声音]
是啊，我想你说得对。
即使我觉得他有点疯，
而且我不认同他的做法，
我也应该至少表现出
我对爸爸的关心。他刚才说
他需要什么药来着？

scripts.text:
[Postell]
''Kolbun A?'' Alright,
I better make sure that
it's safe for him to take.
Who knows, that stuff might
make him worse. Anyway,
I'll try to get it to him soon.
scripts.translation:
[波斯特尔]
''Kolbun A？'' 好的，
我得确认一下他吃这个是否安全。
谁知道呢，那东西可能会
让他病情加重。总之，
我会尽快给他送过去。

scripts.text:
[Postell]
Hey, would you do
me a favor and make
sure that my dad doesn't
get himself into any
more trouble? I'd really
appreciate it if you do.
scripts.translation:
[波斯特尔]
嘿，你能帮我个忙，
确保我爸爸不再惹麻烦吗？
如果你能做到的话，
我会非常感激的。

scripts.text:
[Postell]
Yeah, like he's addicted
to the medicine. That's why
I'm trying to make sure he
gets as little of it as possible! Honestly, I think he drinks
too much medicine already...
scripts.translation:
[波斯特尔]
是啊，就像他对药物上瘾一样。
所以我才想尽量让他少吃点！
说实话，我觉得他吃的药已经够多了...

scripts.text:
[Postell]
Kolbun A, Kolbun A...
Let's see, is it really
safe for my dad to take?
If it isn't, I better come up
with some replacement...
scripts.translation:
[波斯特尔]
Kolbun A，Kolbun A...
让我看看，这对爸爸来说
真的安全吗？
如果不安全，我最好想个替代品...

scripts.text:
[Postell]
I really like living
in Hugel. Fresh air,
clean water, everyone's
friendly and nice. What
more could I want?
scripts.translation:
[波斯特尔]
我真的很喜欢住在毁葛。
空气新鲜，水质干净，
大家都友好又亲切。
我还能想要什么呢？

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are several
books and a few
liquid medicines
inside this drawer.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF抽屉里有几本书
和一些液体药物。^000000

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Oh... Oh...
Oooh... The pain
is gone! It's a miracle!
Maybe I'll just take the
Withstander later...
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
哦...哦...
噢...疼痛消失了！
真是奇迹！
也许我稍后再吃维斯坦德吧...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find an old book
inside the drawer.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你在抽屉里发现了一本陈旧的书。^000000

scripts.text:
[Welcome to Lighthalzen!]
Author: Tupetso Iltekka
scripts.translation:
[欢迎来到里希塔乐镇！]
作者：图佩特索·伊尔特卡

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(^333333I guess Allen used
to live in Lighthalzen.
I guess that's why he'd
keep this old PR brochure...^000000)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(^333333看来艾伦以前住在里希塔乐镇。
难怪他会留着这本旧的宣传册...^000000)

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find Allen's
journal inside the
drawer and quickly
leaf through its pages.
It's difficult to read since
the pages are old and worn.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你在抽屉里发现了艾伦的日记，
并快速翻阅了它的页面。
由于书页陈旧磨损，
阅读起来有些困难。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's see, let's see...
Rekenber Corporation...
Something about the Slums....
Enormous funds... Experiments.
Lab... Escape... Hugel... Um...
Dr. Morriphen... Side effects?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
让我想想...
雷肯贝尔公司...
关于贫民窟的事...
巨额资金... 实验。
实验室... 逃跑... 毁葛... 嗯...
莫里芬博士... 副作用？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wh-what...?
Do you really
need that medicine?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什...什么...？
你真的需要
那种药吗？！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Oh... Oh...
Oooh... The pain
is gone! It's a miracle!
Maybe I'll just take the
Withstander later...
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
哦...哦...
噢...疼痛消失了！
真是奇迹！
也许我稍后再吃维斯坦德吧...

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
Wh-who are you, and what are
you looking for? If you're here
for the stuff, then you came
too early. As you can see,
I don't feel well enough to
speak to you right now.
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
你...你是谁，
你在找什么？如果你是
为了那些东西来的，
那你来得太早了。你看，
我现在身体很不舒服，
没法和你对话。

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
^333333*Cough Cough*
*Cough Cough*^000000

[{0}]
Holy--! Are you alright?
Y-you're coughing up blood!
Relax, I was just passing by!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪--！你没事吧？
你...你在咳血！
别担心，我只是路过！

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
R-really? Well then, I'm
sorry to have bothered you,
then. I guess I'm just a little
jumpy is all. ^333333*Cough, cough~*^000000
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
真...真的吗？那真是
抱歉打扰到你了。
我想我只是有点
神经质而已。^333333*咳咳~*^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey... You don't sound
too good. Do you want me
to bring you to a hospital?
That's a really nasty cough
you've got there, so maybe
you should get it checked.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿...你听起来
状态不太好。需要我
带你去医院吗？
你的咳嗽看起来很严重，
也许应该去检查一下。

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
No, thanks, I'm fine.
I just haven't gone home
for a few months and wasn't
able to get my prescription
refilled, that's all. ^333333*Haaak*
*Cough-cough-cooooooough!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
不用了，谢谢，我没事。
我只是几个月没回家，
没能去续我的处方药，
仅此而已。^333333*哈啊*
*咳咳咳...咳咳咳！*^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm...
What should I do?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...
我该怎么办？

scripts.text: Leave him
scripts.translation: 离开他

scripts.text: Help him
scripts.translation: 帮助他

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know, I'm a little
worried about your coughing,
but I don't think there's any
way that I can help you...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道吗，我有点
担心你的咳嗽，
但我觉得我帮不上什么忙...

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
^333333*Cough cough*^000000
Don't worry, I'll be
just fine. You take care
of yourself, you hear?
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
^333333*咳咳*^000000
别担心，我会
没事的。你要照顾好
自己，听到了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey...
Are you sure that
you'll be alright?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿...
你确定你
会没事吗？

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
^333333*Cough cough*^000000
Don't worry, I'll be
just fine. You take care
of yourself, you hear?
^333333*Haaaak* *Reeetch*^000000
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
^333333*咳咳*^000000
别担心，我会
没事的。你要照顾好
自己，听到了吗？
^333333*哈啊* *干呕*^000000

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
^333333*Reeeeetch*
*Cooooough Cough*
*Hhhh, Hhhhh, Hhhh*
*Haaaaack* *Retch*^000000

[{0}]
Please, mister.
Let me help you.
I can't just leave
you alone if you
sound like that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
拜托了，先生。
让我帮帮你吧。
听到你这样咳嗽，
我不能就这样丢下你不管。

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
...............................
I didn't, I didn't want to
bother you, b-but if you insist
oh h-helping me, then maybe
I'll ask you to do me a favor.
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
...............................
我、我不想打扰你，
但如果你坚持要帮我的话，
那...能不能请你帮我个忙？

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
Would you visit my home in
Hugel and ask my wife, Siria,
for my medication? She knows
where to find it, and will give
it to you. Oh, and please don't
tell her anything else, okay?
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
请去我在毁葛的家，
找我的妻子西丽亚，
把我的药取回来。她知道药在哪里，
会交给你的。啊，还有，
请不要告诉她其他事情，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
She's always worried about
me getting worse, and I don't
want to give her any reason to
get stressed. Please just tell
her that I ran out of medicine.
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
她总是担心我的病情会恶化，
我不想给她增加任何压力。
请只告诉她我的药吃完了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright.
I'll come back here
as soon as I can.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的。
我会尽快赶回来的。

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
Thanks so much.
^333333*Cough Cough*
*Cough Cough*^000000

[Morriphen]
Ugh... I don't feel
very well. I guess
I better call it a day...
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
唉...我感觉很不舒服。
我想还是先休息一下吧...

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
Please ask my ^333333*Cough*^000000
wife Siria in my home in
^333333*Reeetch*^000000 Hugel for m-my
medicine. Th-thank you...
^333333*Haaaaack* *Hhh, haaaack*^000000

[{0}]
Oh no... Morriphen
doesn't look good at all!
I better hurry and bring
him medicine from Siria
in Hugel as soon as I can!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
糟糕...莫里芬看起来情况很不好！
我得赶紧去毁葛找西丽亚，
尽快把药带回来！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh no... Morriphen
doesn't look good at all!
I better hurry and bring
him medicine from Dono
in Hugel as soon as I can!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
糟糕...莫里芬看起来情况很不好！
我得赶紧去毁葛找多诺，
尽快把药带回来！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh no... Morriphen
doesn't look good at all!
I better hurry and bring
him medicine from Dono
in Hugel as soon as I can!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
糟糕...莫里芬看起来情况很不好！
我得赶紧去毁葛找多诺，
尽快把药带回来！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh no... Morriphen
doesn't look good at all!
I better hurry and bring
him medicine from Dono
in Hugel as soon as I can!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
糟糕...莫里芬看起来情况很不好！
我得赶紧去毁葛找多诺，
尽快把药带回来！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou administer the
medicine to Morriphen,
who slowly regains
consciousness.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你给莫里芬喂了药，
他慢慢恢复了意识。^000000

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
^333333*Cough, cough*^000000
Wh-where am I?
I'm... not dead yet?
Oh, you! It seems I was
right to trust you. So did my
wife give you my medicine?
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
^333333*咳咳*^000000
我...我在哪里？
我...还没死吗？
啊，是你啊！看来我信任你是对的。
那么，我妻子把药给你了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, Siria also ran
out of your medicine when
I arrived at your house, so
she told me to go get some
from your friend, Dono.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其实，当我到达你家时，
西丽亚那里的药也吃完了，
所以她让我去找你的朋友多诺拿药。

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
Oh, no, what have you done?
My wife's life depends on that
medicine too! Oh no, if she
doesn't get any, she'll die
from my stupidity! Please!
I beg you, bring this to her!
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
哦不，你做了什么？
我妻子的命也靠那些药维持着！
天哪，如果她吃不到药，她会死掉的！
都怪我太愚蠢了！求求你！
拜托了，把这些药带给她！

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
That woman is everything
to me. If she's gone, then
I don't know what I'll do.
Please take this medicine
to her as soon as you can!
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
那个女人对我来说就是一切。
如果她不在，我不知道我会怎样。
请尽快把这些药带给她！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't worry, I'm on my
way. I'll hurry as fast as
I can back to Hugel to
give Siria this medicine.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
别担心，我这就去。
我会尽快赶回毁葛，
把药交给西丽亚。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What am I doing...?
I need to return to
Hugel and deliver this
medicine to Siria as
soon as possible!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我在做什么...？
我得赶紧回毁葛，
尽快把药交给西丽亚！

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
You're back! So, have you
seen my wife? She's okay,
isn't she? Why aren't you
saying--oh no. Oh dear God,
no. D-don't tell me she's dead!
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
你回来了！那么，你见到我妻子了吗？
她没事吧？
为什么你不说话——哦不。天哪，不。
别告诉我她死了！

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
She has to be fine...!
If anything happened
to her, I... I won't forgive
you! No one would find your
body! No, wait, wait... No, I'm
sorry, I'm just so anxious...!
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
她一定没事...！
如果她出了什么事，我...我绝不会原谅你！
没人会找到你的尸体！
不，等等，等等...不，对不起，我只是太焦虑了...！

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
^333333*Sob*^000000 Please forgive me!
Please tell me my wife is
okay. I'm sorry, everything
is just so overwhelming right
now. ^333333*Sob*^000000 Please, please...
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
^333333*抽泣*^000000请原谅我！
请告诉我我妻子没事。
对不起，现在一切都太让人难以承受了。
^333333*抽泣*^000000求求你，求求你...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Siria is fine.
Now are you satisfied?
If you're that worried about
her, you ought to see her
more often. Geez...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
西丽亚没事。
这下你满意了吗？
如果你这么担心她，
就应该多去看看她。真是的...

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
Hallelujah! I'm so
relieved! She's alive!
I'm sorry, I'd be home
more often, but I'm always
struggling here to make ends
meet. Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
哈利路亚！我松了一口气！
她还活着！
对不起，我本该多回家的，
但我一直在这里为生计奔波。
非常感谢你！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't sweat it.
It was just the right
thing to do, that's all.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
别放在心上。
我只是做了该做的事而已。

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
You're such a kind person...
You save my life and my wife's
life. I'll do anything you ask me to do to repay you! Consider me
your humble servant from now on. What is your command, oh master?
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
你真是个善良的人...
你救了我的命，也救了我妻子的命。
为了报答你，无论让我做什么我都愿意！
从现在起，请把我当作你卑微的仆人吧。
主人，请下达您的命令。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's...
That's going too far.
Becoming my servant for
life isn't necessary, you know.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这...
这就太过分了。
没必要让我一辈子都当你的主人啊。

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
Wait, I know! If you won't
accept my life, then I can
give you someone else's. Do
you have any enemies! I'll go
out and kill someone for you!
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
等等，我知道了！
如果你不接受我的命，
那我可以用别人的命来抵。
你有仇人吗！
我去外面杀个人给你！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...That's fine.
Actually, I'm more interested
in hearing how you, Siria, and
Dono are all connected. When
I spoke to Siria, she told me
that you two weren't married...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...算了。
其实，我更想听听你、西丽亚和多诺
之间到底有什么联系。
我和西丽亚说话时，她告诉我
你们两个并不是夫妻...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Siria did mention
that she's greatly
indebted to you for
some reason, and she'll
never be able to fully repay
you, not even with her life.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
西丽亚提到，
她因为某种原因
对你感激涕零，
甚至用她的命都还不清
这份恩情。

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
She said that? ^333333*Sigh*^000000
Poor girl, I've asked so
many times not to think
that way. Alright, if that's
what you really want, then
I will tell you our story.
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
她这么说吗？^333333*叹气*^000000
可怜的孩子，我已经求过她很多次
不要这么想了。好吧，
如果你真的想知道，
那我就讲讲我们的故事吧。

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
Dono and I have been friends
since childhood. We did almost
everything together. Even when
we started our professional
careers, we both decided to work for the Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
多诺和我从小就是朋友。
我们几乎形影不离。
即使开始职业生涯，
我们也决定一起为雷根修芦公司工作。

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
Dono eventually became in
charge of Rekenber's Medical
Experimental Research, while
I spearheaded projects for
Rekenber's weapon research.
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
多诺后来负责雷根修芦的
医学实验研究，
而我则主导雷根修芦的武器研究项目。

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
Although our areas of expertise
are different, Dono and I found
that our collaborations were
productive for both of us. But
then, one day, I dropped by
Dono's office and saw her.
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
虽然我们的专业领域不同，
但多诺和我发现
我们的合作对双方都有益。
但有一天，我去多诺的办公室，
看到了她。

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
She was floating in a giant
test tube, and I couldn't take
my eyes off her: she was the
most beautiful thing I'd ever
seen. But Dono said she was
nothing but an experiment...
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
她漂浮在一个巨大的试管里，
我完全移不开目光：
她是我见过的最美丽的东西。
但多诺说她只是一个实验品...

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
He told me not to be so
curious, but I didn't listen.
Ever since then, I went to his office as often as I could, making
stupid excuses to see her. I just couldn't help it. I was in love.
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
他让我别那么多管闲事，
但我没有听。
从那以后，我尽可能频繁地去他的办公室，
找些愚蠢的借口只为见她一面。
我控制不住自己。我爱上了她。

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
Then, I heard news that Dono's
research wasn't producing the
expected results, and that he
would be shutting everything
down. All experiments would
be efficiently disposed.
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
然后，我听说多诺的研究
没有达到预期结果，
他打算关闭一切。
所有实验品都将被高效处理掉。

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
There was a snowstorm
that night, but I braved the
freezing cold to sneak into the
Rekenber Laboratory. I broke her out of her test tube, set the lab
on fire, and got the hell out.
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
那天晚上下着暴风雪，
但我冒着严寒潜入雷根修芦附设研究所。
我把她从试管里救出来，
放火烧了实验室，然后逃之夭夭。

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
I couldn't know it at the
time, but I was exposed to
some chemicals during the fire.
They damaged my tissues badly,
so that's why I'm so dependent
on these medicines now.
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
当时我还不知道，
但在火灾中我接触到了某些化学物质。
它们严重损伤了我的组织，
这就是为什么我现在如此依赖这些药物。

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
Anyway, we ran from the lab,
escaping to the mountains.
I just carried her on my back,
as far as I could go. Finally,
I couldn't fight the dizziness,
and I suddenly blacked out.
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
总之，我们从实验室逃了出来，
逃到了山里。
我背着她，能走多远就走多远。
最后，我实在无法忍受眩晕，
突然昏了过去。

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
I remember seeing a tall, robed
man right before I fainted. He
said something about bringing
us to Hugel, a resting place
for the lost, those born from Odin's shadow. It was strange...
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
我记得在昏迷前看到了一个高大的、
穿着长袍的男人。他说要把我们带到毁葛，
那是迷失者的安息之地，
奥丁阴影中诞生之人的归宿。真奇怪...

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
I couldn't see his face.
His hood was covering it,
but I think his name was, um...
Mawon... Mawong? Anyway, when
we woke up, we were lying in
warm beds inside Hugel Village.
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
我看不到他的脸。
他的兜帽遮住了脸，
但我想他的名字是，嗯...
莫翁...莫翁？总之，
当我们醒来时，我们正躺在
毁葛村庄温暖的床上。

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
The people we met were very
accomdating, welcome, and
friendly. They also didn't
ask us any questions: we were
just accepted. The girl I saved didn't know how to speak then...
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
我们遇到的人非常热情、
欢迎且友好。他们也没有
问我们任何问题：
我们被接纳了。我救下的女孩
当时还不会说话...

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
As soon as I got better,
I taught her our language,
and even gave her a name,
Siria. She was no longer an
experiment, but my beloved. Still, we didn't live happily ever after.
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
等我身体好转后，
我教了她我们的语言，
甚至给她取了一个名字，
西丽亚。她不再是一个
实验品，而是我的挚爱。
然而，我们并没有从此幸福地生活在一起。

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
I had to make living for the
two of us to survive, so I found work in Einbroch and Lighthalzen.
Eventually, I bumped into Dono
inside a shabby herb shop in Lighthalzen. I felt so ashamed...
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
为了养活我们两个人，
我找到了工作，在艾音布罗克
和里希塔乐镇谋生。
最终，我在里希塔乐镇
一家破旧的草药店里
遇到了多诺。我感到非常羞愧...

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
I burned up his lab, which
must've hurt his reputation
in the company. Still, when
I told him what happened, he
seemed to understand. He
even started to help me...
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
我烧毁了他的实验室，
这肯定损害了他在公司里的
声誉。然而，当我告诉他
发生了什么时，他似乎
理解了我。他甚至开始
帮助我...

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
You know, Siria was supposed
to become a mass murder weapon.
The reason why Dono's experiment failed was became she resisted
their plans. She's more than just an experiment or weapon, you know.
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
你知道吗，西丽亚原本
应该成为大规模屠杀的武器。
多诺的实验之所以失败，
是因为她抵抗了他们的计划。
她不仅仅是一个实验品或武器，
你知道吗。

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
If everything had turned out
as Dono planned, Siria would
become a soldier, and I would
be supplying her armaments,
cutting edge weapons at the pinnacle of military development.
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
如果一切如多诺所计划的那样，
西丽亚将成为一名士兵，
而我则负责为她提供武器，
制造处于军事发展巅峰的
尖端武器。

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
While I was working for Rekenber, I was working on mass producing
imitations of the legendary sword, ''Executioner.'' They wouldn't be
perfect copies, but imagine what would've happened if I succeeded.
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
在我为雷根修芦工作时，
我正在尝试大规模生产
传奇之剑“行刑者”的仿制品。
它们不会是完美的复制品，
但想象一下，如果我成功了，
会发生什么。

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
When I think about it, we all
could have been rich. I was in
charge of weapon manufacturing
after all, and our biggest
customer, Arunafeltz, would
have given us good business.
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
想想看，我们本可以
变得非常富有。毕竟，
我负责武器制造，
而我们最大的客户阿鲁纳菲兹
会给我们带来丰厚的生意。

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
I made my choice, and I have
no regrets. In fact, I wouldn't
change my life or give away
Siria for the world. However,
Dono would probably think
differently: work was his life.
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
我做出了我的选择，
我不后悔。事实上，
我不会改变我的生活，
也不会为了整个世界而
放弃西丽亚。然而，
多诺可能会认为不同：
工作就是他的生命。

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
I get the feeling that Dono
would never tell Rekenber about
me and Siria. I can never repay
him for the helping us now, but
I'm sure that he must hate me
deep down inside.
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
我感觉多诺永远不会
向雷根修芦透露我和西丽亚
的事。我永远无法报答
他现在的帮助，
但我确信他内心深处
一定恨我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't think like that.
I'm sure Dono still thinks
of you as his friend. He's
bitter about what happened,
but he won't abandon you.
Why don't you go see him?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
别那样想。
我相信多诺仍然
把你当作他的朋友。
他对发生的事感到痛苦，
但他不会抛弃你。
你为什么不
去看看他呢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Besides, you have an
excuse to go see him now,
your medicine, right? I'm
sure you can repay him by
visiting him, and living
happily with your Seria.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
而且，你现在有
一个去看他的借口，
你的药，对吧？
我相信你可以通过
探望他来报答他，
并且和你的西丽亚
幸福地生活。

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
^333333*Sob*^000000 You're right...
I'm so sorry Dono! ^333333*Sniff*^000000
Thank you so much. If you
ever visit Hugel again, come
by and see me. You've really
helped me and Seria so much.
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
^333333*抽泣*^000000 你说得对...
对不起，多诺！ ^333333*抽泣*^000000
非常感谢你。如果你
再次访问毁葛，
请来看看我。你真的
帮助了我和西丽亚很多。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't worry about it.
Just get better so that
I won't have to worry
about you. Take care~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
别担心。
只要你好起来，
我就不必为你担心了。
保重~

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
Oh, long time no see~
Yes, my wife and I can't
possibly be any happier.
We've been taking it easy,
and managed to make full
recoveries. Amazing, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
哦，好久不见~
是的，我和妻子
不可能再幸福了。
我们一直过着轻松的生活，
并完全康复了。
真不可思议，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
Oh, and we finally got
married in a small ceremony
here in Hugel. Why don't you
come visit our house sometime?
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
哦，我们终于在
毁葛举行了一个小型婚礼。
你何不找个时间来
看看我们的家呢？

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
Oh, long time no see~
Yes, my wife and I can't
possibly be any happier.
We've been taking it easy,
and managed to make full
recoveries. Amazing, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
哦，好久不见~
是的，我和妻子
不可能再幸福了。
我们一直过着轻松的生活，
并完全康复了。
真不可思议，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Morriphen]
Oh, and we finally got
married in a small ceremony
here in Hugel. Why don't you
come visit our house sometime?
scripts.translation:
[莫里芬]
哦，我们终于在
毁葛举行了一个小型婚礼。
你何不找个时间来
看看我们的家呢？

scripts.text:
[Siria]
Oh, hello there.
Can I help you
with anything?
It looks like you want
to ask me something...
scripts.translation:
[西丽亚]
哦，你好。
我能帮你
什么吗？
看起来你想
问我点什么...

scripts.text:
^3355FFHow can a woman this
young be Morriphen's wife?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF一个这么年轻的女人
怎么能成为莫里芬的妻子？^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, um, Morriphen sent
me here so that I can bring
him his medicine. I was wo--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，嗯，莫里芬
派我来这里，
以便我能给他
带药。我正在想--

scripts.text:
[Siria]
Oh my God! Is he alright?
Please, oh dear Lord, don't
let him be dead! No! D-did
anything bad happen to him?
scripts.translation:
[西丽亚]
天哪！他没事吧？
求求你，亲爱的上帝，
别让他死了！不！
他是不是
发生了什么事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(She is being panicky, and doesn't seem to know what she should do.
She absent-mindedly steps forward and then stumbles on the floor.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（她显得十分慌张，似乎不知道该做什么。
她心不在焉地向前迈了一步，结果被地板绊了一下。）

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you okay?!
(Her eyes look blank. She seems to have a hard time to see things.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你没事吧？！
（她的眼神空洞。她似乎很难看清东西。）

scripts.text:
[Siria]
Oh, I am fine, thank you.
I am just...I am just having a vision problem.
So...what happened to him?
scripts.translation:
[西丽亚]
哦，我没事，谢谢。
我只是...只是有点视力问题。
那么...他怎么了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He's just not feeling
well, that's all. All he
told me was that he ran
out of his medicine, and
needs some more.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他只是感觉有点不舒服而已。
他告诉我，他的药吃完了，
需要再买一些。

scripts.text:
[Siria]
Aww, I just ran out of
the medicine too. Find
Morriphen's friend, and get
it from him. He's supposed to
be in Lighthalzen, somewhere...
scripts.translation:
[西丽亚]
哎呀，我的药也刚好用完了。
去找找莫里芬的朋友，
从他那里拿药吧。他应该在里希塔乐镇的某个地方...

scripts.text:
[Siria]
^333333*Cough cough!*^000000
Ugh, excuse me.
Let me sit down for
a moment. *Cough!*

^3355FFSiria's face grows
pale, and she starts
to sweat profusely.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF西丽亚的脸色变得苍白，
开始大量出汗。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um...
Are you feeling
alright? You're not
sick too, are you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那个...
你还好吗？
你不会也生病了吧？

scripts.text:
[Siria]
Oh, no, no... I'm just
so worried about Morriphen.
*Sob* I can't live without him,
he's everything in the world
to me. I owe him everything,
I have to go see Dono, I hav--
scripts.translation:
[西丽亚]
哦，不，不...我只是太担心莫里芬了。
*抽泣* 没有他我活不下去，
他是我世界里的一切。
我欠他那么多，
我必须去看看多诺，我必--

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know what? You better
relax and rest here, and I'll
go visit this Dono person in
Lighthalzen. You don't sound
well enough to be traveling.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道吗？你最好在这里放松休息一下，
我去里希塔乐镇拜访这位多诺先生。
你听起来身体状况不太好，不适合赶路。

scripts.text:
[Siria]
I'm... I'm sorry to
trouble you. But if
Morriphen can trust you
to come here, then I'll
trust you too. ^333333*Cough*^000000
Thank you so much...
scripts.translation:
[西丽亚]
我...很抱歉给你添麻烦了。但既然莫里芬
能信任你来到这里，那么我也信任你。^333333*咳*^000000
非常感谢你...

scripts.text:
[Siria]
^333333*Sniff*^000000 Please
go to Lighthalzen and
get ^333333*Cough*^000000 Morriphen's
medicine from his friend,
Dono, as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[西丽亚]
^333333*吸鼻子*^000000 请去里希塔乐镇，
尽快从他的朋友多诺那里
^333333*咳*^000000 拿到莫里芬的药。

scripts.text:
[Siria]
Oh, have you met Dono?
I'm so grateful for all of
his help. He really is a
good friend to Morriphen,
no matter what he says.
scripts.translation:
[西丽亚]
哦，你见过多诺吗？
我很感激他所有的帮助。
无论他说什么，
他确实是莫里芬的好朋友。

scripts.text:
[Siria]
Oh, have you met Dono?
I'm so grateful for all of
his help. He really is a
good friend to Morriphen,
no matter what he says.
scripts.translation:
[西丽亚]
哦，你见过多诺吗？
我很感激他所有的帮助。
无论他说什么，
他确实是莫里芬的好朋友。

scripts.text:
[Siria]
Oh, have you met Dono?
I'm so grateful for all of
his help. He really is a
good friend to Morriphen,
no matter what he says.
scripts.translation:
[西丽亚]
哦，你见过多诺吗？
我很感激他所有的帮助。
无论他说什么，
他确实是莫里芬的好朋友。

scripts.text:
[Siria]
*Cough* I-I'm fine,
so please don't worry
about me. Just bring the
medicine to Morriphen as
fast as you can for me.
scripts.translation:
[西丽亚]
*咳* 我没事，
所以请不要担心我。请帮我
尽快把药带给莫里芬。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou gently administered
the medicine to Siria, who
slow regained consciousness.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你温柔地给西丽亚喂了药，
她慢慢恢复了意识。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, are you alright?
How are you feeling?
Morriphen asked me to
come here and give you
this medicine right away.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，你还好吗？
感觉怎么样？
莫里芬让我马上
来这里给你送药。

scripts.text:
[Siria]
...Ah... I can't...
I don't know... I...
Where is...? Oh, it's
you. I think... I think
you just saved my life.
I'm sorry for being a burden...
scripts.translation:
[西丽亚]
...啊...我...我...我不知道...我...
我在哪里？哦，是你。
我想...我想你刚才救了我的命。
抱歉给你添麻烦了...

scripts.text:
[Siria]
All I've been is a nuisance
to both Morriphen and Dono.
You don't understand how I've
destroyed their lives. I just--
I just... I just need to relax.
Thank you for everything...
scripts.translation:
[西丽亚]
我一直都是莫里芬和多诺的累赘。
你不明白我毁掉了他们的生活。
我只是--
我只是...我需要放松一下。
谢谢你做的一切...

scripts.text:
[Siria]
Oh, please go back
to Morriphen and let
him know that I'm much
better. I don't want him
to worry about me!
scripts.translation:
[西丽亚]
哦，请回到莫里芬那里，
告诉他我好多了。
我不想让他担心我！

scripts.text:
[Siria]
Oh, welcome~
Thank you so much
for helping me and
Morriphen. You've been
a real godsend, you know?
scripts.translation:
[西丽亚]
哦，欢迎回来~
非常感谢你帮助我和莫里芬。
你真是帮了大忙呢。

scripts.text:
[Siria]
Oh, hello there.
Can I help you
with anything?
scripts.translation:
[西丽亚]
哦，你好。
有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text:
[Dono]
What do you want?
Spit it out, I don't
have all day.
scripts.translation:
[多诺]
你要干什么？
有话快说，我没那么多时间。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, but
I'm looking for a
man named Dono.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下，
我在找一个叫多诺的人。

scripts.text:
[Dono]
Yeah, that's me,
but who the heck
are you, anyway?
scripts.translation:
[多诺]
对，就是我，
但你是谁啊？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I'm just here
to get some medicine
for Morriphen. Um, his
wife Siria said that
you would have it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，我只是来给莫里芬拿药的。
嗯，他妻子西丽亚说
你这里有药？

scripts.text:
[Dono]
Wife? Hurmph! Not likely.
Alright, I see. He must've
run out of medicine. Jesus,
they're both still alive? It's
a miracle that they've both
lasted this long. Eh, oh well.
scripts.translation:
[多诺]
妻子？哼！不可能。
好吧，我明白了。他肯定是把药用完了。
天哪，他们居然都还活着？
能撑到现在真是个奇迹。唉，算了。

scripts.text:
[Dono]
It's his own fault his body
got messed up. Now let's
see how much medicine we
got here... Hmm... Dang. This
isn't good. Hey, you said you
work for Morriphen, that right?
scripts.translation:
[多诺]
他身体搞成这样也是他自己的错。
现在看看这里还有多少药...
嗯...该死。
情况不妙。喂，你说你是给莫里芬工作的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Dono]
I have the medicine, but it's
not enough for one person, much
less the two of them. I need you to help me make some more.
Now, listen carefully, these
are the ingredients I need...
scripts.translation:
[多诺]
我有药，但不够一个人用的，
更别提他们两个了。我需要你帮我再做一些。
现在，仔细听好，
这是我需要的材料...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, wait, I thought I was
only getting medicine for
Morriphen. Are you saying
that his wife Siria needs
the medicine too?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，等等，我以为我只是来给莫里芬拿药的。
你是说他的妻子西丽亚也需要药吗？

scripts.text:
[Dono]
Why do you keep calling
Siria his wife? Yeah, she's
sick too. If you met her, you'd
see for yourself, right? Well,
I'm getting pretty worried about them, so you better hurry this up.
scripts.translation:
[多诺]
你为什么一直叫西丽亚是他妻子？
对，她也病了。如果你见过她，
你自己也会看出来的，对吧？
好吧，我有点担心他们，所以你最好快点。

scripts.text:
[Dono]
Go get
^3355FF5 Coal^000000,
^3355FF5 Brigan^000000,
^3355FF5 Cyfar^000000,
^3355FF1 Unripe Apple^000000,
^3355FF3 Detrimindexta^000000...

[Dono]
...^3355FF20 Shells^000000,
^3355FF1 Red Herb^000000,
^3355FF1 Blue Herb^000000,
^3355FF1 Green Herb^000000,
^3355FF1 White Herb^000000, and
^3355FF1 Yellow Herb^000000.

[Dono]
I know this is sudden,
I know I'm pushing you
hard, but I've got no choice.
If you don't hurry, then
those two will die, simple as that. I'll wait for you here.
scripts.translation:
[多诺]
我知道这很突然，
我知道我在逼你，但我别无选择。
如果你不快点，
那两个人就会死，就这么简单。我在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Dono]
Store's closed.
Get outta here, and
come back later to
buy something, got it?
scripts.translation:
[多诺]
商店关门了。
滚出去，
过会儿再来买东西，懂吗？

scripts.text:
[Dono]
Good, good, you've brought
everything I've asked. Give
me a moment to process these
materials and make the medicine. ^333333*Sigh*^000000 I used to have assistants
do this kind of work for me...
scripts.translation:
[多诺]
很好，很好，你把我要的东西都带来了。
给我一点时间处理这些材料并制作药物。^333333*叹气*^000000 我以前有助手
帮我做这种工作...

scripts.text:
[Dono]
Back when I used to work for
the Rekenber Corporation, I was
a department head! Oh well, it
can't be helped now. Ah, it's
done. Now, let me test this
out before I give it to you.
scripts.translation:
[多诺]
当我还在雷肯贝尔公司工作时，
我是部门主管！唉，算了，
现在没办法了。啊，完成了。
现在，让我在给你之前先测试一下。

scripts.text:
^3355FFDono reveals that he has
grinded the materials into
a fine powder. He sprinkles
a small amount into a glass
of water, and the liquid turns
blue after he mixes it.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF多诺将材料研磨成
细粉。他将少量粉末撒入
一杯水中，搅拌后液体
变成了蓝色。^000000

scripts.text:
[Dono]
Damn! I used the right
proportions! Why isn't it
working?! Morriphen, I hate
you! Grrr...! Hey, kid, I need
you to help me again!
scripts.translation:
[多诺]
该死！我用了正确的
比例！为什么不起作用？！
莫里芬，我恨你！咕噜...！
喂，小孩，我需要你再帮我一次！

scripts.text:
[Dono]
Go to the Lighthalzen
Makkie. Tell him I sent you
to get some Red Plant Stem Powder for Morriphen's medicine.
scripts.translation:
[多诺]
去里希塔乐镇找玛琪。
告诉他我派你去
拿一些红草根粉，用于莫里芬的药物。

scripts.text:
[Dono]
Look, I know it's a pain,
but hurry and get it for me
as fast as you can. I need
that stuff to correct some
chemical impurities in this
medicine. Go, go now!
scripts.translation:
[多诺]
听着，我知道这很麻烦，
但请尽可能快地去拿。
我需要那种东西来修正
这种药物中的化学杂质。
去吧，快去吧！

scripts.text:
[Dono]
If you don't hurry and
gather the materials for
the medicine, Morriphen
and Siria are gonna be
in big trouble. Listen
up, this is what I need...
scripts.translation:
[多诺]
如果你不快点收集
制作药物的材料，
莫里芬和西丽亚
就要出大麻烦了。
听好了，我需要的是...

scripts.text:
[Dono]
Go get
^3355FF5 Coal^000000,
^3355FF5 Brigan^000000,
^3355FF5 Cyfar^000000,
^3355FF1 Unripe Apple^000000,
^3355FF3 Detrimindexta^000000...

[Dono]
...^3355FF20 Shells^000000,
^3355FF1 Red Herb^000000,
^3355FF1 Blue Herb^000000,
^3355FF1 Green Herb^000000,
^3355FF1 White Herb^000000, and
^3355FF1 Yellow Herb^000000.

[Dono]
Hey, you should be able
to find Makkie inside the
pub across the street. Hurry
up and bring me some Red
Plant Stem Power from him. Come on, Morriphen's in trouble!
scripts.translation:
[多诺]
嘿，你应该能在
街对面的酒馆里找到玛琪。
快点去跟他拿一些红草根粉。
快啊，莫里芬有麻烦了！

scripts.text:
[Dono]
Where is it?!
Okay, good, you brought
it. Huh. This isn't a lot of
Red Plant Stem Powder,
but this should do. Alright,
let's see if it works now.
scripts.translation:
[多诺]
在哪里？！
好的，很好，你带来了。
嗯。这不是很多红草根粉，
但应该够了。好了，
让我们看看现在是否有效。

scripts.text:
^3355FFDono sprinkles the
red powder into the
glass of blue water.
The liquid immediately
becomes red.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF多诺将红色粉末撒入
装有蓝色液体的玻璃杯中。
液体立刻变成了红色。^000000

scripts.text:
[Dono]
Great, the medicine is
finally ready! By the way,
how is Makkie doing? I know
he's got a big mouth, so did
he tell you anything stupid?
scripts.translation:
[多诺]
太好了，药物终于
准备好了！顺便问一下，
玛琪怎么样了？我知道
他嘴很碎，他有没有
跟你说了什么蠢话？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Er, he did mention that
both you and Morriphen used
to work together for Rekenber.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃，他确实提到
你和莫里芬以前
曾在雷肯贝尔一起工作。

scripts.text:
[Dono]
He did, huh? Yeah, that's
true. Morriphen and I used
to be researchers... those
were the best damn days
of my life. Afterwards, it
pretty much went downhill.
scripts.translation:
[多诺]
他确实说了啊？是的，
那是真的。莫里芬和我
以前都是研究员...那是
我生命中最美好的日子。
之后，事情就越来越糟了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What do you mean?
Did something happen?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你什么意思？
发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Dono]
Oh, hell yeah. That dumb
romanticist Morriphen caused
huge trouble for the company.
It's pretty much his fault that
I got fired from Rekenber.
Grr! Let's not talk about it!
scripts.translation:
[多诺]
哦，天哪。那个愚蠢的
浪漫主义者莫里芬给公司
惹了大麻烦。基本上就是
他的错，让我被雷肯贝尔
解雇了。咕噜！别提了！

scripts.text:
[Dono]
Just thinking about what
happened makes me so angry!
I swear, I'd kill him if he wasn't my best friend! Ah, speaking
of which, you better get this
medicine to Morriphen now!
scripts.translation:
[多诺]
光是想想发生的事
我就很生气！我发誓，
如果不是我最好的朋友，
我早就杀了他了！啊，
说到这个，你最好现在
就把药带给莫里芬！

scripts.text:
[Dono]
Right, and don't
mention anything
I said to him, willya?
If he gets upset, and
stresses himself to death,
my work will be for nothing.
scripts.translation:
[多诺]
对了，别把
我说的话告诉他，好吗？
如果他生气了，
把自己气死了，
我的工作就白费了。

scripts.text:
[Dono]
Whoa, what are you still
doing here?! Hurry and
get that medicine over to
Morriphen, or he'll die soon!
scripts.translation:
[多诺]
哇，你在这里做什么？！
快点把药带给莫里芬，
不然他很快就会死的！

scripts.text:
[Dono]
Oh, hey, do you know
how Morriphen's doing?
Tell that jerk to come
by more often. He's the
only guy that can offer me
a decent challenge at chess...
scripts.translation:
[多诺]
哦，嘿，你知道
莫里芬现在怎么样了？
告诉那个混蛋多来
这里走走。他是唯一
能给我下棋带来挑战的人...

scripts.text:
[Dono]
Oh, hey, do you know
how Morriphen's doing?
Tell that jerk to come
by more often. He's the
only guy that can offer me
a decent challenge at chess...
scripts.translation:
[多诺]
哦，嘿，你知道
莫里芬现在怎么样了？
告诉那个混蛋多来
这里走走。他是唯一
能给我下棋带来挑战的人...

scripts.text:

Oh, hey, do you know
how Morriphen's doing?
Tell that jerk to come
by more often. He's the
only guy that can offer me
a decent challenge at chess...
scripts.translation:
[多诺]
哦，嘿，你知道
莫里芬现在怎么样了？
告诉那个混蛋多来
这里走走。他是唯一
能给我下棋带来挑战的人...

scripts.text:
[Dono]
Hey, store's closed!
I'll open when I feel
like it, so until then,
I'm not selling you
anything! Now, scram!
scripts.translation:
[多诺]
嘿，商店关门了！
我想开的时候才会开，
在那之前，我不卖
任何东西给你！现在，
滚开！

scripts.text:
[Makkie]
Hello, how may
I help you today?
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
你好，今天有什么
可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I'm here to get
some Red Plant Stem
Powder for Dono. It's
pretty important, actually.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我来找多诺拿
一些红草根粉。这其实
很重要。

scripts.text:
[Makkie]
Ah, I see. He must need
it to prepare medicine for
Morriphen and Siria, am
I right? Okay, just give me
a moment. While you're waiting, go ahead and relax, look around...
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
啊，我明白了。他一定是
需要它来为莫里芬和西丽亚
准备药物，对吗？好的，
请稍等。在等待的时候，
你可以放松一下，四处看看...

scripts.text:
^3355FFMakkie sifted the powder
into a bag for you, you see
a picture of Makkie, Dono,
and Morriphen wearing white
lab coats on the table.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF玛琪将粉末筛入
袋子给你，你看到
桌子上有一张照片，
照片上是玛琪、多诺
和莫里芬穿着白大褂。^000000

scripts.text:
[Makkie]
Oh, that? Yeah, that was
taken when Dono, Morriphen
and I worked for the
Rekenber Corporation. I know
they look eccentric, but they're really good guys, trust me.
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
哦，那个？是的，那是
多诺、莫里芬和我在
雷肯贝尔公司工作时
拍的。我知道他们看起来
有点古怪，但他们真的是
好人，相信我。

scripts.text:
[Makkie]
Yeah, I used to work under
Dono, actually. He was head
of the Genetic Engineering
Department, and Morriphen
was doing other research.
Those were some good times.
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
是的，我以前曾在
多诺手下工作。他是
基因工程部门的主管，
而莫里芬在做其他研究。
那是些美好的时光。

scripts.text:
[Makkie]
Suddenly, me, Dono, and
everyone else working under
him was just fired! I was new
at the time, so I was only able
to learn why we were fired much
later than everyone else.
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
突然之间，我、多诺，还有在他手下工作的所有人都被解雇了！当时我刚入职不久，所以直到很久之后我才弄清楚大家被解雇的原因。

scripts.text:
[Makkie]
It turns out that there
was a fire, possibly arson,
in the Rekenber genetic labs.
Dono assumed full responsibility, though everyone who worked for
him just knows he didn't do it.
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
原来是在基因学者研究所发生了一场火灾，可能是人为纵火。多诺承担了一切责任，但在他手下工作的人都知道，这并不是他做的。

scripts.text:
[Makkie]
So that's how we ended
up at our current jobs.
Strangely enough, Morriphen
disappeared at the same time.
I don't know what happened to him since our days at Rekenber...
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
所以我们才来到了现在的工作岗位。奇怪的是，莫里芬也在同一时间消失了。自从我们在雷肯贝尔公司工作之后，我就不知道他后来怎么样了...

scripts.text:
[Makkie]
Anyway, when Morriphen
showed up again, he ended up
needing the medicine we're
making. I sure wish I had a
best friend like Dono or
Morriphen. Those two are close.
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
总之，当莫里芬再次出现时，他正好需要我们要制作的药物。我真希望能像多诺或莫里芬那样有个好朋友。他们两个关系很亲密。

scripts.text:
[Makkie]
Yeah, Dono sure is a nice guy.
He even helped me get this job~
Anyway, if you see him, or if
you visit Morriphen, please
give them my regards. Here you
are: Red Plant Stem Powder.
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
是啊，多诺真是个好人。
他甚至帮我找到了这份工作~
总之，如果你见到他，或者去拜访莫里芬，请代我向他们问好。给你：红草根粉。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou receive a small bag
of Red Plant Stem Powder.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你获得了一小袋红草根粉。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh! Thanks so much
for the powder. Now,
I better hurry and give
this to Dono. Goodbye~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦！非常感谢你的粉末。
现在，我得赶紧把这个交给多诺。再见~

scripts.text:
[Makkie]
Gosh, I'm so bored~
I wouldn't even mind
having some work to do.
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
天哪，我好无聊~
我甚至不介意有点工作做。

scripts.text:
[Makkie]
Gosh, I'm so bored~
I wouldn't even mind
having some work to do.
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
天哪，我好无聊~
我甚至不介意有点工作做。

scripts.text:
[Makkie]
Gosh, I'm so bored~
I wouldn't even mind
having some work to do.
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
天哪，我好无聊~
我甚至不介意有点工作做。

scripts.text:
[Makkie]
Hm? Shouldn't you hurry
and get that bag of Red
Plant Stem Powder to
Dono as soon as you can?
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
嗯？你不应该尽快把那袋红草根粉交给多诺吗？

scripts.text:
[Makkie]
Hey, have you seen
Morriphen and Dono
lately? I hope they're
doing alright. Maybe
I should go see them
soon, for old time's sake.
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
嘿，你最近见过莫里芬和多诺吗？我希望他们一切都好。也许我该趁早去见见他们，叙叙旧。

scripts.text:
[Makkie]
Hey, have you seen
Morriphen and Dono
lately? I hope they're
doing alright. Maybe
I should go see them
soon, for old time's sake.
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
嘿，你最近见过莫里芬和多诺吗？我希望他们一切都好。也许我该趁早去见见他们，叙叙旧。

scripts.text:

I should go see them
soon, for old time's sake.
scripts.translation:
