scripts.text:
[Manainne]
This tree means so much
to everyone in this town,
and we all have special
memories of this place. But
that El Schatt fellow plans to
chop it down for his shop...
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
这棵树对镇上的每个人来说都意义非凡，
我们都在这里留下了特别的回忆。
但那个艾尔·沙特竟然打算
为了他的商店把它砍掉...

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
You see him? That's
El Schatt right there.
I've never met anyone
so cruel and selfish!
Right now he's surveying
the land for construction...
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
你看到了吗？
那就是艾尔·沙特。
我从来没见过
比他更残忍、更自私的人！
他现在正在勘察
用于施工的土地...

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
This tree means so much
to everyone in this town,
and we all have special
memories of this place. But
that El Schatt fellow plans to
chop it down for his shop...
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
这棵树对镇上的每个人来说都意义非凡，
我们都在这里留下了特别的回忆。
但那个艾尔·沙特竟然打算
为了他的商店把它砍掉...

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
You see him? That's
El Schatt right there.
I've never met anyone
so cruel and selfish!
Right now he's surveying
the land for construction...
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
你看到了吗？
那就是艾尔·沙特。
我从来没见过
比他更残忍、更自私的人！
他现在正在勘察
用于施工的土地...

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
You know, El Schatt and
I used to get along when
he dated my older sister,
Kanainne. In fact, they'd
always spend time together right under that tree. Weird, huh?
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
你知道吗，艾尔·沙特
和我以前相处得还不错，
当时他还在追求
我的姐姐卡娜茵。
事实上，他们总是
在那棵树下共度时光。真奇怪，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
Then, well, Kanainne
got really sick, and we...
We couldn't help her. She
passed away, and then El Schatt
just disappeared. It was only
recently that he's come back.
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
后来，卡娜茵
病得很重，我们...
我们没能救下她。
她去世后，艾尔·沙特
就消失了。直到最近
他才回来。

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
Now El Schatt is just a
heartless, money grubbing...!
He's completely changed.
My sister would be rolling
in her grave, seeing him now...
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
现在的艾尔·沙特
就是个无情、唯利是图的...！
他完全变了一个人。
我姐姐看到现在的他，
恐怕在九泉之下都要气得转圈了...

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
Now El Schatt is just a
heartless, money grubbing...!
He's completely changed.
My sister would be rolling
in her grave, seeing him now...
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
现在的艾尔·沙特
就是个无情、唯利是图的...！
他完全变了一个人。
我姐姐看到现在的他，
恐怕在九泉之下都要气得转圈了...

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
What? That's...
That's an incredible
story. You met my dead
sister in Niflheim?! You
must be lying to me!
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
什么？那是...
那是个不可思议的故事。
你在尼弗海姆遇到了
我死去的姐姐？！
你肯定是在骗我！

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
Let's... Let's just
stop talking about this,
okay? I appreciate that you
want to stop El Schatt from
cutting down our tree, but
this is almost too much.
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
我们...
我们别再谈这个了，
好吗？我很感激你
想阻止艾尔·沙特
砍掉我们的树，
但这真的有点太过分了。

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
Gosh, all that talk
about Niflheim is...
It's giving me the chills!
A-aren't you cold?
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
天哪，刚才那些
关于尼弗海姆的话题...
听得我直打寒颤！
你...你不觉得冷吗？

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
......
.........
Huh? You're...
Still here...?

[Manainne]
Y-you know what's
weird? The weather's
perfectly fine, but I...
I feel so cold all of a
sudden. You don't feel
it at all, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
你...你知道奇怪的是什么吗？
天气明明很好，但我...
我突然觉得好冷。你完全
没感觉到，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
I think I'm coming down
with something. My head
feels so numb, and I c-can't
focus any of my thoughts.
This is freakin' me out...
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
我觉得我好像要生病了。
我的头好晕，我...我完全
无法集中注意力。
这真的吓到我了...

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
...!

[Manainne]
...I'm here. I'm really
back! Oh, it's been so
long! Hello, adventurer,
remember me? I'm Kanainne,
the spirit you saw down in
Niflheim. Let me explain...
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
...我在这里。我真的
回来了！好久不见！你好，冒险者，
还记得我吗？我是卡娜茵，
你在尼弗海姆见到的那个精灵。
让我解释一下...

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
My spirit was able to follow
you here, and now that I'm
here, I only have so much time
to possess my sister's body,
and then talk to El Schatt.
El Schatt? El Schatt...?
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
我的灵魂能够
跟随你来到这里，
而现在我既然在这里，
我就只有这么点时间
附身在我姐姐的身体里，
去和艾尔·沙特谈谈。
艾尔·沙特？艾尔·沙特...？

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Manainne...?
What do you want?
Quit bugging me,
I'm busy right now...
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
玛娜茵...？
你想干什么？
别烦我了，
我现在很忙...

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
It's... It's me,
El Schatt, it's Kanainne.
Of course you remember
me, right? Listen, I need to--
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
是我...
是我，艾尔·沙特，
我是卡娜茵。
你当然记得我，对吧？
听着，我需要--

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Manainne...?!
I'm shocked...
Don't you respect
your own sister?!
I can't believe you'd...
Knock it off right now!
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
玛娜茵...？！
我震惊了...
你不尊重你自己的姐姐吗？！
我简直不敢相信你会...
立刻给我闭嘴！

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Look, out of my respect
for you and the relationship
that me and your sister had,
I'm going to forget you said
that. But don't you dare use
her name that way again!
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
听着，出于对你的尊重，
以及我和你姐姐曾经的关系，
我会假装没听到你刚才说的话。
但你绝对不许
再那样用她的名字！

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
Wait, El Schatt!
It's really me, but
I can only speak to you
through my sister for
a short time. L-listen...
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
等等，艾尔·沙特！
真的是我，但我只能通过我姐姐
和你短暂地对话。听...听我说...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Manainne...
You don't make jokes
like that about the departed,
especially if it's Kannaine.
You know better than that!
Where the hell's your respect?!
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
玛娜茵...
你不可以拿逝者开玩笑，
尤其是卡娜茵。
你明明比谁都清楚！
你的尊重呢？！

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
''If you're the wind,
I'll be the sky, so that you
can fly freely in my arms...''
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
“如果你是一阵风，
我愿化作天空，
让你在我的怀抱中自由飞翔...”

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Huh...?!

[Manainne]
''My soul is just
for you, the shining
sun that brightens
up my whole world.''
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
“我的灵魂只属于你，
你是照亮我整个世界的
那轮耀眼的太阳。”

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
How do you...
How do you know
those words...?
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
你怎么...
你怎么会知道
那些话...？

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
''In my dream, your
eyes held the reflection
of the ocean's clear waters... Someday I'll show them to you.''
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
“在我的梦里，
你的眼眸映照着海洋清澈的水光...
总有一天我会把它们展示给你看。”

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
''Your lovely face,
your enticing smile...
They're forever be in my
heart, so I'll never be lonely.''
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
“你可爱的脸庞，
你迷人的微笑...
它们永远留在我心中，
所以我永远不会感到孤单。”

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Manainne...
How do you
know that song?
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
玛娜茵...
你怎么
知道那首歌？

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
El Schatt...
It's me, Kanainne.
You wrote this song
just for me. But I died
before you could finish it.
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
艾尔·沙特...
是我，卡娜茵。
你专门为我写了这首歌。
但我在你写完之前就去世了。

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
That was your dream,
wasn't it? To play your
beautiful music to make
people happy? Did you ever
finish our song for me?
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
那是你的梦想，
对吧？用你美妙的音乐
让人们感到幸福？
你最终为我们完成了那首歌吗？

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Hahahah, Manainne, alright.
Your sister must have told
you about that song. Ha ha...
You're t-taking it too far...
Please, just... Just stop.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
哈哈哈哈哈，玛娜茵，好吧。
你姐姐一定跟你提过那首歌。
哈...哈...
你...你太过分了...
求求你...停下来吧。

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
El Schatt...
Listen to me.
Look at me. It's
really your Kanainne.
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
艾尔·沙特...
听我说。
看着我。真的是
你的卡娜茵。

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Kanainne...?
It's too much to
believe. I want to
believe it so badly...
Is it really you?
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
卡娜茵...？
这太难以置信了。
我多么希望能相信...
真的是你吗？

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
El Schatt...
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
艾尔·沙特...

scripts.text:
^3355FFManainne is sobbing
uncontrollably, and there's
nothing you can do to comfort
her. Nothing at all. You must
leave her alone to her despair
and unfathomable sense of loss.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF玛娜茵无法控制地哭泣，
你什么都做不了来安慰她。
什么都做不了。你只能
让她独自面对绝望和无尽的失落。^000000

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
You know, even though
it's not a wealthy area,
I really love this small
and quiet town. Even if
I could live anywhere in
the world, I'd live right here~
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
你知道吗，虽然这里
不是富裕的地方，
但我真的很喜欢这个
小而安静的城镇。即使
我可以住在世界的任何角落，
我还是会选择住在这里~

scripts.text:
[Spirit]
El Schatt...
Manainne...
I miss them...
scripts.translation:
[精灵]
艾尔·沙特...
玛娜茵...
我想念他们...

scripts.text:
[Spirit]
Those names... Yes,
I remember now. Manainee
was... my younger sister.
El Schatt was... my lover.
M-my name was... Kanainne!
scripts.translation:
[精灵]
那些名字...是的，
我想起来了。玛娜茵是...
我的妹妹。
艾尔·沙特是...我的爱人。
我...我的名字是...卡娜茵！

scripts.text:
[Kanainne's Spirit]
Now I know why I'm here
in this realm. El Schatt...
I've been watching him.
He isn't able to let me go...
But I can't directly intervene
with the affairs of the living.
scripts.translation:
[卡奈恩之魂]
现在我知道我为什么
会出现在这个领域了。艾尔·沙特...
我一直在注视着他。
他无法放下我...
但我不能直接干涉
生者的事务。

scripts.text:
[Kanainne's Spirit]
I... I can borrow my
sister's body? Yes, if she
cooperates, maybe... Maybe
it will work. I must... must do
something before he does
he hurts himself even more...
scripts.translation:
[卡奈恩之魂]
我...我可以借用
我妹妹的身体吗？是的，
如果她配合的话，也许...
也许行得通。我必须...
必须在他伤害自己之前
做点什么...

scripts.text:
[Kanainne's Spirit]
You... You can help
me... Just go back to 
the living... to Hugel...
Let me send you there...
scripts.translation:
[卡奈恩之魂]
你...你可以帮
我的忙...回到
生者的世界...去毁葛...
让我送你去那里...

scripts.text:
[Kanainne's Spirit]
You...! You can help
me... Just go back to 
the living... to Hugel...
Let me send you there...
scripts.translation:
[卡奈恩之魂]
你...！你可以帮
我的忙...回到
生者的世界...去毁葛...
让我送你去那里...

scripts.text:
[Spirit]
The living shouldn't
be here in Niflheim...
Go back! Go back to your
own world before it's too late!
scripts.translation:
[精灵]
生者不应该
出现在尼弗尔海姆...
回去吧！回到
你自己的世界，
不然就来不及了！

scripts.text:
[Spirit]
El Schatt...
Manainne...
I miss them...
scripts.translation:
[精灵]
艾尔·沙特...
玛娜茵...
我想念他们...

scripts.text:
[Perfitz]
I'm pleased that my son has
finally set his mind on the
family business. I didn't know
he had it in him to become
such a proactive entrepreneur.
scripts.translation:
[佩尔菲茨]
我很高兴我的儿子
终于下定决心
接手家业了。我没想到
他居然有成为
如此积极的创业者的潜质。

scripts.text:
[Perfitz]
It's funny... He used to
deperately fight me when it
came to building shops where
that tree has planted. Yes, I'm
proud that he's grown as a
business person. Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[佩尔菲茨]
真有趣...以前他
总是拼命和我争辩，
反对在那棵树旁边
建商店。是的，
我为他作为一个
商人的成长感到骄傲。呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Perfitz]
Although I'm pleased,
I get this gut feeling that
something's not right, like
he's too excited about cutting
that tree down. Maybe this old
man is just too suspcious~
scripts.translation:
[佩尔菲茨]
虽然我很高兴，
但我有种直觉
觉得不对劲，
好像他对砍倒
那棵树太兴奋了。
也许是我这个
老头子太疑神疑鬼了~

scripts.text:
[Perfitz]
It's funny how things
change. You know, El Schatt
actually used to protest against my idea of building shops in the
area when that tree grows. Hmm... I wonder, what happened to him?
scripts.translation:
[佩尔菲茨]
世事真是变化莫测。
你知道吗，艾尔·沙特
以前其实反对过
我在那棵树生长的
区域建商店的想法。
嗯...我想知道，
他后来怎么样了？

scripts.text:
[Perfitz]
Money is very dependable...
But it's value is relative, and
can change at any moment.
Still, at my age, you can't
live without it. Make sure you
financially prepare of old age.
scripts.translation:
[佩尔菲茨]
金钱是非常可靠的...
但它的价值是相对的，
随时都可能改变。
不过，到了我这个年纪，
没有钱是活不下去的。
一定要为晚年
做好财务准备。

scripts.text:
[Perfitz]
Now, most people assume that
I have very few friends because
I trust money more than people.
That's somewhat true: money
will never betray you, and few
friends can be so dependable.
scripts.translation:
[佩尔菲茨]
现在，大多数人认为
我朋友很少，因为
我信钱胜过信人。
这倒是有几分道理：
金钱永远不会背叛你，
而能如此可靠的朋友
寥寥无几。

scripts.text:
[Perfitz]
However, friends that can
be trusted for life are worth
more than all the money in the
world. To a rich man like me,
those are the only friends
that are worth having.
scripts.translation:
[佩尔菲茨]
然而，能托付终身的
朋友比世界上所有的
金钱都更有价值。
对于像我这样的
富人来说，
只有这样的朋友
才值得结交。

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
What? What's that look for?
Oh, you must have spoken to
Manainne. Look, memories are
nice and all, but I don't dwell
on the past. I think about the
future. That's what's best.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
什么？你这是什么表情？
哦，你肯定是和
玛娜茵聊过了。听着，
回忆固然美好，
但我不会沉溺于过去。
我思考的是未来。
这才是最重要的。

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Hey, I've got some great
memories of this place too,
but you know what? I've decided
to let go of them before they
get too painful. That's life.
Besides, it's not all bad.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
嘿，我对这个地方
也有很多美好的回忆，
但你知道吗？
我决定在它们变得
太痛苦之前放下它们。
这就是生活。
况且，也不是全是坏事。

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
My father's been wanting to
build a shop here for so long,
and now, I think it's about time. And this business will help the
entire community. We should've
done this a long time ago...
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
我父亲一直想
在这里建商店，
现在，我觉得时机到了。
而且这个生意会帮助
整个社区。我们早该
这么做了...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
C'mon... Take a look
around. I won't deny that
this is a quaint and lovely
town, but how much money do
you think these people enjoy?
I need to look to the future...
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
来吧...四处看看。
我不否认这是一个
古朴而美丽的小镇，
但你觉得这些人
能享受多少金钱？
我需要展望未来...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
This is the perfect
location for shops.
Yeah, I'll build a whole
plaza, and rent it out to the
merchants. Build up some
commerce, attract businesses...
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
这里是建商店的
绝佳位置。
是的，我要建一个
大型广场，
租给商人们。
发展商业，吸引企业...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Everyone should just
forget about that tree.
When you think about it,
it's just a waste of space...
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
大家应该
忘掉那棵树。
仔细想想，
它只是浪费空间...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
You've spoken with my father?
Hmpf! Don't tell me you're here
to change my mind. I'm building
those shops, and that's final.
It's useless to try to convince
me otherwise. Understand?
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
你和我父亲谈过了？
哼！别告诉我你是来
改变我主意的。
我要建那些商店，
这是最终决定。
试图说服我改变主意
是没用的。明白吗？

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
It's true that I used
to think differently...
I'd protect that old tree
with my life, I won't deny
it. But that's an old story that should be buried in the past...
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
确实，我以前
想法不同...
我会拼了命保护
那棵老树，我不否认。
但那是应该被埋藏在
过去的旧事...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
The past is behind me
as it should be. Now
I must focus on building
my family's businesses.
Father was right all along...
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
过去就该留在
过去。现在
我必须专注于
发展家族的事业。
父亲一直是对的...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
What did you say...?
You met Kanainne?
Listen, that's not funny.
I won't tolerate that kind
of sick joke, so get out
of here before I get angry.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
你刚才说什么...？
你见过玛娜茵？
听着，这不好笑。
我无法容忍这种
恶心的玩笑，
趁我发火之前
赶紧滚出去。

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
No way...!
Kanainne is dead!
There's no way
I can believe this!
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
不可能...！
玛娜茵已经死了！
我绝不可能
相信这件事！

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
K-Kanainne! ^333333*Sob*^000000
I've missed you so much!
Why did you leave me?
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
玛...玛娜茵！ ^333333*抽泣*^000000
我好想你！
你为什么要离开我？

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
Oh, my dear,
sweet El Schatt...
I'm so sorry. But
that was my fate...
It was my time to go...
You have to let me go...
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
亲爱的，
可爱的艾尔·沙特...
我很抱歉。但
那是我的命运...
是我该走的时候了...
你必须让我离开...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
I can't take it anymore!
It hurts too much without you!
I can't stop thinking about us,
and all the memories... all of
the memories hurt so much...
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
我受不了了！
没有你太痛苦了！
我忍不住想起我们，
还有那些回忆... 所有的
回忆都让我好痛...

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
Is that why you want to
cut down that tree? Because
it reminds you too much of
all of our days together?
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
这就是你想
砍掉那棵树的原因吗？因为
它让你想起了
我们在一起的所有日子？

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Y-yes! Seeing it makes
me so angry and so sad!
I wanted to get rid of it!
If I don't forget you, then
what will I do? I c-can't
forget about you, c-can I?
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
是...是的！看到它
让我又气又难过！
我想把它除掉！
如果我不忘记你，
那我该怎么办？我...我
忘不了你，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
Will destroying that tree
make you happy? Do you think
you'll be happy if you forget
all about me? I know you're
not like that, El Schatt.
You're not that cold...
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
砍掉那棵树
会让你快乐吗？你觉得
如果你完全忘记我，
你会快乐吗？我知道
你不是那样的人，艾尔·沙特。
你没有那么冷酷...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
No... I don't want
to forget you. All of
our good times. But I miss
you so much... I think I'm
going to go insane! I don't
know if I can endure this pain!
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
不...我不想
忘记你。我们
所有美好的时光。但我好想你... 我觉得我
快要疯了！我不知道
我能不能忍受这种痛苦！

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
Please be strong for me,
El Schatt. Someday, time
will heal your wounds, and
your memories of me will only
bring you fondness, not pain.
I miss you El Schatt, and I...
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
请为了我坚强起来，
艾尔·沙特。总有一天，时间
会治愈你的伤口，
你对我的回忆只会
带来怀念，而不是痛苦。
我想你，艾尔·沙特，我...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Kanainne...?
K-Kanaine?
What's happening?
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
玛娜茵...？
玛...玛娜茵？
发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
El Schatt, I'm so sorry...
But I have to go now. I can't
stay in the world of the living
for too long, and my time limit
is almost up. I still... I...
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
艾尔·沙特，我很抱歉...
但我现在必须走了。我不能
在人间停留太久，
我的时间快到了。我还... 我...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
N-no! Please, stay with
me! I'm not ready to lose
you again! D-don't leave
me again! Nooo! Kanainne!
I need you here with me!
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
不...！求你，留下来
陪我！我还没准备好
再次失去你！别...别再次
离开我！不...！玛娜茵！
我需要你在这里陪我！

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
I can't do that...
But please, El Schatt...
Promise that you'll be
yourself from now on...
Be kind... And follow
your true dreams...
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
我做不到...
但是请，艾尔·沙特...
答应我从今以后
做回你自己...
要善良... 并且追随
你真正的梦想...

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
Don't cut down
that tree... And make...
make beautiful music.
Please finish the song
that you made for me for...
for both of our sakes...
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
不要砍掉
那棵树... 并且... 并且
创作美妙的音乐。
请完成那首
你为我写的歌，为了...
为了我们两个...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Anything for you,
Kanainne. I vow it...
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
为了你，
玛娜茵。我发誓...

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
El Schatt...
I still... I still...
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
艾尔·沙特...
我还... 我还...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Y-yes...
Kanainne...?
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
是...是的...
玛娜茵...？

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Kanainne...?
Kanainne!
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
玛娜茵...？
玛娜茵！

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
...I...
...El Schatt...
She's gone again.
It's... I'm Manainne...
^333333*Sniff*^000000 She had to go back...
scripts.translation:
[玛娜茵]
...我...
...艾尔·沙特...
她又走了。
我是...我是玛娜茵...
^333333*抽泣*^000000 她不得不回去了...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Oh... Oh dear
sweet God... My...
My dear Kanainne...
No.... No... Please...
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
噢...噢，天哪...
我的...
我亲爱的玛娜茵...
不...不...求求你...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
...Would you please
leave me alone? I have...
I have an awful lot to
think about. And there's
music that I have to write...
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
...请让我一个人待着好吗？我有很多...
有很多事情要思考。而且我还有音乐要写...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Father was right...
This area is the perfect
place to build some stores.
All that's left is to chop down
that old tree. It's in the way
of a whole lot of things...
scripts.translation:
[艾尔·沙特]
神父说得对...
这个地方非常适合建商店。
剩下的就是砍掉那棵老树了。它挡了很多东西的路...

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
D-Daddy...!
Daddy where
are you?! Wah~!
scripts.translation:
[托尔皮]
爸...爸爸...！
爸爸你在哪里？！哇~！

scripts.text: What's wrong?
scripts.translation: 怎么了？

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
My Daddy hasn't
been home for a few
day now. I'm afraid that
something must have
happened to him. *Sniff*
scripts.translation:
[托尔皮]
爸爸已经好几天没回家了。我很担心他是不是出什么事了。*抽泣*

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Your Dad is missing?
Why don't you tell me
about the last time
that you saw him?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你爸爸失踪了？
为什么不告诉我你最后一次见到他是什么时候呢？

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
Well, we were playing
Hide-and-Seek, and then
it was his turn to hide,
and then, a-and then...
I never found him!
scripts.translation:
[托尔皮]
嗯，我们在玩捉迷藏，然后轮到爸爸藏起来，然后，然后...
我就再也找不到他了！

scripts.text: Really? Tell me more...
scripts.translation: 真的吗？再多告诉我一些...

scripts.text: What, is that all...?
scripts.translation: 就这些吗...？

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
Th-then my Mom got
mad at Dad for hiding
for so long. But when
she went to find him, she
disappeared too! I-I'm all
alone now! Waaaaaah~!
scripts.translation:
[托尔皮]
然后妈妈因为爸爸藏太久生气了。但妈妈去找他的时候，她也消失了！我现在一个人了！哇啊啊啊~！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't worry, I'll look
for your parents. I'm
sure that I can find at
least one of them just
outside of town.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
别担心，我会帮你找父母的。我相信我能在城外找到至少其中一个。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't worry, your
Dad will probably
show up sooner
or later. Well, lots
of luck, kid.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
别担心，你爸爸很快就会回来的。祝你好运，小孩。

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
D-Daddy...!
Mommiiiiiiiiie!
Where are yoooou?!
Wuh-Waaaaaaaaaah!
scripts.translation:
[托尔皮]
爸...爸爸...！
妈妈~！
你们在哪里？！呜-哇啊啊啊！

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
Oh...
Mommy was just
outside of town?
*Sob* Okay, I hope my
Daddy comes back soon...
scripts.translation:
[托尔皮]
噢...
妈妈就在城外？
*抽泣* 好吧，希望爸爸快点回来...

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
Y-you found my Daddy!
Hooray! I was so worried
about him! Th-thank you
so much for your help!
scripts.translation:
[托尔皮]
你...你找到我爸爸了！
太好了！我好担心他！非常感谢你的帮助！

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
Um, um, where is my
Daddy hiding anyway?
Oh? A barrel? Where
was it again? Heh heh!
Now I can find him!
scripts.translation:
[托尔皮]
嗯，嗯，爸爸到底藏在哪里呢？
噢？一个桶？在哪里来着？嘿嘿！
现在我可以找到他了！

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
Oh, would you go talk
to my Mom, and tell her
to come here please? And
also tell her that Daddy
is safe! See you later~
scripts.translation:
[托尔皮]
你能去跟我妈妈说一声，让她来这里吗？
顺便告诉她爸爸很安全！再见~

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
^333333...............................
Hee hee~ Once I find
my Daddy, he has to get me
a girlfriend! He promised~!^000000

[Torpy]
Would you please hurry
and talk to my Mom? She
should be just outside of?
this town, where you last
saw her. Bye bye for now~
scripts.translation:
[托尔皮]
你能快点去跟我妈妈说一声吗？
她应该就在城外，你上次见到她的地方。拜拜~

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
^333333...............................
Oh yeah! Should I have
Mom help me pick out my
new girlfriend? Hmm, I dunno.
Wh-what if they become friends?
Um, that might not be good...^000000
scripts.translation:
[托尔皮]
^333333...............................
对了！要不要让妈妈帮我挑女朋友呢？嗯，不知道。
万...万一她们成了朋友怎么办？
嗯，那样可能不太好...^000000

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
Daddy promised to get
me a girlfriend if I beat him
at Hide-and-Seek! Hahaha!
I won, so now he has to do it!
scripts.translation:
[托尔皮]
爸爸答应过，如果我赢了他捉迷藏，就给我找个女朋友！哈哈哈！
我赢了，所以他必须兑现承诺！

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
Wait, but should I let
my Dad pick my girlfriend?
Maybe I should pick her...
Yeah, I'll pick the perfectest
girl that I can find! Yaaay~
scripts.translation:
[托尔皮]
等等，但我应该让爸爸帮我挑女朋友吗？
也许我应该自己挑...
没错，我要找到最完美的女孩！耶~

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
Maybe I should wait until
I'm older to have a girlfriend.
I mean, what if the girl I pick
now gets uglier when she
grows up? Or what if she gets really fat? I better be careful...
scripts.translation:
[托尔皮]
也许我应该等长大一点再交女朋友。
我是说，万一我现在挑的女孩长大后变丑了怎么办？
或者万一她变得很胖呢？我得小心点...

scripts.text:
^3355FFTorpy is still a young,
naive child that has much
to learn about girlfriends,
or just people, in general.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF托尔皮还是个年幼天真的孩子，
他对女朋友，或者对一般人，
还有很多要学习的地方。^000000

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
^333333*Sniff*^000000 D-Daddy's gone!
Will you help me find my
Daddy please? I h-have
to find him now! H-Hurry!
scripts.translation:
[托尔皮]
^333333*抽泣*^000000 爸...爸爸不见了！
你能帮我找找爸爸吗？
我...我必须马上找到他！快...快点！

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
Waaah~!
I have to find
my Daddy! Daddy...!
Where are yooooou?!
scripts.translation:
[托尔皮]
哇啊~！
我必须找到爸爸！爸爸...！
你在哪...哪里呀？！

scripts.text:
[Torpy's Mom]
Where did he go this time?!
If my husband doesn't have
a good excuse for not coming
home, then he better come
up with one or he'll be sorry!
scripts.translation:
[托尔皮的妈妈]
他这次又去哪了？！
如果我丈夫没有正当理由不回家，
那他最好想出一个，否则他会后悔的！

scripts.text:
[Torpy's Mom]
Hmm? Oh, you talked to
my little Torpy? He thinks his
father and I just vanished?
Oh, I'm so sorry, I think there's been some misunderstanding!
scripts.translation:
[托尔皮的妈妈]
嗯？哦，你跟我的小托尔皮说话了？
他以为我和他爸爸都失踪了？
哦，真抱歉，我想这里有些误会！

scripts.text:
[Torpy's Mom]
Although Torpy's father has
been missing for a little
while, I just stepped out of
the house this morning. So
I haven't even been gone for
a few hours, much less a day.
scripts.translation:
[托尔皮的妈妈]
虽然托尔皮的爸爸确实失踪了一会儿，
但我今天早上才刚出门。
所以我还没离开几个小时，更别提一天了。

scripts.text:
[Torpy's Mom]
You see, my husband is
a hunter, so it's usual for him
not to come home for a few
days. Still, he's never been
gone for this long before,
so I've been looking for him...
scripts.translation:
[托尔皮的妈妈]
你看，我丈夫是个猎人，
所以他几天不回家是很正常的。
不过，他以前从没失踪这么久过，
所以我一直在找他...

scripts.text:
[Torpy's Mom]
I've been getting a little
worried myself, honestly.
He's not in any of his usual
hunting grounds. Hopefully,
if I wait here long enough,
he'll show up sooner or later.
scripts.translation:
[托尔皮的妈妈]
说实话，我也开始有点担心了。
他不在他通常打猎的地方。
希望我在这里等得够久，
他迟早会出现的。

scripts.text:
[Torpy's Mom]
If he doesn't show up
today, I better search
for him inside town. Maybe
he's hiding somewhere,
like at his friend's house.
Why is like always like this?
scripts.translation:
[托尔皮的妈妈]
如果他今天还不出现，
我最好去镇子里找找。
也许他躲在某个地方，
比如他朋友家里。
为什么总是这样？

scripts.text:
[Torpy's Mom]
Listen, would you please
tell my son Torpy that I'm
fine and will be coming back
home soon? Also, if you see
my husband inside town, tell
him that he better come home!
scripts.translation:
[托尔皮的妈妈]
听着，你能帮我告诉儿子托尔皮，
我很好，很快就会回家吗？
还有，如果你在镇子里看到我丈夫，
告诉他他最好回家！

scripts.text:
[Torpy's Mom]
Listen, would you please
tell my son Torpy that I'm
fine and will be coming back
home soon? Also, if you see
my husband inside town, tell
him that he better come home!
scripts.translation:
[托尔皮的妈妈]
听着，你能帮我告诉儿子托尔皮，
我很好，很快就会回家吗？
还有，如果你在镇子里看到我丈夫，
告诉他他最好回家！

scripts.text:
[Torpy's Mom]
What?! He was hiding
inside a barrel this
entire time?! Oh, no.
I'm sorry, my husband has
caused you so much trouble.
scripts.translation:
[托尔皮的妈妈]
什么？！他整个时间都躲在桶里？！
哦，不。
对不起，我丈夫给你们添了这么多麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Torpy's Mom]
I really appreciate
everything you've done
to help us find him. I know
it's not much, but I hope
you accept this as our thanks.
Goodbye for now, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[托尔皮的妈妈]
我非常感谢你们为我们找到他所做的一切。
我知道这不算什么，
但希望你们能收下这份感谢。
再见，冒险者~

scripts.text:
[Torpy's Mom]
Sometimes I wonder if
Torpy is too mature for
his age, or if my husband
is too immature. In a strange
way, those two really take
after each other. Oh, well...
scripts.translation:
[托尔皮的妈妈]
有时候我会想，
是托尔皮太成熟了，
还是我丈夫太幼稚了。
以某种奇怪的方式，
这两人真的很像。哦，算了...

scripts.text:
[Torpy's Mom]
When is that husband
of mine going to come
out of that barrel? He
didn't make another weird
bet with Torpy, did he? Oh,
the trouble with those two...
scripts.translation:
[托尔皮的妈妈]
我那个丈夫什么时候才能从桶里出来？
他是不是又跟托尔皮打赌了？
哦，这两人真让人头疼...

scripts.text:
[Torpy's Mom]
Where did he go this time?!
If my husband doesn't have
a good excuse for not coming
home, then he better come
up with one or he'll be sorry!
scripts.translation:
[托尔皮的妈妈]
他这次又去哪了？！
如果我丈夫没有正当理由不回家，
那他最好想出一个，否则他会后悔的！

scripts.text:
[Strange Man]
So... hun...gry...
F-food... Give me...
F-food... Must... replenish...
h-health... with... Steamed...
Crab... Nippers... Please...

^3355FFIt sounds like
this barrel wants
Steamed Crab Nippers.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF听起来这个桶想要蒸蟹螯。^000000

scripts.text: I'll bring you Steamed Crab Nippers
scripts.translation: 我会给你带蒸蟹螯

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text:
[Strange Man]
Please... cook me...
Steamed... Crab Nippers...!
You... n-need.... 10 Green
Herbs... 1 Yellow Potions...
and 10... N-Nippers... to
c-cook th-them. Ugh...
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的男子]
请...给我做...
蒸...蟹螯...！
你...需...需要...10个绿草...
1瓶黄色药水...
和10个...蟹螯...
来...烹饪。呃...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hold on,
I have to cook
them for you?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等一下，
我要为你烹饪它们？！

scripts.text:
[Strange Man]
Y-yes...
It's... It's the
o-only... possible...
Way... P-please help...
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的男子]
是...是的...
这是...这是唯一...
可能的...方法...请...请帮帮我...

scripts.text:
[Strange Man]
D-don't... leave...
me... Here... Th-the...
hunger...! It... It can't...
It c-can't be... d-denied!
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的男子]
别...别走...
留...我在这里...那...那...
饥饿...！它...它无法...
它...无法被...忽视！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Weirdo! Why don't you
get out of that barrel,
and get your Steamed
Crab Nippers yourself?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
怪人！你为什么不
从那个桶里出来，
自己去弄蒸蟹螯？！

scripts.text:
[Strange Man]
Th-that... tantalizing...
scent... It's S-Steamed...
Crab... Nippers... Oh God...
It's b-been so... l-long...
G-Give me! G-Give me now!
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的男子]
那...那...诱人的...
香味...是蒸...
蟹...螯...天哪...
已经...很久...
没...没吃了...
给...给我！现在...给我！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou dumped the
Steamed Crab Nippers
into the barrel where
it was quickly devoured.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你把蒸蟹螯倒进了桶里，
它很快就被吃光了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Strange Man]
Ha ha ha!
Back in the game, baby!
Man, it's been, about what,
3 days since I last ate?
It's good to be alive!
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的男子]
哈哈！
游戏继续，宝贝！
天哪，我大概
有3天没吃东西了？
活着真好！

scripts.text:
^3355FFFor now, you should
tell Torpy and his mom
where Torpy's father is
hiding so they won't
worry about him so much.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF现在，你应该告诉托尔皮和他的妈妈，托尔皮的父亲藏在哪里，这样他们就不会那么担心他了。

scripts.text:
^800080Torpy's mom might want to know about^000000
^800080this extraordinary barrel.^000000
^800080How long does Torpy's father plan to stay within the barrel?^000000
scripts.translation: ^800080托尔皮的父亲打算在桶里待多久？^000000

scripts.text:
^800080That barrel will become a symbolic object^000000
^800080that pays tribute to the firm will of Torpy's father^000000
^800080who is trying hard to avoid keeping the promise with his son to find his wife.^000000
scripts.translation:
^800080那个桶将成为一个象征物，^000000
^800080致敬托尔皮父亲坚定的意志，^000000
^800080他正努力避免履行与儿子寻找妻子的承诺。^000000

scripts.text:
^800080You hear something bustling from the hole in the barrel.^000000
^800080However, it doesn't seem to be a big deal.^000000
scripts.translation:
^800080你听到桶的洞里传来一阵骚动。^000000
^800080不过，这似乎没什么大事。^000000

scripts.text:
[Strange Man]
Ahhhh... Thanks for
the free meal! It was
so invigorating! Well,
I better climb back
inside that barrel. See
ya round, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的男子]
啊...谢谢你的
免费餐！真让人
精神焕发！好吧，
我得爬回那个桶里了。
再见，冒险者~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hold it!
Why are you hiding
inside that barrel?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等！
你为什么躲在
那个桶里？！

scripts.text:
[Strange Man]
Huh? Oh, I'm just
playing Hide-and-Seek
with my son, that's all.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的男子]
嗯？哦，我只是
在和我儿子玩捉迷藏，
仅此而已。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But you haven't
eaten in days! Wait,
hold on, you wouldn't
happen to be Torpy's
father now, would you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但你已经好几天
没吃东西了！等等，
你该不会是托尔皮的
父亲吧？

scripts.text:
[Strange Man]
Oh, you ran into my boy?
Has he given up on our
little wager yet? Because
I'd really hate to lose...
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的男子]
哦，你遇到我儿子了？
他放弃我们的小赌注了吗？
因为我真的不想输...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um, your wife and son
are really worried about
you. Shouldn't you be going
home as soon as you can?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，你的妻子和儿子
真的很担心你。
你不应该尽快回家吗？

scripts.text:
[Strange Man]
No, I can't! Not until
Torpy gives up! I made
a really silly promise
with my son, and if I lose
this game of Hide-and-Seek...
Well, I just can't lose! Bye!
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的男子]
不行，我不能！
除非托尔皮放弃！
我和儿子开了一个很傻的玩笑，
如果我输掉这场捉迷藏...
总之，我绝对不能输！再见！

scripts.text:
^3355FFTorpy's father has
hidden himself again,
but at least now you
can go back to Torpy's
Mom and Torpy, and let them
both know where he is hiding.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF托尔皮的父亲又躲起来了，
但至少现在你可以回到托尔皮
和他妈妈那里，
告诉他们他躲在哪里了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Strange Man]
Hahahaha!
Steamed Crab Nippers!
That really hit the spot!
I ate so much, I won't
have to eat again for days!
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的男子]
哈哈哈哈哈！
蒸蟹螯！
真是一绝！
我吃得太多，
好几天都不用再吃东西了！

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Hi there, thanks for
visiting our lovely town!
Why don't you come in and
have a taste of authentic
Hugel cuisine? I guarantee
that you won't regret it~
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
你好，感谢光临我们美丽的城镇！
何不进来尝尝正宗的毁葛美食呢？
我保证你不会后悔的~

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
My name is Cellette Lavit,
and I proudly serve Fish Cake
Soup, Hugel's specialty dish.
All the tourists that've tried
it have loved it, and I have
many regular customers~
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
我叫塞莱特·拉维特，
我很自豪地提供串汤，
这是毁葛的特色菜。
所有尝试过的游客都喜欢它，
而且我有很多常客~

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
This dish has something
of a cult following, and it's
not widely popularized, but I'm
sure that it'll be considered
representative of Schwarzwald
Republic cuisine someday.
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
这道菜拥有一群忠实的追随者，
虽然它还没有广泛流行，
但我相信总有一天，
它会被视为修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的代表美食。

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Listen, you look like an
able adventurer, so would
you consider working part time
for me? I have many orders for
Fish Cake Soup, so there's
no way I can make deliveries...
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
听着，你看起来像个能干的冒险者，
你愿意考虑为我做兼职吗？
我有很多串汤的订单，
所以我没办法亲自送货...

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
If you work for me, I'll
waive the price: I'll give you
1 Fish Cake Soup for each
delivery that you complete.
But if you're not interested,
you can just buy some now~
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
如果你为我工作，我会免除费用：
每完成一次送货，我就给你一碗串汤。
但如果你不感兴趣，
现在也可以直接买一些~

scripts.text: Sure, I'll work for you!
scripts.translation: 好的，我愿意为你工作！

scripts.text: I want to buy Fish Cake Soup.
scripts.translation: 我想买串汤。

scripts.text: See ya.
scripts.translation: 再见。

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Oh, thank you so much!
You can't imagine how busy
I've been, and how much I need the help! Now, let's get started~
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
哦，太感谢你了！
你无法想象我有多忙，
我多么需要你的帮助！
好了，让我们开始吧~

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Alright, please take this
order of Fish Cake Soup to
my friend Neha. I'm grateful
that she's a regular customer--
she's a good friend, but I'm sure that she loves the soup as well.
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
好的，请把这碗串汤
送到我的朋友内哈那里。
我很感激她是我的常客——
她是个好朋友，但我相信她也喜欢这汤。

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Right, take this next order
of Fish Cake Soup to Maewan,
another one of my regulars.
He's been buying my soup ever
since I helped him start his business. Nice of him, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
好的，把这碗串汤
送到梅万那里，
他也是我的常客之一。
自从我帮他创业以来，
他就一直买我的汤。他真好，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Okay, this order of Fish
Cake Soup is ready! Please
take it to my roommate Layoma.
But... Be careful. She's got
a thing about punctuality.
Just try not to be late...
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
好的，这碗串汤准备好了！
请送到我的室友拉约玛那里。
但是...小心点。她非常注重准时。
尽量别迟到...

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Quick, take this Fish
Paste Soup to Erjan. Um,
but be careful, he's really
nitpicky... And he likes to
have everything in such
and such and order...
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
快，把这碗鱼泥汤送到埃尔扬那里。
嗯，但是小心点，他真的很挑剔...
而且他喜欢把一切都按特定的顺序摆放...

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Oh, you'd like to try my
Fish Cake Soup, eh? Good
choice, I know you'll enjoy
its delicious, hearty flavor~
Each order costs 100 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
哦，你想尝尝我的串汤，是吗？
好选择，我知道你会喜欢它美味浓郁的风味的~
每碗100 Zeny。

scripts.text: Order a Fish Cake Soup
scripts.translation: 点一碗串汤

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Thanks! Enjoy your
bowl of Fish Cake Soup.
I hope you come and 
visit me again, okay?
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
谢谢！享用你的串汤吧。
希望你再来光顾，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Oh, what's this?
You don't have enough
money? Well, come back
after you save 100 zeny.
That's a really good price
for my gourmet soup, you know.
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
哦，这是什么？
你钱不够吗？
那等你攒够100 Zeny再来吧。
对于我这样的美食家做的汤来说，
这真的是很划算的价格，你知道吗。

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
If you're ever hungry,
or just want to enjoy
a delicious meal, come
and have some of my soup~
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
如果你饿了，
或者只是想享受一顿美味的大餐，
就来尝尝我的汤吧~

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Oh? You're not interested
in trying my Fish Cake Soup
at all? Well, if you change
your mind, please come
back. I just know you'll love
the taste if you give it a try.
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
哦？你完全不想尝尝我的串汤吗？
好吧，如果你改变主意了，请回来。
我相信只要你试一下，就会爱上它的味道。

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Haven't you left already?
My friend Neha is waiting
for you to deliver her order
of Fish Cake Soup. Please
try to get it to her before the
soup gets cold, okay?
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
你还没走吗？
我的朋友内哈正在等你送她的串汤订单。
请在汤变凉之前送到她那里，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
What's that? You lost
the Fish Cake Soup you're
supposed to deliver to Neha?
Oh well, I suppose I'll have
to give you this fresh bowl
of soup that I just made...
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
什么？你弄丢了应该送给内哈的串汤？
好吧，我想我得把这碗我刚做好的新鲜汤给你...

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
But you need to be
responsible and pay
me for the food you lost.
There, I took 100 zeny
from you. That's fair, so
please don't lose it this time.
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
但你得负责任，
为你弄丢的食物付钱。
看，我从你那里收了100 Zeny。
这很公平，所以这次别再弄丢了。

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
W-wait... You don't
have any money to pay
me for the soup you lost?
Well, I don't think I can
trust somebody like you
with any deliveries...
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
等...等等...你没钱付你弄丢的汤的钱？
嗯，我觉得我不能信任像你这样的人
去做任何配送...

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Whoa, whoa, whoa!
You should have left
already to deliver that
soup to Maewan! Hurry,
before it gets too cold!
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
哇，哇，哇！
你应该已经出发去给梅万送汤了！
快去吧，别让它太凉了！

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
What's that? You lost
the Fish Cake Soup you're
supposed to give to Maewan?
Oh well, I suppose I'll have
to give you this fresh bowl
of soup that I just made...
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
什么？你弄丢了应该送给梅万的串汤？
好吧，我想我得把这碗我刚做好的新鲜汤给你...

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
But you need to be
responsible and pay
me for the food you lost.
There, I took 100 zeny
from you. That's fair, so
please don't lose it this time.
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
但你得负责任，
为你弄丢的食物付钱。
看，我从你那里收了100 Zeny。
这很公平，所以这次别再弄丢了。

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
W-wait... You don't
have any money to pay
me for the soup you lost?
Well, I don't think I can
trust somebody like you
with any deliveries...
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
等...等等...你没钱付你弄丢的汤的钱？
嗯，我觉得我不能信任像你这样的人
去做任何配送...

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
I thought you left to
deliver that soup to
Layoma. You should hurry
and bring it to her, before
it doesn't taste good after
it gets cold, you know.
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
我以为你出发去给拉约玛送汤了。
你应该赶紧送给她，
你知道的，汤凉了就不好喝了。

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
What's that? You lost
the Fish Cake Soup you're
supposed to give to Layoma?
Oh well, I suppose I'll have
to give you this fresh bowl
of soup that I just made...
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
什么？你弄丢了应该送给拉约玛的串汤？
好吧，我想我得把这碗我刚做好的新鲜汤给你...

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
But you need to be
responsible and pay
me for the food you lost.
There, I took 100 zeny
from you. That's fair, so
please don't lose it this time.
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
但你得负责任，
为你弄丢的食物付钱。
看，我从你那里收了100 Zeny。
这很公平，所以这次别再弄丢了。

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
W-wait... You don't
have any money to pay
me for the soup you lost?
Well, I don't think I can
trust somebody like you
with any deliveries...
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
等...等等...你没钱付你弄丢的汤的钱？
嗯，我觉得我不能信任像你这样的人
去做任何配送...

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Oh, dear, you better
leave now and deliver
that Fish Cake Soup to
Erjan before he can think
of something to complain about. Although it's probably too late...
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
哎呀，抱歉，
我不能和一个被证明不负责任的人做生意。
这不是针对你个人，只是我的规定。

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
What's that? You lost
the Fish Cake Soup you're
supposed to deliver to Erjan?
Oh well, I suppose I'll have
to give you this fresh bowl
of soup that I just made...
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
什么？你弄丢了应该送给埃尔扬的串汤？
好吧，我想我得把这碗我刚做好的新鲜汤给你...

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
But you need to be
responsible and pay
me for the food you lost.
There, I took 100 zeny
from you. That's fair, so
please don't lose it this time.
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
但你得负责任，
为你弄丢的食物付钱。
看，我从你那里收了100 Zeny。
这很公平，所以这次别再弄丢了。

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
W-wait... You don't
have any money to pay
me for the soup you lost?
Well, I don't think I can
trust somebody like you
with any deliveries...
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
等...等等...你没钱付你弄丢的汤的钱？
嗯，我觉得我不能信任像你这样的人
去做任何配送...

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Ah, I'm sorry, but
I can't do any business
with somebody that's proven
to be irresponsible. Nothing
personal, it's just my policy.
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
干得好！我听说你成功送出了汤。
我就知道我可以信任你！啊，差点忘了，
这是你的串汤。非常感谢你的帮助~

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Good work! I hear that
you successfully delivered
the soup. I knew I could trust
you! Ah, before I forget, here
is your Fish Cake Soup. Thank
you so much for your help~
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
和你合作真的很愉快，
希望你有空再来帮我。
哦，还有，请告诉所有朋友
我美味的串汤。回头见~

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
It was really nice working
with you, and I hope you come
by and help me again sometime.
Oh, and please tell all your
friends about my delicious
Fish Cake Soup. See you later~
scripts.translation:
[塞莱特]
来尝尝正宗的毁葛料理吧！
享用一大碗热气腾腾的美味串汤~

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Come and taste some
authentic Hugel cuisine!
Enjoy a big steaming bowl
of delicious Fish Cake Soup~
scripts.translation:
[内哈]
哦，你有塞莱特的送货，嗯？哼！
你迟到了！你不知道这汤不热的话就不好吃吗？

scripts.text:
[Neha]
Oh, you have a delivery
from Cellette, hm? Hmpf!
You're late! Don't you know
this soup isn't good if it
isn't steaming hot?
scripts.translation:
[内哈]
哦，你是来送塞莱特的汤的，是吗？哼！
你迟到了！难道你不知道汤不趁热喝就不好喝吗？

scripts.text:
[Neha]
But... You're a handsome
fellow, so I'll forgive you...
On one condition. Bring me
^FF00001 Whip^000000 with which to spank 
you. You better hurry, boy, or
I won't let you off that easy.
scripts.translation:
[内哈]
是的，是的...你应该受罚。
你应该被抽打。如果你想完成你的送货，
那就给我带^FF00001根鞭子^000000来，让我抽你
以惩罚你的无礼，女孩！

scripts.text:
[Neha]
Yes, yes... You should
be punished. You should be
spanked. If you want to finish
your delivery, then bring me
^FF00001 Whip^000000 so that I can spank you
for your impertinence, girl!
scripts.translation:
[内哈]
是是是...你应该受到惩罚。
应该被打屁股才对。如果你想完成这次配送，
那就给我^FF00001根鞭子^000000，好让我惩罚你的无礼，女孩！

scripts.text:
[Neha]
Oh ho ho ho ho ho~
I just love cute little boys...
But for some reason, it
thrills me to torture them
a little bit as well. Hoho~
scripts.translation:
[内哈]
哦呵呵呵呵呵~
我最喜欢可爱的小男孩了...
不过不知为何，稍微折磨他们一下
也让我很兴奋呢。呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Neha]
Finally... My soup!
And you brought me my Whip!
Don't worry, I'll only give you
just one hard spanking. It'll
be over before you know it~
scripts.translation:
[内哈]
终于...我的汤来了！
你还给我带了鞭子！
别担心，我只会狠狠打你一巴掌。
眨眼间就结束了~

scripts.text:
[Neha]
Ha!
scripts.translation:
[内哈]
哈！

scripts.text:
[Neha]
Heeyah!!
scripts.translation:
[内哈]
嘿呀！！

scripts.text:
[Neha]
Ooh, did I accidentally
whip you twice? Heh heh...
Well, I'm satisfied. I'll go
ahead and tell Celette that
you did a good job... I hope
you come deliver my soup again~
scripts.translation:
[内哈]
噢，我是不是不小心抽了你两下？嘿嘿...
算了，我很满意。我会告诉塞莱特你做得不错...
希望下次还能收到你送的汤~

scripts.text:
[Neha]
^FF00001 Fish Cake Soup^000000...
^FF00001 Whip^000000... Is that too
much for a girl to ask?
I'm hungry, and I want to
hit somebody! What's wrong
with that, huh? Now hurry up!
scripts.translation:
[内哈]
^FF00001串汤^000000...
还有^FF00001鞭子^000000...这对一个女孩来说要求过分吗？
我饿了，而且我想揍人！这有什么不对吗？快点！

scripts.text:
[Neha]
Oh ho ho ho ho ho~
I just love cute little boys...
But for some reason, it
thrills me to torture them
a little bit as well. Hoho~
scripts.translation:
[内哈]
哦呵呵呵呵呵~
我最喜欢可爱的小男孩了...
不过不知为何，稍微折磨他们一下
也让我很兴奋呢。呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Maewan]
Oh, finally, I've been
waiting for my order of
Fish Cake Soup from Cellette!
Aaaah, it smells oh so delicious~
scripts.translation:
[梅万]
噢，终于来了，我订的塞莱特的串汤！
啊，闻起来好香~

scripts.text:
[Maewan]
Argh, but you're late!
This is your fault, you
know that, right? Well,
it's not a big deal, but
I can forgive you if you
help me with my collection.
scripts.translation:
[梅万]
啊，你迟到了！
你知道这是你的错吗？好吧，
虽然不是什么大事，但如果你能帮我收集东西，
我就原谅你。

scripts.text:
[Maewan]
Just bring me
1 Bookclip in Memory,
alright? Oh, and don't
eat my soup before
you deliver it to me!
scripts.translation:
[梅万]
给我带1个回忆书签，
好吗？哦，还有，
在送给我之前别偷喝我的汤！

scripts.text:
[Maewan]
I like to think of
myself as a man of
eclectic taste. I love
collecting strange and
unique items, and learning
all sorts of new things~
scripts.translation:
[梅万]
我觉得自己是个品味广泛的人。我喜欢收集
奇怪又独特的物品，也喜欢学习各种新知识~

scripts.text:
[Maewan]
Great, you really brought
me a Bookclip in Memory!
Yes, this'll make a fine
addition to my collection~
Oh, and give me my soup.
Thanks again for delivering~
scripts.translation:
[梅万]
太好了，你真的给我带了回忆书签！
是的，这将是我收藏中很棒的补充~
哦，还有，把我的汤给我。
再次感谢你的配送~

scripts.text:
[Maewan]
I know it sounds unfair
of me to ask you to bring
^FF00001 Bookclip in Memory^000000 with
my ^FF0000Fish Cake Soup^000000, but well...
scripts.translation:
[梅万]
我知道让你在我的^FF0000串汤^000000之外
再带^FF00001回忆书签^000000听起来有点不公平，但是...

scripts.text:
[Maewan]
I'd feel left out if
I didn't do it. I know
all of Cellette's other
customers are asking the
people delivering their soup
for all sorts of crazy things.
scripts.translation:
[梅万]
如果我不这么做，我会觉得自己被落下了。我知道
塞莱特的其他顾客都在让送汤的人
带各种奇怪的东西。

scripts.text:
[Maewan]
I like to think of
myself as a man of
eclectic taste. I love
collecting strange and
unique items, and learning
all sorts of new things~
scripts.translation:
[梅万]
我觉得自己是个品味广泛的人。我喜欢收集
奇怪又独特的物品，也喜欢学习各种新知识~

scripts.text:
[Layoma]
You're here to deliver
my Fish Cake Soup?
How could you be so late?!
Don't you know that your
incompetence also reflects
on Cellette and her shop?!
scripts.translation:
[拉约玛]
你是来送我的串汤的？
你怎么能这么晚？！
难道你不知道你的无能也会
反映在塞莱特和她的店铺上吗？！

scripts.text:
[Layoma]
I can't let you continue
delivering for Cellette
unless you prove that you're
dependable to me. Erm, bring
me ^FF00001 Mushroom Spore^000000, and
I'll forget this whole thing.
scripts.translation:
[拉约玛]
除非你向我证明你是可靠的，否则我不能让你
继续为塞莱特送汤。嗯，给我带
^FF00001香菇芽孢^000000，我就当这件事没发生过。

scripts.text:
[Layoma]
I love singing songs,
and I love eating mushrooms.
For a person living in Hugel,
that's a pretty exciting life!
scripts.translation:
[拉约玛]
我喜欢唱歌，也喜欢吃蘑菇。
对于一个住在毁葛的人来说，
这算是相当充实的生活了！

scripts.text:
[Layoma]
Great! You brought me
1 Mushroom Spore! This
will taste perfect with my
bowl of Fish Cake Soup~
scripts.translation:
[拉约玛]
太好了！你给了我1个香菇芽孢！
这搭配我的串汤味道一定很棒~

scripts.text:
[Layoma]
Alright, maybe I can
count on you to work
for my roommate Cellette
a little while longer. Oh, and
please tell her to not to come home so late all the time, okay?
scripts.translation:
[拉约玛]
好吧，也许我可以让你再为我的室友塞莱特
工作一段时间。哦，还有，
请告诉她不要总是这么晚回家，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Layoma]
Hey! I thought you
wanted to prove that
you're a reliable and
trustworthy person! Go
and bring me 1 Mushroom
Spore with my Fish Cake Soup!
scripts.translation:
[拉约玛]
嘿！我以为你想证明
你是一个可靠且值得信赖的人！
去给我带1个香菇芽孢
和我的串汤一起过来！

scripts.text:
[Layoma]
I love singing songs,
and I love eating mushrooms.
For a person living in Hugel,
that's a pretty exciting life!
scripts.translation:
[拉约玛]
我喜欢唱歌，也喜欢吃蘑菇。
对于一个住在毁葛的人来说，
这算是相当充实的生活了！

scripts.text:
[Erjan]
Well, I thought you'd
never come to deliver
my Fish Cake Soup. You're
awfully late, you know that?
Still, the smell is just so appetizing, I can barely resist...
scripts.translation:
[埃尔扬]
我还以为你永远不会
把我的串汤送过来呢。
你来得可真够晚的，知道吗？
不过，这香味真是诱人，
我几乎忍不住要吃了...

scripts.text:
[Erjan]
Hm, but as the first son
of the Franchefeschu family,
I cannot eat this soup unless
it is suitably prepared. Go!
I command you to bring me
the commoner's ^FF0000China^000000!
scripts.translation:
[埃尔扬]
嗯，但作为法兰切·费舒家族
的长子，如果餐具不体面，
我是不会喝这碗汤的。去吧！
我命令你去给我拿
平民用的^FF0000瓷器^000000来！

scripts.text:
[Erjan]
Realize that I'm compromising
with you by asking you to bring
me regular China... I always
enjoy my meals on the finest
glass and tableware available.
That's how we noblemen live~
scripts.translation:
[埃尔扬]
你要知道，我让你拿普通的
瓷器，这已经是对你的一种
妥协了。我向来只使用
最精美的玻璃器皿和餐具
用餐。这才是贵族的生活~

scripts.text:
[Erjan]
I am Erjan, first son of
the noble Franchefeschu
family. Commoner, if you
do not have any business
with me, then leave me be,
and do whatever it is you do.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔扬]
我是埃尔扬，高贵的
法兰切·费舒家族的长子。
平民，如果你没有正事，
就请离开，去做你该做的事吧。

scripts.text:
[Erjan]
Ah, so you've delivered
my Fish Cake Soup with some
proper China. Yes, this pleases
me. Now, I may enjoy this meal
in a manner befitting the
Franchefeschu family.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔扬]
啊，看来你终于把
配有合适瓷器的串汤送来了。
很好，这让我很满意。
现在，我可以以符合
法兰切·费舒家族身份的方式
享用这顿饭了。

scripts.text:
[Erjan]
Although this China is
below my standards, I also
understand that this is the
best you can do. Yes, to accept
this is my... noblesse oblige.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔扬]
虽然这瓷器
低于我的标准，
但我也理解这已经是
你能做到的极限了。
是的，接受它，是我的...
贵族义务。

scripts.text:
[Erjan]
You are dismissed.
Please take your leave,
and return to Cellette
with my noble thanks.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔扬]
你可以退下了。
请离开，并替我
向塞莱特转达
我高贵的谢意。

scripts.text:
[Erjan]
Must I repeat myself?
Bring me my ^FF0000Fish Cake Soup^000000
with ^FF00001 China^000000 so that I may
properly enjoy my meal.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔扬]
需要我再说一遍吗？
把我的^FF0000串汤^000000和
^FF00001个瓷器^000000拿来，
这样我才能好好享用这顿饭。

scripts.text:
[Erjan]
I am Erjan, first son of
the noble Franchefeschu
family. Commoner, if you
do not have any business
with me, then leave me be,
and do whatever it is you do.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔扬]
我是埃尔扬，高贵的
法兰切·费舒家族的长子。
平民，如果你没有正事，
就请离开，去做你该做的事吧。

^333333*Cough*^000000 name is Euslan,

I'm starting to worry since
I haven't heard from him in
days. I really want to go out
and find him on my own. ^333333*Cough*^000000
scripts.translation:

我一直在这里等我的未婚夫回来，
但好几天没收到他的消息，
我开始担心了。我真的很想
自己出去找他。 ^333333*咳*^000000

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
I really want to see my
Thierry. If only I wasn't
so sick, then I wouldn't have
these problems. ^333333*Sob*^000000 Where

scripts.translation:

我真的好想见我的

Thierry... ^333333*Sob*^000000
When are you

[Euslan]

for a needle in a haystack,
but the only way I can think
of finding Thierry is to ask
the Airship Crewmen if they
might know where my fiancee is.
scripts.translation:

我知道这就像大海捞针，

就是问问飞空艇的船员，
看他们是否知道我的未婚夫在哪里。

scripts.text:

searching the Schwarzwald
Republic, so maybe the crewmen

[尤斯兰]
^333333*咳*^000000 对了，蒂埃里
为了给我找医生说的
治疗我病情的药，
乘飞空艇出发了。 ^333333*咳咳*^000000

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
I know it's like searching
for a needle in a haystack,
but the only way I can think
of finding Thierry is to ask
the Airship Crewmen if they
might know where my fiancee is.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
我知道这就像大海捞针，
但我能想到的唯一找到蒂埃里的方法，
就是问问飞空艇的船员，
看他们是否知道我的未婚夫在哪里。

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
^333333*Cough*^000000 Oh, right...
My fiancee was planning on
searching the Schwarzwald
Republic, so maybe the crewmen
on the Schwarzwald Republic domestic flights might know him.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
^333333*咳*^000000 哦，对了...
我的未婚夫计划去
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国，
所以也许修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德国内航线的
船员会认识他。

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
If you manage to find
where Thierry might have
gone, then please let me
know as soon as you can,
okay? Thanks for cheering
me up, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
如果你能找到蒂埃里
可能去的地方，
请尽快告诉我，好吗？
谢谢你让我振作起来，{0}。

scripts.text:
^333333Euslan is still patiently
waiting for Thierry's return.
You should keep your promise
to her by asking the crewmen on
the Schwaltvalt Republic domestic flights about Euslan's fiancee.^000000
scripts.translation:
^333333尤斯兰仍在耐心地
等待蒂埃里回来。
你应该信守承诺，
去询问修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德国内航线的船员
关于尤斯兰未婚夫的事。^000000

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
Oh, you're back!
^333333*Cough*^000000 Maybe it's too
much to hope for, but did
you learn anything about
where my fiancee might be?
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
哦，你回来了！
^333333*咳*^000000 也许是我
奢望了，但你有没有
打听到我未婚夫
可能在哪儿？

scripts.text: Well, I met Kaci on the Airship.
scripts.translation: 我在飞空艇上遇到了凯西。

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
Oh, Kaci works on the
Airship? It's been so long
since I've seen her. I guess
we've lost touch ever since
I've gotten sick... Still, I'm
glad to have heard from her.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
哦，凯西在飞空艇上工作？
好久没见她了。我想
自从我生病后就
失去联系了... 不过，
能听到她的消息真好。

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
Oh, how fortunate! So Kaci
knows where Thierry might be?
^333333*Cough*^000000 Ah, he went to Hugel.
I have a brother that lives
there, though it's been a while
since I've heard from him...
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
哦，真幸运！那凯西
知道蒂埃里可能在哪儿？
^333333*咳*^000000 啊，他去了毁葛。
我有个哥哥住在那里，
虽然好久没联系他了...

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
Um, if you don't mind, would
you please do another favor
for me? If you travel to Hugel,
would you find Thierry and tell
that I'm alright? He must be
so worried about he by now...
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
那个，如果不麻烦的话，
能再帮我一个忙吗？如果你去毁葛，
请找到蒂埃里，告诉他我很好。
他现在一定很担心我...

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
^333333*Cough Cough*^000000 It might
be a good idea to ask my
brother Eukran, who's working
as a Bingo game coordinator
in Hugel, since he might know
where Thierry is. ^333333*Cough*^000000
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
^333333*咳咳*^000000 也许可以问问
我的哥哥尤克兰，他在毁葛
担任宾果游戏协调员，
他可能知道蒂埃里在哪里。 ^333333*咳*^000000

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
I know that it's a lot
to ask, so please don't
trouble yourself if it's out
of your way. Still, I'd really
appreciate your help if you
happen to pass through Hugel.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
我知道这要求有点多，
如果太麻烦就别费心了。
不过，如果你正好经过毁葛，
我会非常感激你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
If you get the chance,
please visit my brother
Eukran in Hugel, and ask
him where my Thierry might be.
Thank you again for your kindness.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
如果有机会，
请去毁葛拜访我的哥哥尤克兰，
问问他我的蒂埃里可能在哪儿。
再次感谢你的好意。

scripts.text:
^3355FFEuslan is waiting for
you to bring her news from
her fiancee Thierry. You better
go back to Hugel to find him.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF尤斯兰在等你
带回来关于未婚夫蒂埃里的消息。
你最好回毁葛去找他。

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
Oh, you've returned!
^333333*Cough*^000000 Were you able to
speak to my brother and
find my fiancee Thierry?
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
哦，你回来了！
^333333*咳*^000000 你见到我哥哥了吗？
找到我的未婚夫蒂埃里了吗？

scripts.text:
^333333You tell Euslan that you
were able to find Thierry,
and that he has managed to
procure some medicine for
her. You give Euslan the
medicine as Thierry requested.^000000
scripts.translation:
^333333你告诉尤斯兰，
你找到了蒂埃里，
而且他设法为她
弄到了药。你按照蒂埃里的要求
把药交给了尤斯兰。^000000

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
*Sniff* I don't deserve
such a wonderful man. Why
did that silly fool go through
so much trouble for a useless
woman like me. *Cough* I still don't understand it... I don't...
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
*吸鼻子* 我不配拥有这么优秀的男人。
那个傻瓜为什么要为一个像我这样没用的人
费这么大的劲呢。*咳嗽* 我还是不明白... 我不...

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
Thank you so much for
your help, adventurer, and
for bringing me this medicine.
I'll be waiting for Thierry to
come back home, and do my
best to get better. ^333333*Cough*^000000
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
非常感谢你的帮助，冒险者，
还有你为我带来的药。
我会等蒂埃里回家的，
并尽我所能好起来。^333333*咳嗽*^000000

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
{0}...
I'll never forget what
you've done for Thierry and
me. I'll always be praying for
your safety in your adventures.
Take care of yourself...
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
{0}...
我永远不会忘记你为蒂埃里和我所做的一切。
我会一直为你在冒险中的平安祈祷。
请保重...

scripts.text:
^3355FFEuslan is still waiting
for her fiancee to return
home, but she appears
much more relieved and
relaxed than she used to be.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF尤斯兰仍在等待未婚夫回家，
但她看起来比之前
更加安心和放松了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Arcade Owner]
Welcome to the
Bingo Game Arcade.
Would you like to
play a game?
scripts.translation:
[游戏厅老板]
欢迎来到宾果游戏厅。
你想玩一局吗？

scripts.text: I want to meet the game coordinator.
scripts.translation: 我想见见游戏协调员。

scripts.text:
[Arcade Owner]
I'm sorry, but if he's on
duty, we can't really let you
meet him unless you come
here to play a game. Our
game coordinators tend
to be pretty busy...
scripts.translation:
[游戏厅老板]
很抱歉，如果他在值班，
除非你来玩游戏，否则我们真的
不能让你见他。我们的
游戏协调员通常都很忙...

scripts.text:
[Eukran]
Oh, weren't you just
in the bingo room?
I hope you enjoyed
the game. Now, can
I help you with anything?
scripts.translation:
[尤克兰]
哦，你刚才不是
在宾果游戏室吗？
希望你玩得开心。那么，
有什么我可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: Talk about Euslan
scripts.translation: 谈谈尤斯兰

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou tell Eukran about his
sister's illness, and that
she has sent you to search
for her fiancee Thierry.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你告诉尤克兰他妹妹的病情，
以及她派你去寻找
她的未婚夫蒂埃里。^000000

scripts.text:
[Eukran]
*Sob* I had no idea
that my sister Euslan
was so sick! No wonder
Thierry looked so depressed
the last time I saw him. Why
didn't he tell me anything?
scripts.translation:
[尤克兰]
*抽泣* 我完全不知道
我妹妹尤斯兰病得这么重！
难怪上次见到蒂埃里时
他看起来那么沮丧。他为什么
什么都不告诉我？

scripts.text:
[Eukran]
You see, Thierry passed by
here about a month ago, and
told me that he had to visit
the Odin Shrine. I wasn't
sure then, but now I think
he's trying to help my sister.
scripts.translation:
[尤克兰]
你看，蒂埃里大约一个月前
路过这里，
告诉我他必须去拜访奥丁神龛。
当时我不太确定，但现在我觉得
他是在试图帮助我妹妹。

scripts.text:
[Eukran]
There must be something
there that can help my
sister recover. Why else
would Thierry go to such a
dangerous place? No one goes to the Odin Shrine for no reason.
scripts.translation:
[尤克兰]
那里一定有什么
能帮助我妹妹康复的东西。
否则蒂埃里为什么要去
那么危险的地方？没有人会无缘无故
去奥丁神龛的。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou can hear two
people talking to
each other a short
distance away.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你能听到不远处
两个人在交谈。^000000

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
You sure your research
is progressing? I haven't
seen anything that even
resembles real results!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
你确定你的研究
有进展吗？我还没看到
任何像样的结果！

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
I'm telling you, this isn't
like the last project. There's
no other way around it, it's
going to take some time.
You just have to be patient...
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
我告诉你，这不像
上一个项目。没有其他捷径，
这需要一些时间。
你只能耐心等待...

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Fine. That's fine by me.
But what about your fiancee?
I know she's near death's door:
can you really afford to wait
this long? Think about it.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
好吧。这对我没问题。
但你的未婚妻呢？
我知道她命悬一线：
你真的能等这么久吗？想想吧。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Just finish this as
soon as you can. For
your fiancee's sake.
And your own sake.
Catch my meaning?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
尽快完成它。
为了你的未婚妻。
也为了你自己。
明白我的意思吗？

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
...I understand.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
...我明白了。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou hear the sound of
footsteps steadily becoming
fainter and fainter. One of the
men must be walking away.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你听到脚步声逐渐变得微弱，
其中一个人正走远了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Hm? Oh, an adventurer.
There's more and more
of you coming to visit this
Odin Shrine nowadays.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
嗯？哦，是位冒险者。
最近来这座奥丁神龛参观的
人越来越多了。

scripts.text: Mr. Thierry?
scripts.translation: 蒂埃里先生？

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
...?!
H-how do you
know my name?
Do I know you
from somewhere?
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃里]
...？！
你...你怎么知道我的名字？
我认识你吗？

scripts.text: Tell him about Euslan
scripts.translation: 告诉他尤斯兰的事

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
Oh, Euslan sent you to me?
I'm so sorry that you had to
go through so much trouble.
Still, I'm glad to hear from her. Please let her know that I'm
coming home soon, would you?
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃里]
哦，是尤斯兰派你来的？
真抱歉让你费心了。
不过听到她的消息我很高兴。
请告诉她我很快就回家，好吗？

scripts.text: What are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 你来这里做什么？

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
Well, um, I'm sorry.
I can't really go into the
details, but I'm doing this
work to find a cure for
Euslan's disease. It's not
curable by modern medicine...
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃里]
嗯，抱歉。
我不能透露太多细节，
但我做这份工作是为了寻找
尤斯兰疾病的治愈方法。
现代医学无法治愈它...

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
I can't tell you more
than that. Please just
trust me on this. In the
meantime, would you tell
Euslan that I should be
coming home very soon?
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃里]
我无法告诉你更多。
请相信我。在此期间，
你能告诉尤斯兰我很快就会
回家吗？

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
Oh, I thought you
already left Odin Shrine.
You don't have anything 
else to tell me, do you?
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃里]
哦，我以为你已经离开
奥丁神龛了。
你没有什么别的事要告诉我
吧？

scripts.text: Warn Thierry about Suspicious Men
scripts.translation: 警告蒂埃里关于可疑男子

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
What?! It's just what
I thought! They were just
using me this whole time...!
Still, I can't leave this
place just yet... I can't...
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃里]
什么？！正是我想的！
他们一直在利用我...！
但我现在还不能离开这里... 我不能...

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
I guess it all started when
Euslan contracted that weird
disease. None of the doctors
knew what it was, none of them
could do anything about it.
It was totally devastating...
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃里]
我想一切始于尤斯兰
患上那种奇怪的疾病。
医生们都不知道那是什么，
谁也没办法。
那真是毁灭性的打击...

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
Finally, I took her to see
Mawong, who told us that he
actually met someone that had
that disease, and that there
was a way for me to cure it.
I had to take my chances...
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃里]
最后，我带她去找了毛翁，
他说他遇到过患有这种病的人，
并且有办法治愈它。
我只能赌一把...

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
Mawong told me that the cure
was somewhere near the Odin
Shrine in Hugel. As you already
know, this place is incredibly
dangerous. But I don't care.
I'll do anything for Euslan.
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃里]
毛翁告诉我，治愈方法
在毁葛的奥丁神龛附近。
如你所知，这个地方极其危险。
但我不在乎。
为了尤斯兰，我什么都愿意做。

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
Of course, I only told Euslan
that I'd be looking around the
Schwarzwald Republic... If she
knew I was at the Odin Shrine,
she'd worry too much about me.
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃里]
当然，我只告诉尤斯兰
我在修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国
附近寻找... 如果她知道我在
奥丁神龛，她会过度担心我。

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
Once I got here, I didn't
know what to do, or what I was
even looking for. Then, I ran
into these strange men, and
told them my story out of my
frustration over my situation.
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃里]
来到这里后，我不知道该做什么，
甚至不知道我在找什么。
然后，我遇到了那些奇怪的男子，
出于对处境的沮丧，我告诉了他们我的故事。

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
It seemed like a miracle
when they said that they knew
how to cure Euslan. They told
me that they were a research
team working on a project
related to my dilemna.
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃里]
当他们说知道如何治愈尤斯兰时，
这似乎是个奇迹。他们告诉我
他们是一个研究团队，正在从事
与我的困境相关的项目。

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
I didn't even think twice
about it: I immediately
accepted their offer to
join them. I did whatever
research they asked while
I searched for Euslan's cure...
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃里]
我甚至没有多想：我立即
接受了他们的邀请加入他们。
我做了他们要求的所有研究，
同时寻找尤斯兰的治愈方法...

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
Later, I overheard them
talking, and I learned that
they were really Rekenber
Corporation agents. Their
project had nothing to do
with medicine or my Euslan...
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃里]
后来，我偷听到他们的谈话，
发现他们其实是雷肯贝尔公司的
特工。他们的项目与医学或我的
尤斯兰毫无关系...

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
Their true goal is to improve
their guardian technology by
finding the remains of some
giant beneath the Odin Shrine.
Still, working with them gave
me access to so many resources.
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃里]
他们的真正目标是通过寻找
奥丁神龛下某个巨人的遗骸来
改进他们的守卫技术。
尽管如此，与他们合作让我
获得了大量资源。

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
I've actually been able to
find a cure for Euslan's
illness through my research
with those men, so I can't
quit now. I still need to make
that medicine for Euslan!
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃里]
实际上，通过与那些人的研究，
我已经找到了尤斯兰疾病的治愈方法，
所以我不能现在放弃。
我仍然需要为尤斯兰制作那种药！

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
So, behind their backs, I've
been using their guardians to
gather the ingredients needed
for my fiancee's medicine. But
if they're planning to get rid of me, I've just run out of time.
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃里]
所以，在他们背后，我一直在利用他们的守卫
来收集我未婚妻药物所需的材料。
但如果他们打算除掉我，
我的时间已经不多了。

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
It doesn't matter what
happens to me, but I must
save Euslan. I only need
^FF00005 Runes of the Darkness^000000 to
finish that medicine. Please
help me get them, adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃里]
无论发生什么，我都必须拯救尤斯兰。
我只需要^FF00005个黑暗符文^000000
来完成那种药。
请帮我拿到它们，冒险者...

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
You're the only one I can
trust to save Euslan. In the
meantime, I'll be hiding from
those men right over here.
If they get me, I'll never be
able to make the medicine!
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃里]
你是唯一能让我信任去拯救尤斯兰的人。
在此期间，我会躲在这里，
避开那些男人。
如果他们抓到我，我就永远无法制作那种药了！

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
I understand that gathering
materials here in the Odin
Shrine is difficult, but try to
get me ^3355FF5 Runes of the Darkness^000000
as soon as you can. My Euslan
really needs that medicine...
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃里]
我理解在奥丁神龛这里收集材料很困难，
但请尽量快一点给我^3355FF5个黑暗符文^000000。
我的尤斯兰真的很需要那种药...

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
Oh! You really brought me
the Runes of the Darkness!
I can finally make the medicine
that will save my dear Euslan.
I... I can't thank you enough
for this. I'm so happy...
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃里]
哦！你真的给我带来了黑暗符文！
我终于可以制作拯救我亲爱的尤斯兰的药了。
我...我感激不尽。
我太高兴了...

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
Please give me a moment:
I want to make this right
away. Let's see, ah, here
are my research notes...
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃里]
请给我一点时间：
我想马上制作。让我看看，啊，
这是我的研究日志...

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
It's finally done. This
medicine will cure Euslan.
If you'd do one last thing
for me, please bring this to
her. I've got to sneak away
later after things calm down.
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃里]
终于完成了。这种药能治愈尤斯兰。
如果你能再帮我最后一件事，
请把这个带给她。
等事情平息后，我必须偷偷离开。

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
Please understand that
I want to see her as soon
as I can, but I have to wait
until those Rekenber agents
stop searching for me. And let
Eslan know I'll come home soon.
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃里]
请理解，我想尽快见到她，
但我必须等到那些雷肯贝尔特工
停止寻找我。并告诉尤斯兰
我会很快回家。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received the
medicine that Thierry
has made to give to Euslan.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你收到了蒂埃里制作的
给尤斯兰的药。^000000

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
Please give that
medicine to Euslan as
soon as you can: her life
depends on it. Please let
her know that I'm coming
home as soon as I can.
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃里]
请尽快把那种药给尤斯兰：
她的生命取决于它。请告诉她
我会尽快回家。

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
I'm sorry, Euslan...
Please just wait for
me a little while longer.
I swear I'll come home to you!
scripts.translation:
[研究员]
对不起，尤斯兰...
请再等我一会儿。
我发誓我会回家找你！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou hear the voice of
the suspicious man that
was speaking to Thierry
a little while ago. You
carefully listen to what
he is saying...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你听到了刚才与蒂埃里说话的那个
可疑男子的声音。你仔细倾听
他在说什么...^000000

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Thierry seems to have
caught on to what we're
really up to. I think that's why he's slowing down on his
research. We better get rid
of him before it's too late.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
蒂埃里似乎已经察觉到我们
真正在做什么。我想这就是他
研究进度变慢的原因。我们最好在
为时已晚之前除掉他。

scripts.text:
[Very Suspicious Man]
Sure. Just let me
know when you
want him dead.
Then I'll kill him.
No problem.
scripts.translation:
[非常可疑的男子]
当然。只要告诉我
你想让他死的时候。
然后我会杀了他。
没问题。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis isn't good!
Thierry's in danger, so
you better go tell him
about this right now!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF情况不妙！
蒂埃里处于危险之中，所以你最好
马上告诉他这件事！^000000

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Could Burupu be hiding
from me again? He's been
wanting to ditch work more
and more ever since he wanted
to become a Swordman. If only
I could hire someone else...
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
布鲁普是不是又在躲着我？
自从他想成为剑士以来，
他就越来越想逃避工作。要是
我能雇到别人就好了...

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Unfortunately, he's the
only one I can find that
can actually milk my cow,
Booboo! If you can find
Burupu for me, I'll be sure
to pay you for your effort.
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
不幸的是，他是唯一能
给我的奶牛布布挤奶的人。
如果你能帮我找到布鲁普，
我一定会为你的努力支付报酬。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙。

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Thank you, you're a
lifesaver! I need to get the
milk delivered by tomorrow,
so I really need Burupu back!
You should be able to find him
somewhere just outside of town.
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
谢谢你，你真是救星！我需要
在明天之前把牛奶送出去，
所以我真的很需要布鲁普回来！
你应该能在镇外找到他。

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
N-no...!
If I can't find
Burupu, then there's no
way I'd be able to deliver
the milk orders by tomorrow!
Great, what am I gonna do?
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
不...！
如果我找不到布鲁普，
我就无法在明天之前交付牛奶订单！
天哪，我该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Burupu, I need you
to come to work! Maybe
you can find him practicing
with his sword right outside
of town. I hope you can find
that lazy guy for me...
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
布鲁普，我需要你来上班！
也许你能在镇外找到他，
他可能正在那里练习剑术。
希望你能帮我找到那个懒鬼...

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Burupu is making demands?!
I guess I don't have a choice.
You wouldn't happen to know
how much Rapiers cost, do you?
Why does Burupu want to become
a Swordman so much, huh?
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
布鲁普竟然提要求了？！
看来我别无选择。
你知道刺剑要多少钱吗？
布鲁普为什么那么想成为剑士呢？

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Oh, you're going to
help me milk the cow?
Great, great, thanks so
much! Please milk Booboo
right away, and get me
some delicious milk~
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
哦，你要帮我给奶牛挤奶？
太好了，太感谢了！
请立刻给布布挤奶，
给我弄些美味的牛奶~

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Hmm, how about this?
If you can actually milk
Booboo the cow, then I'll
give you some food. Does
that sound fair? Anyway,
please get to work soon~
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
嗯，这样如何？
如果你能给布布挤奶，
我就给你一些食物。
这样公平吧？总之，
请快点开始工作~

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Great! Now that you've
milked Booboo, I can go
and make my deliveries
tomorrow! Here's a little
something to eat as my way
of saying, ''Thanks a lot~''
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
太好了！既然你帮布布挤了奶，
我明天就可以去送货了！
这里有一点吃的，
算是我对你说的“非常感谢~”

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Wait a minute!
Currently you are carrying
too many items with you.
Please come back again
after you store some items into kafra storage.
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
等一下！
你身上携带的物品太多了。
请先去卡普拉仓库存放一些物品，
然后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
I always need
someone to help me
milk Booboo, especially
when Burupu doesn't feel
like doing it, so please come
by and help me when you can~
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
我总是需要有人帮我给布布挤奶，
尤其是当布鲁普不想干活的时候，
所以请在你方便的时候来帮我~

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Oh, it's you again!
Did you want to help me
out by milking Booboo the
cow? I can always use a
dependable person like you.
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
哦，又是你！
你是想帮我给布布挤奶吗？
我随时都需要像你这样可靠的人。

scripts.text: Sure, I'll milk Booboo.
scripts.translation: 好的，我来给布布挤奶。

scripts.text: What'll pay me this time?
scripts.translation: 这次给我什么报酬？

scripts.text: Nah, just dropping by.
scripts.translation: 不，只是顺便来看看。

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Great, great! If you want
to milk Booboo, first tell
Burupu that he doesn't need
to come in today, and then
come back to me. Then, I'll
let you milk Booboo the cow.
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
太好了，太好了！如果你想给布布挤奶，
先告诉布鲁普他今天不用来上班，
然后再回来找我。然后，
我就让你给布布挤奶。

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Let's see...
Milk Booboo for me this
time, and I'll randomly
choose one of the following
sets of rewards to give you.
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
让我看看...
这次你帮布布挤奶，
我会从以下奖励中随机
选择一组给你。

scripts.text:
1 set of 5 Milk,
1 set of 3 Honey,
1 set of 5 Orange Potions,
1 set of Yellow Potions, or
1 Bundle of Food. Hmmm...
That sounds fair, right?
scripts.translation:
1组5瓶牛奶，
1组3瓶蜂蜜，
1组5瓶赤色药水，
1组黄色药水，或者
1个食物保鲜袋。嗯...
这样听起来很公平，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Ahahahah, it's good
to see you! Now, don't
be a stranger, alright?
Burupu could learn a
couple things from you...
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
哈哈，见到你真好！
别见外，好吗？
布鲁普可以从你身上
学到很多东西...

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
For now, go talk
to Burupu and let him
know that he doesn't need
to come into work today~
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
现在，去和布鲁普谈谈，
告诉他今天不用来上班~

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Ah, you spoke to
Burupu already? Good,
now would you please
milk Booboo the cow?
Thanks once again~
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
啊，你已经和布鲁普谈过了？
很好，那么请帮我给布布挤奶好吗？
再次感谢~

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Please go and milk
Booboo the cow as
soon as you can, okay?
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
请尽快去给布布挤奶，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Ah, you've done a good
job of milking Booboo the
cow for me. Let's see, let's
see, what would be good to
give you as payment. Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
啊，你帮布布挤奶的工作做得很好。
让我想想，让我想想，
给你什么作为报酬比较好呢。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
You know what?
Why don't you have
some Milk? It's only
fitting, after all. Besides,
it's really good for you!
Thanks again for your help~
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
你知道吗？
不如你喝点牛奶吧？
毕竟很合适。而且，
它对你身体真的很好！
再次感谢你的帮助~

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Wait a minute!
Currently you are carrying
too many items with you.
Please come back again
after you store some items into kafra storage.
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
等一下！
你身上携带的物品太多了。
请先去卡普拉仓库存放一些物品，
然后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Ah, I've got it!
You like Orange Potions,
right? Come on, you looove
Orange Potions! Here, you can
have a bunch as my way of saying thanks for milking Booboo the cow~
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
啊，我想到了！
你喜欢赤色药水，对吧？
没错，你肯定超爱赤色药水！
来，给你一大把，
就当是我感谢你帮布布挤奶的谢礼~

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Wait a minute!
Currently you are carrying
too many items with you.
Please come back again
after you store some items into kafra storage.
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
等一下！
你身上携带的物品太多了。
请先去卡普拉仓库存放一些物品，
然后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Oooh, I could give you
some Yellow Potions, Yes,
that's a good idea. Please
take these Yellow Potions
as a token of my gratitude
for milking old Booboo.
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
噢，我可以给你一些黄色药水，
对，这是个好主意。
请收下这些黄色药水，
作为我感谢你帮老布布挤奶的心意。

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Wait a minute!
Currently you are carrying
too many items with you.
Please come back again
after you store some items into kafra storage.
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
等一下！
你身上携带的物品太多了。
请先去卡普拉仓库存放一些物品，
然后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Hey, why don't you
take some fresh Honey?
Yes, it's sweet, delicious,
it's everything you could
ever want! Thanks for
milking Booboo for me~
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
嘿，你要不要尝尝新鲜的蜂蜜？
对，它又甜又美味，
是你想要的一切！
谢谢你帮我给布布挤奶~

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Wait a minute!
Currently you are carrying
too many items with you.
Please come back again
after you store some items into kafra storage.
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
等一下！
你身上携带的物品太多了。
请先去卡普拉仓库存放一些物品，
然后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Here, why don't you
have some of this really
delicious food? I don't
remember what I packed in
here, but I'm sure it tastes
good, and it's good for you~
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
来，尝尝这个特别好吃的食物吧？
我不记得我装的是什么了，
但肯定很好吃，而且对你身体有益~

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Wait a minute!
Currently you are carrying
too many items with you.
Please come back again
after you store some items into kafra storage.
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
等一下！
你身上携带的物品太多了。
请先去卡普拉仓库存放一些物品，
然后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Aww, nuts...!
I've got so many
Milk deliveries to do
tomorrow, but what can
I do without any Milk?!
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
哎呀，糟糕...
明天我有好多牛奶要送，
但没有牛奶我该怎么办啊？！

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Oh no, what am I gonna
do?! I need to deliver the
milk tomorrow, but Burupu
still hasn't arrived yet!
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
天哪，我该怎么办？！
明天要送牛奶，
但布鲁普还没到！

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
When is he coming
to work? Burupu,
where are you?!
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
他什么时候来上班？
布鲁普，你在哪里？！

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Why hasn't Burupu
arrived yet? If he
doesn't come soon,
how will I get the milk
delivered by tomorrow?
scripts.translation:
[库鲁佩]
布鲁普怎么还没到？
如果他再不快点来，
我明天怎么把牛奶送出去？

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
What? Kurupe wants me
to come in to work again?
Man, does it look like I want
to milk Booboo all my life?
Forget that, I'm gonna be
a Swordman! Tally-hoooe!
scripts.translation:
[布鲁普]
什么？库鲁佩想让我再去上班？
拜托，难道我想一辈子给布布挤奶吗？
算了吧，我要当剑士！
出发咯！

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
Yeah, ever since that
Airship landed in our
town, and I saw all those
Swordmen, I knew it'd be
my destiny! Forget ranching, I'm gonna wield a frickin' sword!
scripts.translation:
[布鲁普]
是啊，自从那艘飞空艇降落在我们城镇，
我看到那些剑士后，
我就知道这是我的命运！
别管放牧了，我要去挥舞一把像样的剑！

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
Hey, that equipment of
yours looks plenty expensive.
I think I'll need something
like that if I wanna become
a Swordman. Hey, I know
how we can help each other~
scripts.translation:
[布鲁普]
嘿，你那套装备看起来挺贵的。
我觉得想当剑士的话，我也需要那样的东西。
嘿，我知道我们怎么互相帮助了~

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
I'll help you with milking
Booboo the cow if you can get
me some proper Swordman
equipment. Let's see... Why not
give me 1 Rapier with 2 Slots? That's not too much to ask, right?
scripts.translation:
[布鲁普]
如果你能给我弄一套像样的剑士装备，
我就帮你给布布挤奶。
让我想想...不如给我一把带2个槽位的细剑？
这要求不过分吧？

scripts.text: Alright.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text: Whoa, that's too much!
scripts.translation: 太贵了！

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
I'm glad you agree~
Okay then, try to bring
me a Rapier with 2 Slots
as soon as you can! I can't
wait to start training with it!
scripts.translation:
[布鲁普]
很高兴你同意了~
那么，请尽快给我弄一把带2个槽位的细剑！
我都等不及要开始用它训练了！

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
You think so...?
Well, it's the only
thing I can think of
that I really want...
scripts.translation:
[布鲁普]
你觉得是吗...？
嗯，这是我能想到的
我真正想要的唯一东西了...

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
Hey, weren't you
supposed to bring me
a Rapier with 2 Slots?
If you want me to milk
Booboo the cow, then keep
your end of our bargain~
scripts.translation:
[布鲁普]
嘿，你不是应该给我带一把带2个槽位的细剑吗？
如果你想让我给布布挤奶，
那就履行我们的约定~

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
Oh, wow...!
That's such a beautiful
Rapier! Look, it's got
2 Slots and everything!
I'm gonna start training
with it right now!
scripts.translation:
[布鲁普]
噢，哇...
这把细剑真漂亮！
看，它还有2个槽位呢！
我要马上开始用它训练！

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
You know what?
I've changed my mind.
Screw milking that dumb cow!
Still, a Swordman is supposed
to keep his promises, huh?
Okay then, how about this?
scripts.translation:
[布鲁普]
你知道吗？
我改变主意了。
去给那头蠢牛挤奶吧！
不过，剑士总得信守承诺，对吧？
好吧，那这样如何？

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
I hid my secret instructions
for milking Booboo the cow
under the ground just northeast
of her. Read them carefully, and you should be able to milk her
yourself. You can do it, right?
scripts.translation:
[布鲁普]
我把给布布挤奶的秘诀
藏在她东北方向的地下了。
仔细读一读，你应该就能自己给她挤奶了。
你能做到的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
Anyway, don't forget
to find and read those
instructions. Oh, and
thanks again for the Rapier~
scripts.translation:
[布鲁普]
总之，别忘了去找并阅读那些说明。
哦，还有，再次感谢你的细剑~

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
Hmm? You wanna milk
Booboo today? Great,
that means I've got more
time to work on my fencing.
All right, now I can focus
completely on my training!
scripts.translation:
[布鲁普]
嗯？你今天想给布布挤奶？太好了，
这样我就有更多时间练习击剑了。
好，现在我可以专心训练了！

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
I'm gonna become the
best Swordman in the
world! But first, I gotta
learn how to use this thing!
Heeeeee-YAH! How's that? That was almost a Magnum Break, right?
scripts.translation:
[布鲁普]
我要成为世界上最好的剑士！
但首先，我得学会怎么用它！
嘿——呀！怎么样？刚才那招差点就是怒爆了吧？

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
Heeeyah!
Yaaaaaaaah!
Wh-whooooooosh!
scripts.translation:
[布鲁普]
嘿呀！
呀——！
呼——！

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
Crap! Why do I have
to have such a crappy
sword?! I mean, I'm getting
tired of making all my own
whooshing sounds and effects.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁普]
该死！为什么我用的剑这么烂？！
我是说，我自己发出那些呼呼声和特效，我都听腻了。

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
Heeeyah!
Yaaaaaaaah!
Yeeeeeeeyoooop!
scripts.translation:
[布鲁普]
嘿呀！
呀——！
耶——！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found a small^000000
^3355FFnotebook on the ground.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你在地上发现了一本^000000
^3355FF小笔记本。^000000

scripts.text:
^804000This small notebook^000000
^804000contains Burupu's detailed^000000
^804000instructions for milking^000000
^804000Booboo the cow. Although^000000

scripts.text:
[Chapter 1]
Booboo is a very emotionally
sensitive cow that expresses
herself through the power of
song. You must listen to her
song, determine how she feels,
and then comb her just right.
scripts.translation:
[第一章]
布布是一头情感非常敏感的奶牛，
她通过歌声来表达自己。
你必须倾听她的歌声，
判断她的情绪，
然后恰到好处地梳理她的毛发。

scripts.text:
[Chapter 1]
Basically, depending on
how Booboo feels, you must
give her the number of brush
strokes that correspond to
her song. I'll explain more
about that in Chapter 2.
scripts.translation:
[第一章]
基本上，根据布布的情绪，
你需要梳理与她歌声对应的次数。
我会在第二章详细解释这一点。

scripts.text:
[Chapter 2 Contents]
 
Part 1: How to Respond to
Booboo the Cow's Feelings
Part 2: Booboo's Songs
scripts.translation:
[第二章目录]
 
第一节：如何回应布布的情绪
第二节：布布的歌声

scripts.text: Part 1
scripts.translation: 第一节

scripts.text: Part 2
scripts.translation: 第二节

scripts.text:
[Chapter 2, Part 1]
Booboo the Cow usually
expresses five different
feelings through her songs:
these are joy, sadness, anger,
love, and neutral contentment.
scripts.translation:
[第二章 第一节]
布布通常通过歌声表达五种不同的情绪：
分别是喜悦、悲伤、愤怒、
爱意，以及平静的满足感。

scripts.text:
[Chapter 2, Part 1]
^800080She is so happy^000000!
When Booboo the Cow
feels joy, then you go
ahead and brush her
hair 3 times before
you can milk her.
^800080 3 times^000000.
scripts.translation:
[第二章 第一节]
^800080她很开心^000000！
当布布感到喜悦时，
你需要先梳理她的毛发3次，
然后才能挤奶。
^800080 3次^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chapter 2, Part 1]
^800080She is as usual^000000.
When she feels so-so, you need to
comb her hair ^800080 5 times^000000.
scripts.translation:
[第二章 第一节]
^800080她情绪平常^000000。
当她感觉一般时，
你需要梳理她的毛发^800080 5次^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chapter 2, Part 1]
If Booboo the cow feels
sad, then you need to make
her feel more loved. How
do you do this? Just brush
her hair at least 10 times.
scripts.translation:
[第二章 第一节]
如果布布感到悲伤，
你需要让她感到被关爱。
该怎么做呢？
只需梳理她的毛发至少10次。

scripts.text:
[Chapter 2, Part 1]
Now, remember that when
Booboo the cow is angry,
you shouldn't touch her
at all. Just say, ''No!'' to
brushing her hair, okay?
scripts.translation:
[第二章 第一节]
请记住，当布布感到愤怒时，
你绝对不要触碰她。
选择“不”来拒绝梳理她的毛发，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Chapter 2, Part 1]
If you happen to see
Booboo the cow in love,
then just brush her hair
once. Just look for the
hearts, and you'll know
that she's in love, okay?
scripts.translation:
[第二章 第一节]
如果你看到布布处于恋爱中，
只需梳理她的毛发1次。
只要看到爱心，你就知道她正在恋爱，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Chapter 2, Part 1]
Whenever Booboo the
cow is just feeling
neutral contentment,
then just brush her
5 times. That's all~
scripts.translation:
[第二章 第一节]
当布布感到平静的满足时，
只需梳理她的毛发5次。
就是这样~

scripts.text:
[Chapter 2, Part 2]
Booboo the cow will
always sing this song.
Keep these sounds in
mind when she sings them...
scripts.translation:
[第二章 第二节]
布布总是会唱这首歌。
当她唱这些声音时，请牢记在心...
