^0000ffBrrrrrr~ Booboo~ Boorrboo~^000000
^ff0000Booruboorubrr~ Rrrrboo~^000000
^0000ffRrrr~ Booboorrrr~ Boobooru~^000000
^ff0000Boobooboo~ Rururu~ Booruboorub~^000000
^0000ffBoo! B! Boo~^000000

[Chapter 2, Part 2]
When you try to milk
Booboo, she will sing this
song with a slight difference.
Look for the difference in
Booboo's song, and then
hum the correct word to her.
scripts.translation:
[第二章 第二节]
当你尝试给布布挤奶时，
她会唱一首略有不同的歌。
找出布布歌声中的不同之处，
然后向她哼唱正确的词。

scripts.text:
[Chapter 3]
If you want to milk
Booboo the cow, you
must first get permission
from Kurupe. You will also
need 3 Concentration Potions
to insert into Booboo's comb.
scripts.translation:
[第三章]
如果你想给布布挤奶，
必须先从库鲁佩那里获得许可。
你还需要3瓶集中药水，
插入布布的梳子中。

Boop boop boo~
Booboo Boop boo!

scripts.text:
**Recruitment Notice**
 
We are now hiring recruits
for the Odin Shrine Expedition.
 
- Shrine Expedition Dept.
scripts.translation:
**招募公告**
 
我们正在招募奥丁神龛探险队的成员。
 
- 神龛探险部

scripts.text:
**Recruitment Notice**
 
Join our magician
community, and make
all your days a festival!
 
- Hugel Magician Community
scripts.translation:
**招募公告**
 
加入我们的魔法师社区，
让每一天都成为节日！
 
- 毁葛魔法师社区

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Whatever you're
trying to sell me,
I'm not interested!
Now get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
不管你想卖给我什么，
我都不感兴趣！
现在给我滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Huh...?
What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
嗯...？
你想要什么？

scripts.text: Excuse me...
scripts.translation: 打扰一下...

scripts.text: I saw the recruitment notice and...
scripts.translation: 我看到了招募公告...

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Whatever you're
trying to sell me,
I'm not interested!
Now get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
不管你想卖给我什么，
我都不感兴趣！
现在给我滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Oh, so you saw the
recruitment notice for the
Odin Shrine Expedition, eh?
Hmmm... Alright, you look
like you're strong enough.
Yeah, I think you qualify.
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
哦，你是看到了奥丁神龛探险队的招募公告啊？
嗯...好吧，你看起来足够强壮。
是的，我认为你符合条件。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Oh, so you saw the
recruitment notice for the
Odin Shrine Expedition, eh?
Well, I dunno. I think that
kind of expedition would
eat you alive. No offense...
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
哦，你是看到了奥丁神龛探险队的招募公告啊？
嗯，我不知道。我觉得那种探险会把你吃掉的。别介意...

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Look, I'll reconsider
whether you qualify after
you get train a little more,
develop your skills, you know,
get stronger. For now, though,
I don't think we can use you.
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
听着，等你再训练一下，
提升一下技能，你知道的，
变得更强壮之后，我会重新考虑你是否符合条件。
但现在，我觉得我们还用不上你。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
I'm Alex Helmut, and I'm
in charge of the expedition.
See that guy over there? That's
my younger brother Julian who's
also working on the excavation.
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
我是亚历克斯·赫尔穆特，
负责这次探险。
看到那边那个人了吗？那是
我的弟弟朱利安，他也在参与挖掘工作。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Our main goal in this
excavation is to retrieve
some extremely valuable
item inside the shrine. However, it's too dangerous to go in there
if you're not strong enough.
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
我们这次挖掘的主要目标是
取回神龛内部一件极其珍贵的物品。
但是，如果你不够强壮，
进去太危险了。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Anyway, if you'd like to
help us, please take a look
around the shrine and see
if you'd want to work for us.
Please talk to the Boatman
to travel to the shrine, okay?
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
总之，如果你想帮我们的忙，
请先去神龛周围看看，
考虑一下是否愿意为我们工作。
请去找船夫，让他带你过去，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Alex]
You really oughtta
check out the shrine
for yourself first. Just talk
to the Boatman so that
he take you over there.
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
你真的应该先亲自去看看神龛。
只要找船夫，
让他带你过去就行了。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Oh, so you've gone
and seen the shrine
already. So will you help
us in our expedition?
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
哦，看来你已经
去过神龛了。那么，
你愿意参加我们的探险吗？

scripts.text: Who are the people in the next room?
scripts.translation: 隔壁房间里的人是谁？

scripts.text: Well...
Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 有的，我有。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Oh... Them.
They're officially my
co-workers, but quite
frankly, they were forced
upon me by the Rune-Midgarts
Kingdom. It can't be helped...
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
哦...他们。
名义上是我的同事，
但说实话，他们是卢恩·米德加兹王国
强塞给我的。我也没办法...

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Anyway, I have to accept
them to help international
relations or something silly
like that. They say they're here to research religious relics,
but I just don't trust them.
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
总之，为了维护国际关系之类的
无聊理由，我不得不接受他们。
他们说是来研究宗教圣物的，
但我就是不信。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
In fact, I think it's
obvious that they're here
for something else, though
I'm not sure what it may be.
And that gray haired lady...
She totally creeps me out!
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
事实上，我觉得很明显
他们另有目的，
虽然我不确定具体是什么。
还有那个灰发女士...
她让我浑身不自在！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Yeah, well, I know
it might be a tough
decision to make. Well,
take your time. I understand
that you have to weigh the
risks and everything.
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
是啊，我知道
这可能很难决定。嗯，
慢慢来。我理解
你需要权衡风险之类的。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Great! In that case, your
first assignment is to bring
me ^3355FF5 Runes of the Darkness^000000
from the shrine. Don't worry,
I'll make sure that you're
rewarded for your efforts.
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
太好了！既然如此，
你的第一个任务是去神龛
给我带^3355FF5 5个黑暗符文^000000回来。
别担心，
我会确保给你相应的报酬。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
This is your chance
to show me that your
dependability and sense
of responsibility. Then,
we can move on to the
more important stuff.
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
这是你向我证明
你的可靠性和责任感的机会。
然后，
我们才能进入更重要的环节。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
What are you still
doing here? Shouldn't
you be headed to the
shrine already?
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
你还在这里干什么？
你不应该已经去神龛了吗？

scripts.text: What was I supposed to gather?
scripts.translation: 我本来要收集什么？

scripts.text: I'm leaving, I'm leaving!
scripts.translation: 我走了，我走了！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
You've forgotten
already? I asked you
to bring me ^3355FF5 Runes
of the Darkness^000000. Okay,
now hurry up and get to it.
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
你忘了？我让你
给我带^3355FF5 5个黑暗符文^000000回来。好了，
快去快回。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
That's fine...
Just keep in mind that
we're running behind
schedule. If only that
grey haired crone wasn't
here... We'd be done by now!
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
那好吧...
请记住，我们的进度
已经落后了。要是那个
灰发老太婆不在就好了...
我们现在早就完工了！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Well, it's about
time you came back.
So did you bring me
^3355FF5 Runes of the Darkness^000000?
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
嗯，你终于回来了。
那么，你带^3355FF5 5个黑暗符文^000000回来了吗？

scripts.text: Er, not yet...
scripts.translation: 呃，还没有...

scripts.text: There you go!
scripts.translation: 给你！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Wh-what?!
You came here just to
tell me that? Come back
when you're done and
don't waste my time!
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
什-什么？！
你跑来这里就为了告诉我这个？
等你办完事再来，
别浪费我的时间！

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Hey, you know what,
Alex? You can't push
people around like that.
Besides, this adventurer
isn't a pushover, you know?
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
嘿，亚历克斯，你知道吗？
你不能这样对人呼来喝去的。
而且，这位冒险者
可不是好欺负的，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Alex]
What was that...?
Are you trying to
make me mad, Julian?
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
你刚才说什么...？
朱利安，你是想惹我生气吗？

scripts.text:
[Julian]
All I'm saying is that
most adventurers know that
you can't pay them what they're
worth. That's why so many of
them are going in and out
of the other room, you know.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
我只是想说，大多数冒险者都知道，
你给不起他们应得的报酬。
所以才会有那么多人
在那间屋子里进进出出，你知道吗。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
That... grey... haired...!
N-no... Calm down, Alex...
Lose your head, you lose
everything... D-don't stoop
down to her level.
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
那个...灰头发的女人...！
不...不...冷静点，亚历克斯...
一旦失去理智，就会失去一切...
不...不要降格到和她一样的水平。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Alright, I'm not in any
position to make demands
of you... But I would really
appreciate it if you would
bring me 5 Runes of the
Darkness as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
好吧，我现在也没资格对你提要求...
但如果你能尽快
给我带来5个黑暗符文，
我会非常感激的。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Oh! Thank you
so much, I'm sure
these Runes will help
us in our research. I know
this isn't much, but please
accept this Old Blue Box.
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
哦！非常感谢，
我相信这些符文
会对我们的研究有帮助。
虽然这不算什么，
但请收下这个神秘箱子。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Wait...
Research?
Since when did
you do research?
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
等等...
研究？
你什么时候
开始做研究了？

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Gosh, Julian,
will you just
shut up for a bit?
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
天哪，朱利安，
你能不能
闭嘴一会儿？

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Why? I'm the one who
does all the grunt work
and actual research.
You think you're so
big just ''supervising...''
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
为什么？明明是我
在做所有的粗活和实际研究。
你以为自己
只是“监督”就很了不起吗...

scripts.text:
[Alex]
J-Julian!
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
朱-朱利安！

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Right, right, we've
got a visitor. Yeah,
okay, sorry about that.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
好了好了，
有客人在。对，
好的，抱歉刚才失态了。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
I'm sorry about all
this. If you don't mind,
we'll continue our research
and hopefully finish our
project soon. Thanks once
again for all of your help.
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
很抱歉刚才的失态。
如果不介意的话，
我们会继续研究，
希望能尽快完成项目。
再次感谢你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Hm? Oh, this isn't
enough Runes of the
Darkness. I asked you
to bring me 5 of them...
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
嗯？哦，黑暗符文
不够。我让你带5个来...

scripts.text:
[Alex]
...Darn it! I think I might
have miscalculated. Maybe
I really do need more of
these. What am I gonna do?
And what is that grey haired
crone thinking? Hmmmm...
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
...该死！我可能
算错了。也许我确实
需要更多这些。我该怎么办？
还有那个灰头发的老太婆在想什么？
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Alex]
O-Oh! I had no idea that
you were there! Y-you
didn't hear anything
s-strange, did you?
Hahahahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
哦-哦！我不知道
你在那里！你...你
没有听到什么奇怪的话吧？
哈哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Excuse me?
The grey haired crone
offered you a part time
job, but won't pay you?
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
你说什么？
那个灰头发的老太婆
给你提供了一份兼职，
却不付你钱？

scripts.text:
[Alex]
She's really shameless!
We don't have much to pay
volunteers, but we should
at least give them something!
How can she do this?! Oh, er,
let me introduce myself first.
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
她真是一点廉耻都没有！
我们虽然没什么钱付给志愿者，
但至少要给点东西吧！
她怎么能这样？哦，那个，
让我先自我介绍一下。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
I'm Alex Helmut, and I'm
in charge of the expedition.
See that guy over there? That's
my younger brother Julian who's
also working on the excavation.
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
我是亚历克斯·赫尔穆特，
负责这次探险。
看到那边那个人了吗？那是
我的弟弟朱利安，他也在参与挖掘工作。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
As supervisor of this
operation, I'm ashamed to
say that the excavation is
proceeding behind schedule.
If only that grey haired crone
in the next room weren't here!
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
作为这次行动的监督，
我很惭愧地承认，
挖掘工作已经落后于计划了。
要是隔壁那个灰头发的老太婆
不在这里就好了！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
I can't work with
her at all! She's
manipulative, greedy,
selfish, and two faced!
There's got to be another
reason why she's here...!
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
我完全无法和她共事！
她心机深沉、贪婪、
自私，而且两面三刀！
她来这里肯定还有别的原因...！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Hm? Did you need
something? I'm sorry,
but I can't help you
right now. I'm pretty
busy, so I just want to
be left alone for a while.
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
嗯？你需要什么吗？
抱歉，我现在帮不了你。
我很忙，所以想
一个人静一静。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Hm? What are you doing
here? Ashe, Ashe! Get
this person out of here!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
嗯？你在这里做什么？
阿什，阿什！
把这个人赶出去！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Hm? Oh, you must be
here in response to our
recruitment notice, yes?
Let me take a look at you...
Oh, you're all skin and bone!
I can't use someone like you.
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
嗯？哦，你一定是看到我们的招募告示才来的吧？
让我看看你...
哎呀，你瘦得只剩皮包骨了！
我可不能用你这样的人。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Hm? Oh, you must be
here in response to our
recruitment notice, yes?
I'm Laura Laurence, the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom rep
for the Odin Shrine Expedition.
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
嗯？哦，你一定是看到我们的招募告示才来的吧？
我是劳拉·劳伦斯，
卢恩·米德加兹王国在奥丁神龛探险队的代表。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
My assistant, Ashe
Milton, is right over
there. Say, 'Hello,' Ashe.
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
我的助手阿什·米尔顿就在那边。
阿什，打个招呼吧。

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Hello!
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
你好！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
As you may already know,
we're here to uncover relics
from the Odin Shrine. However,
the shrine is infested with
powerful creatures that a weak
woman like me can never defeat.
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
你可能已经知道了，
我们在这里是为了发掘奥丁神龛的遗物。然而，
神龛里充斥着强大的生物，
像我这样柔弱的女子是绝对无法战胜它们的。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Would you let a poor
fragile woman like me go
in there alone? Someone like
you must go in there for me.
Hence, the recruitment notice.
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
你会让像我这样柔弱的女子
独自进去吗？像你这样的人
必须替我进去。所以，才有了招募告示。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Now, we can't actually pay
you for your work. In fact,
we have absolutely nothing to
give you. But you'd be doing
a great service your country,
the Rune-Midgarts' Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
现在，我们实际上无法支付你的报酬。
事实上，我们没有任何东西可以给你。
但你将为你的国家，
卢恩·米德加兹王国，做出巨大的贡献。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Think about it!
You'd be making a great
contribution, helping us
learn more about the age
when the gods showed
themselves to humans!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
想想看！
你将做出巨大的贡献，
帮助我们了解众神
向人类显现的那个时代！

scripts.text: Nah, forget it.
scripts.translation: 不了，算了

scripts.text: Yes, I'll do it!
scripts.translation: 是的，我答应！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
W-Wait! Think about
the importance of learning
about the age of gods! If you
don't help us, then who will?
We need to work together to
build a better future, right?
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
等-等等！想想了解神代的重要性！
如果你不帮助我们，那谁来做？
我们需要共同努力，
建设更美好的未来，对吧？

scripts.text: But you can't pay me.
scripts.translation: 但你付不起钱。

scripts.text: Alright, I'll do it.
scripts.translation: 好吧，我答应。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
You're right.
It's like I said
before. I don't have
anything to pay you.
...............................

[Laura]
Curses! If this project had
more funding, we'd have more
than a cheesy recruitment ad,
and some professional staff
like those rich Schwarzwald
Republic boys in the next room!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
该死！如果这个项目有更多资金，
我们就不止有一张廉价的招募广告，
还有像隔壁修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国那些
有钱的男孩一样的专业职员了！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Fine, it's your choice
whether you want to work
for us. I'm just disappointed
that someone like you won't
help us. I mean, don't you
have any patriotism at all?
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
好吧，是否为我们工作由你决定。
我只是很失望，像你这样的人
不帮助我们。我是说，你难道
一点爱国心都没有吗？

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Perfect! Now, you first
you need to go to the shrine
and survey the area for your
own benefit. Talk to the Boatman, and he'll take you there, okay?
Hurry up and come back soon!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
太好了！现在，你首先
需要去神龛，为了你自己的利益
勘察一下区域。去找船夫，他会带你去，好吗？
快点去，快点回来！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, but
what are you guys
doing over here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下，
你们在这里做什么？

scripts.text:
[Laura]
What are we doing...?
This is the shrine expedition
office. You know, we're doing
research on the artifacts found
in the Odin Shrine on behalf
of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
我们在做什么...？
这是神龛探险办公室。你知道的，我们代表
卢恩·米德加兹王国，
研究在奥丁神龛发现的文物。

scripts.text: About Alex and Julian
scripts.translation: 关于亚历克斯和朱利安

scripts.text: Alright, now I understand.
scripts.translation: 好的，我现在明白了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
These people in the other
room, Alex and Julian, are
they also working in this same
expedition in the Odin Shrine?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
隔壁房间的那些人，亚历克斯和朱利安，
他们也是在这个奥丁神龛的探险队里工作吗？

scripts.text:
[Laura]
...Oh. You must be working
for those rich Schwaltvalt
Republic kids. I can't work
with that impudent girl, at
all, so we're actually working
in separate offices.
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
...哦。你一定是为那些富有的修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的人工作的吧。
我完全无法和那个傲慢无礼的女孩共事，
所以我们实际上是在不同的办公室工作的。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Sorry, let me introduce
myself. I'm Laura Laurence,
the leader of the Odin Shrine
expedition for the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. Ashe Milton is my
assistant for this excavation.
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
抱歉，让我自我介绍一下。我是劳拉·劳伦斯，
代表卢恩·米德加兹王国领导奥丁神龛探险队的首领。
阿什·米尔顿是我这次发掘工作的助手。

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Hello!
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
你好！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
If you'd rather do
a service for your
country and quit working
for those wealthy snobs, then
come back here and let me know.
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
如果你宁愿为你的国家服务，
并辞去为那些富家阔少工作，
那就回到这里告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Hey, I know you...
You're a volunteer for the
other office's expedition,
right? Your timing couldn't
be more perfect. Why don't
you help us for a while?
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
嘿，我认识你...
你是另一间办公室探险队的志愿者，
对吧？你的时机再好不过了。你为什么不暂时帮帮我们呢？

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Basically, I want you
to spy on that snobby girl,
Alex of the Schwarzwald
Republic office, and report
what she's actually doing to me.
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
基本上，我想让你去监视那个傲慢的女孩，
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国办公室的亚历克斯，
并向我汇报她实际上在做什么。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
I have to know...
I need to know whether
they discovered ''that thing''
already. They can't have found
it before us. It's impossible!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
我必须知道...
我需要知道他们是否已经发现了“那个东西”。
他们不可能在我们之前找到它。这是不可能的！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Anyway, just eavesdrop
on the Schwaltvalt Office
by putting your ear really
close to the door, and listen
to them talk. Will you do that?
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
总之，只要把耳朵紧紧贴在门上，
偷听修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德办公室的人说话，
听听他们在说什么。你愿意这么做吗？

scripts.text:
[Laura]
...............................
Of course, you're
going to do it. Right?

[Laura]
RIGHT?!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
对吧？！

scripts.text: Yeah, yeah, whatever.
scripts.translation: 是，是，随便吧。

scripts.text: Sure thing.
scripts.translation: 没问题。

scripts.text: I s-s-s-suppose...!
scripts.translation: 我...我想...好吧！

scripts.text: Yes, Ma'am!
scripts.translation: 遵命，女士！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Good.
Now do it!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
很好。
现在去做吧！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Ask the Boatman to take
you to the Odin Shrine so
that you can actually see it
for yourself. If you don't think you can handle the expedition,
then you can just let me know.
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
让船夫带你去奥丁神龛，
这样你就可以亲眼看看了。
如果你觉得无法胜任这次探险，
那就直接告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Have you been to the
Odin Shrine already?
I know it's scary, but we
need to finish our research
for the good of mankind.
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
你已经去过奥丁神龛了吗？
我知道那里很可怕，但为了人类的福祉，
我们必须完成我们的研究。

scripts.text: Yeah, yeah, whatever.
scripts.translation: 是，是，随便吧。

scripts.text: I see.
scripts.translation: 我明白了。

scripts.text: You're right, Ma'am.
scripts.translation: 您说得对，女士。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Well, then.
Did you happen to
find anything while
you were there?
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
那么。
你在那里有没有碰巧发现什么？

scripts.text: Jellopies.
scripts.translation: 果冻派。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
You can freakin' find
Jellopy anywhere! I meant,
did you find anything special
while you were at the shrine!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
杰勒比结晶哪里都找得到！我是说，你在神龛那里有没有发现什么特别的东西！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Well, that's fine.
I did tell you to just
take a look around, so
I didn't expect you to
bring me anything.
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
好吧，没关系。
我本来只是让你去那里看看，
所以也没指望你能带什么东西回来。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Anyway, are you still willing
to help us? I know that I said
that we can't pay you, but to
be fair, I can offer you something from my special collection.
How does that sound?
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
总之，你还愿意帮我们吗？我知道我说过我们付不起报酬，但为了公平起见，我可以从我的私人收藏中拿一样东西给你。
你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text: Who are the guys in the other room?
scripts.translation: 隔壁房间的那些人是谁？

scripts.text: Well...
Yes!
scripts.translation: 准备好了！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Oh, those are the
Schwarzwald Republic
representatives for this
Odin Shrine expedition.
Personally, I think they're
just a bunch of rich phonies.
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
哦，那些是修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国派来参加这次奥丁神龛考察的代表。
就我个人而言，我觉得他们只是一群装腔作势的有钱人。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
And that Alex girl...
She may seem polite,
but she's always giving
these dirty looks, and
greets me with a fake
smile. I hate her!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
还有那个叫亚历克斯的女孩...
她表面上看起来很礼貌，
但总是用那种轻蔑的眼神看我，
还对我假笑。我讨厌她！

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Ms. Laurence...!
Stop it, please!
It's embarassing to
hear you talk about
a colleague like that.
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
劳伦斯小姐...！
请别这样了！
听你这样谈论同事，
真的很让人尴尬。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
C-colleague?! No way!
I despise that spoiled brat,
and she doesn't deserve the
position that her rich daddy
probably bought for her! Grrr!
Come back later, I'm too mad!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
同...同事？！绝对不行！
我鄙视那个被宠坏的丫头，
她那个位置肯定是她有钱的爸爸买来的！哼！
你稍后再来吧，我现在太生气了！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
If you're having second
thoughts, it might not be
the best idea to work for me.
I mean, I believe in following
your gut instincts, you know?
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
如果你还在犹豫，
也许为我工作并不是个好主意。
我是说，我相信要听从你的直觉，你知道的？

scripts.text:
[Laura]
That's what I've been
waiting to hear! Alright,
please fetch me ^3355FF5 Runes of
the Darkness^000000 from the Odin
Shrine. Go now, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
这正是我想听到的！好的，
请去奥丁神龛为我取回^3355FF5黑暗符文^000000。
现在就去吧，冒险者~

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Hm? You've got a job
to do, don't you? What
are you still doing here?
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
嗯？你有工作要做，不是吗？
还在这里干什么？

scripts.text: What was I supposed to gather?
scripts.translation: 我本来要收集什么？

scripts.text: Don't worry, I'm leaving.
scripts.translation: 别担心，我这就走。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
You're supposed
to bring me ^3355FF5 Runes
of the Darkness^000000. Now,
don't forget this time!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
你应该带^3355FF5黑暗符文^000000给我。
这次可别忘了！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Well, try to hurry up
if you can. I'm already
behind schedule because
we have to work with those
snobby rich kids in the
other office. ^333333*Sigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
如果可以的话，尽量快点。
因为要和隔壁办公室那些势利的有钱人打交道，
我的日程已经延误了。^333333*叹气...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Oh, you've come back.
So where are the Runes
of the Darkness you brought?
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
哦，你回来了。
那你带来的黑暗符文在哪里？

scripts.text: Er, I don't have them yet...
scripts.translation: 呃，我还没拿到...

scripts.text: Right here!
scripts.translation: 就在这里！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
This isn't really one
of those jobs where you
can take your time. Sure, I didn't give you a deadline, but
we can't make progress on our research until you make progress.
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
这可不是那种可以慢慢来的工作。虽然我没给你设定期限，但在你取得进展之前，我们的研究也无法推进。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Oooh, nice job. It's good
that we have more of these
to study. Though, it seems
that the more we research,
the quicker it seems that
we're not getting anywhere...
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
哦哦，干得好。很高兴我们能有更多这些符文来研究。不过，看起来我们研究得越多，似乎越没有进展...

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Hey...
Ashe. Why aren't we
making any progress?
What exactly have you
been doing? None of those
runes have any writing?
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
嘿...
阿什。为什么我们没有取得任何进展？
你到底在做什么？那些符文上都没有文字吗？

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Well, I think there's
supposed to be writing,
but these runes are pretty
old. I've got to polish this
gunk off without damaging
any writing that's there...
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
我想上面应该是有文字的，
但这些符文太古老了。
我得在不损坏文字的前提下，
把这些污垢清理干净...

scripts.text:
[Laura]
By the way, what have the other guys been doing?
What, they don't do anything but wasting their time?
Ah~ I see. They are thinking that this is the perfect excuse
for them to relax and rest.
Well, somehow they are the citizens of this country, you know.
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
顺便问一下，其他人都在干什么？
难道他们除了浪费时间什么也不做吗？
啊~我明白了。他们觉得这是放松休息的完美借口。
毕竟，他们也是这个国家的市民嘛。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
What do you think those
Schwarzwald snobs are doing?
They must think this project
is an excuse for them to relax
and slack off! They can afford to, obviously. Hmpf! Rich people!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
你觉得那些修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德的势利眼在干什么？
他们肯定觉得这个项目是偷懒的借口！
反正他们有的是钱。哼！有钱人！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
They've got things so easy,
while we're barely covering
our research expenses!
In fact, we've had to cut
so many corners, skip
meals and amenities...
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
他们过得那么轻松，
而我们连研究经费都快付不起了！
事实上，我们不得不缩减开支，
甚至要省饭钱和日用品...

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
I know! How can we
carry on professional
research in a shack?
We're literally living at
poverty standards here...
Are we still researchers?
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
我知道！
在这种破棚屋里，
我们怎么能进行专业的研究？
我们简直是在赤贫中生活...
我们还算是研究员吗？

scripts.text:
[Laura]
I know that!
I know that already!
S-stop bringing it up!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
我知道！
我早就知道了！
别...别再提了！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
This is pathetic.
I can't even afford the
energy to continue this
conversation. You too,
why don't you take a rest?
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
这太可悲了。
我连继续这场对话的精力都没有了。
你也是，
为什么不休息一下呢？

scripts.text:
[Laura]
..................
What is this?!
You're supposed to
bring me 5 of them!

[Laura]
Is this your way of
saying that you don't
want to work for us?
Why don't you say it
to my face, eh?
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
这是你想表达你不想为我们工作吗？
为什么不直接当着我的面说呢？

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Ms. Laurence, please,
calm down! We're in no
position to yell at anyone,
especially volunteers! You
of all people should know
that they're doing us a favor!
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
劳伦斯小姐，请冷静一下！
我们没有资格对任何人发火，
尤其是对志愿者！
你应该最清楚，
是他们帮了我们的忙！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Okay, Ashe, I get it!
And as for you, I'll give
you another chance. Next
time you see me, bring
5 Runes of the Darkness!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
好吧，阿什，我懂你的意思了！
至于你，我再给你一次机会。
下次见到我时，
带5个黑暗符文来！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
...Only one?
Look at me. I asked
you for five. I know that
one is better than nothing...
But it's pretty darn close. Go
get me 4 more this instant!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
...只有一个？
看着我。我让你带5个。
我知道一个总比没有好...
但这差不多就是没有。立刻去给我找4个！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
One, two...
Huh? Th-that's all?!
When I ask for 5 Runes
of the Darkness, I mean
5, not 2. Now hurry up
and just do what I asked!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
一，二...
嗯？就...就这些？！
当我让你带5个黑暗符文时，
我是说5个，不是2个。快点，
照我说的做！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
One, two, three...
That's it? Don't you
know how to count to 5?
Go and get me more of those
Runes of the Darkness now!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
一，二，三...
就这些？你不知道怎么数到5吗？
现在马上去给我弄更多黑暗符文来！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
I wonder how much progress
those pampered Schwarzwald
snobs actually made. They've
got the funds, so they could
actually be further ahead
than we are right now...
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
我想知道那些被娇惯的修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德势利眼到底取得了多少进展。
他们有资金，
所以可能比我们领先很多...

scripts.text:
[Laura]
I have to know...
I need to know whether
they discovered ''that thing''
already. They can't have found
it before us. It's impossible!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
我必须知道...
我需要知道他们是否已经发现了“那个东西”。
他们不可能在我们之前找到它。这是不可能的！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
...Hey, you.

[Laura]
Hey, hey!
Hey hey hey!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
嘿，嘿！
嘿，嘿，嘿！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Basically, I want you
to spy on that snobby girl,
Alex of the Schwarzwald
Republic office, and report
what she's actually doing to me.
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
基本上，我想让你去监视那个傲慢的女孩，
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国办公室的亚历克斯，
并向我汇报她实际上在做什么。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Anyway, just eavesdrop
on the Schwaltvalt Office
by putting your ear really
close to the door, and listen
to them talk. Will you do that?
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
总之，只要把耳朵紧紧贴在门上，
偷听修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德办公室的人说话，
听听他们在说什么。你愿意这么做吗？

scripts.text:
[Laura]
...............................
Of course, you're
going to do it. Right?

[Laura]
RIGHT?!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
对吧？！

scripts.text: Yeah, yeah, whatever.
scripts.translation: 是，是，随便吧。

scripts.text: Sure thing.
scripts.translation: 没问题。

scripts.text: I s-s-s-suppose...!
scripts.translation: 我...我想...好吧！

scripts.text: Yes, Ma'am!
scripts.translation: 遵命，女士！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Good.
Now do it!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
很好。
现在去做吧！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
What are you standing
around here for? Go and
eavesdrop on those snobs
next door! I must know
what they're really up to!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
你站在这里干什么？
去隔壁偷听那些势利眼在说什么！
我必须知道他们到底在搞什么鬼！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Frankly, I know I'm paying
you nothing to be spy, but
please tell me what you
learned about the Schwarzwald
Republic Research Team.
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
说实话，我知道我没付你什么间谍费，
但请告诉我，你从修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国研究团队那里
打听到了什么。

scripts.text: Giantes
scripts.translation: 巨人

scripts.text: Ymir's Heart
scripts.translation: 尤弥尔之心

scripts.text: Nothing
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm guessing that you're
already familiar with the
creature known as Giantes
since you're an archaeologist.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想，既然你是考古学家，
你应该已经熟悉被称为巨人的生物了。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Of course! It's an
ancient beast on which
the Guardians were inspired.
N-no way...! Are they here to
finish their guardian research?
What else did you learn?
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
当然！它是古代巨兽，
守护者的灵感正是来源于此。
不...不会吧...！他们是来这里
完成守护者研究的吗？
你还打听到了什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, have you
ever heard of Ymir's...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，你听说过尤弥尔的...

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
...Heart?
Ymir's Heart, right?
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
...心？
是尤弥尔之心吧？

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Ashe, you know about
this? What exactly
is Ymir's Heart?
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
阿什，你知道这个？
尤弥尔之心到底是什么？

scripts.text: It's candy.
scripts.translation: 那是糖果。

scripts.text: It's a book.
scripts.translation: 那是一本书。

scripts.text: It's a place.
scripts.translation: 那是一个地方。

scripts.text: Ymir was a giant...
scripts.translation: 尤弥尔是个巨人...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's this...
Um, really...

[{0}]
Er, you see...
A lot of people know
about Ymir's Heart...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃，你看...
很多人都听说过尤弥尔之心...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know the expression,
''Home is where the heart
is?'' Er, well, Ymir's Heart...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道那句“心之所在，即为家”吗？
呃，总之，尤弥尔之心...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The truth is,
Ymir was this giant...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
事实是，
尤弥尔是个巨人...

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Ymir's Heart?
That's a clothing
brand, isn't it? Yeah,
it's popular amongst
the trendy crowd in the
Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
尤弥尔之心？
那是个服装品牌，对吧？是的，
它在修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的时尚人群中很受欢迎。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Clothing brand?
You mean those snobs
are just spending their
time talking about fashion
in there? Huh. Don't they
have better things to do?
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
服装品牌？
你是说那些势利眼在里面
只是花时间谈论时尚吗？哼。他们难道没有更正经的事要做吗？

scripts.text:
[Laura]
In the meantime, would
you do one more favor for
me? I'd like you to go to
the shrine one last time.
I hear that it's built on
two connected islands...
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
在此期间，你能再帮我一个忙吗？
我想让你最后再去一次神龛。
我听说它建在两个相连的岛屿上...

scripts.text:
[Laura]
I want you to check the
inner island, and see
what you can find while
I investigate the Schwarzwald
Research Team. I'm sorry, but
you're the only one I can ask.
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
我想让你检查内岛，看看你能找到什么，
同时我去调查修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德研究团队。抱歉，
你是唯一能拜托的人。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Nothing...?
Are you sure that's
all you learned?
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
什么都没有...？
你确定这就是你了解到的全部吗？

scripts.text:
[Laura]
I wonder...
What could be going on?
Hopefully I'll be able
to find the answers...
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
真是的...
到底发生了什么？
希望能找到答案...

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Say, are you here
for a job? We're looking
for someone that's passionate
about ancient history. If you
want to make money, then this
this the wrong place for you~
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
喂，你是来工作的吗？我们在找对古代史充满热情的人。如果你想赚钱，那这里可不是什么好地方~

scripts.text:
[Julian]
This is supposed to be
a collaborative excavation,
but the team leaders are too
stubborn and refuse to make
any compromises. It's been
incredibly frustrating...
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
这本来应该是一次联合发掘，但两位领队都太固执，拒绝做任何妥协。真是让人头疼...

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Basically, each of our teams
is conducting its own research
for now. Now, we need your help
to find any relics from the Odin Shrine. We'd appreciate it if you
brought as many as you can!
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
基本上，目前我们各自团队都在独立进行研究。现在我们需要你的帮助，去奥丁神龛寻找任何遗物。如果你能带回来越多越好，我们将不胜感激！

scripts.text:
[Julian]
You sure you want
to work for someone
like my boss? Can't
you tell that she's
evil? Escape from this
place while you still can!
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
你确定要为一个像我老板那样的人工作吗？难道你看不出她是邪恶的吗？趁还来得及，快逃离这个地方吧！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Julian...!
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
朱利安...！

scripts.text:
[Julian]
See what I mean?
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
你看，我说的没错吧？

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Wow, you must really
like this kind of work,
huh? I didn't really expect
that you'd go to the shrine...
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
哇，看来你真的很喜欢这种工作，是吗？我没想到你真的会去神龛...

scripts.text:
[Julian]
I'm amazed to see you
working so hard. You must
like pleasing other people,
I guess, but try not to be too
kind. Wouldn't want that...
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
看到你这么努力工作，我真是惊讶。看来你很擅长取悦别人，不过试着不要太善良。我可不想看到...

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Geez...
You're a really nice
person, you know that?
Just try not to be taken
for a sucker, okay?
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
天哪...
你真是个好人，你知道吗？只是别被人当傻子利用，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Why are both of our
team leaders so bull
headed? Maybe it has
something to do with
them being old and single.
Don't tell them I said that!
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
为什么我们两位领队都这么固执？也许这跟她们年纪大且单身有关。别告诉她们我这么说了！

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Hello, may I help you?
Please understand that
unauthorized personnel
are prohibited from entering
this area. Have you come to
assist in the expedition?
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
你好，有什么可以帮你的吗？请理解，未经授权的人员禁止进入此区域。你是来协助考察的吗？

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Oh, you've here in response
to the recruitment notice?
Well then, let me give you
a brief idea about the work.
First off, we can't pay you any
money, so you'd be a volunteer.
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
哦，你是看到招募告示来的吗？那么，让我简单介绍一下工作内容。首先，我们付不起工资，所以你是志愿者。

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Instead, you're allowed to
keep whatever you excavate
in the Odin Shrine, so long
as we don't need it for our
research. This opportunity
might prove worthwhile to you.
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
作为补偿，你可以保留在奥丁神龛发掘出的任何物品，只要我们的研究不需要它们。这个机会对你来说可能很有价值。

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Now, we should be working
together with the Schwaltvalt
Republic's Research Team, but
our leaders aren't getting along at all. There's just a huge
clash of personalities...
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
现在，我们应该与修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的研究团队合作，但我们的领队们相处得并不融洽。性格冲突非常严重...

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
In any case, if you'd
like to join us in our
efforts to uncover the
secrets of the past, then
please speak to Ms. Laurence.
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
总之，如果你愿意加入我们一起揭开过去的秘密，请去和劳伦斯女士对话。

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
So you're off to the
Odin Shrine? Good luck,
and be careful, alright?
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
你要去奥丁神龛吗？
祝你好运，
一定要小心哦。

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Oh, you're back
earlier than I thought!
I think someone with
your talent can be
a really big help to us!
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
哦，你回来得比我预想的早！
我觉得像你这样有才能的人，
一定会对我们大有帮助！

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Hm? You've decided to
help the Schwarzwald Team?
That's fine, but I'm afraid
Ms. Laurence may be a little
upset by that. Well, it's fine
with me. I don't really care.
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
嗯？你决定去帮助修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德团队了？
这没问题，但我担心劳伦斯女士可能会因此有些不悦。
不过对我来说无所谓，我并不在意。

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
How's the work coming
along? I know the team
leaders hate each other,
but they should recognize
that one person's victory
in research is victory for all.
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
工作进展如何？
我知道两位领队互相看不顺眼，
但他们应该明白，
研究上一个人的胜利，
就是所有人的胜利。

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
How's the work coming
along? I know the team
leaders hate each other,
but they should recognize
that one person's victory
in research is victory for all.
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
工作进展如何？
我知道两位领队互相看不顺眼，
但他们应该明白，
研究上一个人的胜利，
就是所有人的胜利。

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Please keep up
the good work~
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
请继续保持
良好的工作状态~

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Well, it looks like
everything turned out
alright in the end, huh?
Good work getting those runes.
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
看来最后
一切都还好，是吧？
能拿到那些符文，
干得不错。

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Oh, dear, you don't
look very well. Did
something happen?
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
哎呀，你看起来
气色不太好。
发生什么事了吗？

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
I know that Ms. Laurence
can be... vocally aggressive,
but I'm sure that she really
appreciates all of your hard
work. Thank you so much for
all of your efforts~
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
我知道劳伦斯女士
说话可能有些...咄咄逼人，
但我相信她其实非常
感激你的辛勤付出。
非常感谢你的努力~

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Why does Ms. Laurence
have to be this way?
I honestly think this
rivalry is awfully petty...
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
劳伦斯女士
为什么非要这样呢？
我真心觉得
这种竞争未免太...小气了...

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Ehm...
Don't worry
about it~
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
呃...
别担心
这些小事~

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Please don't ask
me about anything...
Besides, I mean
you no harm~
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
请不要问我
任何事情...
而且，我对你
并无恶意~

scripts.text:
[Laura]
So it means that everyone fooled me!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
原来大家都
在骗我！

scripts.text: == Laura is violently wielding a thick file in the air. ==
scripts.translation: == 劳拉正挥舞着一把厚重的锉刀。 ==

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Wh-what...?!
Does this mean
that everyone has
had me fooled this
whole time?! This is
complete lunacy!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
什...什么...？！
难道大家
一直都在骗我？！
这简直太荒唐了！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
What are you talking
about, you crazy wench?
You saw the shrine on the
other side! That's no secret!
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
你在胡说什么，
你这个疯女人？
你明明看到了对面的神龛！
这又不是什么秘密！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
I'm not talking about that!
I saw your brother digging
everywhere in town in the
middle of the night!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
我说的不是那个！
我看到你哥哥
半夜在镇里到处挖掘！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Lies...!
Where the hell did
you get that idea?
What makes you think
there are artifacts buried
around here inside town?
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
胡说...！
你哪来的这种想法？
你以为镇内
埋着什么文物吗？

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Besides, what makes you
think that my brother would
waste so much time doing
something so ridiculous?
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
再说了，
你觉得我哥哥会浪费那么多时间
去做这种荒唐事吗？

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Hahahaha! Yeah,
defend your brother
as much as you like,
you hypocrite! What do
you care about him, I know
you two really hate each other!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
哈哈哈哈哈！没错，
尽管为你哥哥辩护吧，
你这个伪君子！
你才不在乎他呢，
我知道你们俩其实
互相厌恶！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
What was that...?
I dare you to say
that again! I'll make
sure that you regret it!
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
你说什么...？
你敢再说一遍！
我会让你后悔的！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
I know that you were helping
him in his excavations. There's
no way so much progress can be
done by one man alone! In fact,
I have evidence that proves it!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
我知道你在帮他进行挖掘。
一个人怎么可能取得这么大的进展！
事实上，我有证据证明这一点！

scripts.text:
^3355FFLaura violently
waves a thick file
clasped in her hands.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF劳拉用力挥舞着手中紧握的厚厚档案袋。^000000

scripts.text:
[Julian]
What...?
Argh, that's--!
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
什...？
啊，那是——！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
That's right.
Now tell me, what the
hell is ''^FF0000Ymir's Heart?^000000''
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
没错。
现在告诉我，那个所谓的“^FF0000伊米尔之心^000000”到底是什么？

scripts.text:
[Alex]
......
Julian!
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
......
朱利安！

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Uh, this isn't my fault!
Sh-she doesn't have any
right to come into our office!
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
呃，这不是我的错！
她...她没资格闯进我们的办公室！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Hah! Aren't we supposed to
be equal partners in the same
expedition? That's what I heard
at the beginning! But you guys
have something different in mind!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
哈！我们不是应该
是同一支探险队的平等伙伴吗？
一开始就是这么说的！
但你们心里想的显然不一样！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
It's awfully suspicious: you
guys are only going out at
night, and you're making so
little progress with the Odin
Shrine excavation. Tell me,
what are your true goals?!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
这太可疑了：
你们只在晚上外出，
而且奥丁神龛的挖掘进展微乎其微。
告诉我，
你们的真正目的是什么？！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
I-I don't know what you're
talking about! J-Julian must
have gotten some mission, and
has been carrying it out without my consent! Don't go twisting
the facts, you... you thief!
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
我...我不知道你在说什么！
朱利安一定是接到了什么任务，
并在未经我同意的情况下执行了！
别歪曲事实，你...你这个盗贼！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Thief...?!
Look who's
talking!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
盗贼...？！
看看是谁在说这种话！

scripts.text:
^3355FFLaura tossed the file
away, and threateningly
rolled up her sleeves.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF劳拉把档案袋扔了出去，
并威胁般地卷起了袖子。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
S-stop!
Both of you!
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
停...停下！
你们两个都住手！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Stay out of
this, Ashe!
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
阿什，别插手
这件事！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Yeah, this is none
of your business!
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
是啊，这与你无关！

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Oh... Oh, dear!
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
噢...噢，天哪！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Hah...!
Did you...
Just hit me?
scripts.translation:
[劳拉]
哈...！
你...刚才打我了？

scripts.text:
[Alex]
You crazy...!
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
你疯了吗...！

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
This...
This doesn't
look good at all!
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
这...这情况
看起来非常不妙！

scripts.text:
^3355FFAshe picked up
the file that Laura
tossed away.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF阿什捡起了劳拉扔掉的档案袋。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Um, I've got a favor
of my own to ask you.
Would you please bring
this file to Morocc? Just
bring it to my comrade
over at the South Gate.
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
嗯，我也有个请求。
请把这个档案袋带给莫罗克？
只要把它交给南门的
我的同志就可以了。

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
I'm sorry, but we don't
have much time left. I guess
this is the last time we will
ever see each other, so thank
you for all your help, friend.
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
抱歉，我们没多少时间了。
我想这大概是我们最后一次见面了，
谢谢你所有的帮助，朋友。

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Don't worry, my comrade
at Morocc's South Gate will
explain everything once you
find him. Please hurry!
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
别担心，莫罗克南门的同志
见到你后会把一切都解释清楚的。
请快一点！

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Don't worry, my comrade
at Morocc's South Gate will
explain everything once you
find him. Please hurry, and
find him as soon as you can!
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
别担心，莫罗克南门的同志
见到你后会把一切都解释清楚的。
请快一点，尽快找到他！

scripts.text:
^3355FFAshe picked up
the file that Laura
tossed away.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF阿什捡起了劳拉扔掉的档案袋。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Um, I've got a favor
of my own to ask you.
Would you please bring
this file to Morocc? Just
bring it to my comrade
over at the South Gate.
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
嗯，我也有个请求。
请把这个档案袋带给莫罗克？
只要把它交给南门的
我的同志就可以了。

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
I'm sorry, but we don't
have much time left. I guess
this is the last time we will
ever see each other, so thank
you for all your help, friend.
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
抱歉，我们没多少时间了。
我想这大概是我们最后一次见面了，
谢谢你所有的帮助，朋友。

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Don't worry, my comrade
at Morocc's South Gate will
explain everything once you
find him. Please hurry!
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
别担心，莫罗克南门的同志
见到你后会把一切都解释清楚的。
请快一点！

scripts.text:
[Julian]
I...
I don't know
what I should do!
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
我...
我不知道该怎么做！

scripts.text:
[Julian]
I've stopped caring
whether they fight or
not... I'm so not get
involved. If you want,
you can try to stop them...
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
我已经不在乎他们打不打架了...
我不想卷入其中。如果你想的话，
你可以试着去阻止他们...

scripts.text:
[???]
...Silence.

[???]
Don't turn, don't
flinch, don't even
breathe. You're being
followed. Hold on a sec
while I take care of him.
scripts.translation:
[???]
别回头，别发抖，甚至别呼吸。
有人跟踪你。稍等一下，
我去处理掉他。

scripts.text:
[???]
...............................
Good. You've done some
good work. Just drop the file
to the ground. And for your
own good, don't turn around.

^3355FFYou drop the file
to the ground, and it
immediately vanishes in
a small whirlwind of sand.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你把档案袋丢在地上，
它立刻在一阵小旋风中消失了。^000000

scripts.text:
[???]
I know that you've
gotten involved in all
this unexpectedly. Before
I leave, have you got any
questions? Otherwise, I'll go.
scripts.translation:
[???]
我知道你是意外卷入这一切的。
在我离开之前，你还有什么问题吗？
如果没有，我就走了。

scripts.text: Who's Ashe?
scripts.translation: 阿什是谁？

scripts.text: What happened to Laura?
scripts.translation: 劳拉怎么了？

scripts.text:
[???]
You'll never see her
again. She's already
been assigned to a new
mission. If it makes you
feel better, she's one of the
members of ''Secret Wing.''
scripts.translation:
[???]
你再也见不到她了。她已经被分配
去执行新的任务了。如果你想知道，
她是“秘密之翼”的成员之一。

scripts.text:
[???]
She'll be fine. If you're that
interested in archaeology,
you'll be happy to know that
she'll run the excavation the
way she wants to. Rekenber and Arunafeltz should leave her alone.
scripts.translation:
[???]
她会没事的。如果你那么感兴趣于考古学，
你会很高兴知道她会按自己的方式主持发掘工作。
雷肯贝尔和阿鲁纳菲兹应该不会打扰她。

scripts.text:
[???]
You're probably curious
about Ashe, and perhaps
myself as well. Now, have you
ever heard of ''Secret Wing?''
scripts.translation:
[???]
你大概对阿什，甚至对我都很好奇。
那么，你听说过“秘密之翼”吗？

scripts.text:
[???]
Secret Wing is a secret
organization that's scattered
now, but some of the members
are still active. Just consider us enemies of Rekenber Corporation
in the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[???]
秘密之翼是一个秘密组织，现在虽然分散了，
但一些成员仍然活跃。把我们看作雷肯贝尔公司在
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的敌人就好。

scripts.text:
[???]
Everything you saw and
heard is all true. The ghost
of Giantes still remains within
the Odin Shrine. Rekenber wants
it for their ends, as well as
Arunafeltz. It's complicated...
scripts.translation:
[???]
你看到和听到的一切都是真的。
巨人吉安提斯的幽灵仍然留在奥丁神龛中。
雷肯贝尔想要利用它，阿鲁纳菲兹也是。情况很复杂...

scripts.text:
[???]
The people of Rune-Midgarts
and Schwarzwald Republic still
don't know what's going on.
A lot of people are just being
used... Like that one lady,
that archaeologist, Laura.
scripts.translation:
[???]
卢恩·米德加兹和修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的人们
仍然不知道发生了什么。很多人只是被利用...
比如那位女士，那位考古学家，劳拉。

scripts.text:
[???]
...Thanks for
the file. Take care.
Always watch your back.
scripts.translation:
[???]
...谢谢你的档案袋。保重。
永远小心背后。

scripts.text:
[Boatman]
Ah, hello~
Would you like to sail
to the Odin Shrine? The
fare for 1 passenger is
800 zeny. Shall we board?
scripts.translation:
[船夫]
啊，你好~
你想去奥丁神龛吗？
单程票价是800 Zeny。
要登船吗？

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text:
[Boatman]
Ah, alright.
If you change your
mind, I invite you
to return and just
let me know.
scripts.translation:
[船夫]
啊，好的。
如果你改变主意了，
欢迎随时回来告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Boatman]
Hm? You don't have enough
money to pay the fare. Well,
just come back when you do
have the zeny, and then I'll
take you to the Odin Shrine.
scripts.translation:
[船夫]
嗯？你的钱不够支付船费。
等你攒够Zeny再回来吧，
到时候我就带你去奥丁神龛。

scripts.text:
[Boatman]
Alright then,
climb aboard!
We'll arrive near
the Odin Shrine soon~
scripts.translation:
[船夫]
那么，请登船吧！
我们很快就会到达奥丁神龛附近~

scripts.text:
[Boatman]
Ah, would you
like to sail back to
Hugel now, or did you
want to explore a bit more?
scripts.translation:
[船夫]
啊，你现在想回毁葛吗？
还是想再探索一会儿？

scripts.text: I still need to look around...
scripts.translation: 我还需要四处看看...

scripts.text: Yes, take me back to Hugel.
scripts.translation: 是的，带我回毁葛。

scripts.text:
[Boatman]
Well, alright.
Just let me know
when you're ready to
leave this dangerous place.
scripts.translation:
[船夫]
好吧。
等你准备好离开这个危险的地方时，
再告诉我吧。

scripts.text:
[Boatman]
Alright then,
climb aboard!
We'll arrive near
Hugel very soon~
scripts.translation:
[船夫]
那么，请登船吧！
我们很快就会到达毁葛附近~

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis place is empty.
Everyone must
have already left.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里空无一人。
大家应该都已经离开了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFA weathered structure
of the Odin Shrine is
half buried beneath the
ground, but it still looks
fairly stable and durable.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF奥丁神龛的一处破旧建筑
半埋在地下，
但看起来仍然相当稳固耐用。^000000

scripts.text: Pass
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Explore
scripts.translation: 探索

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decided to pass
by the shrine's remnants.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你决定从神龛的遗迹旁经过。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou catch a bright
shimmer among the
remnants of the shrine.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你在神龛的遗迹中发现
一道明亮的闪光。^000000

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text: Pick it up
scripts.translation: 捡起来

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decide to continue
searching through the
shrine's ruins.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你决定继续在神龛的废墟中搜寻。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a shining stone
within the ruins, and carefully
put it into your bag.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你在废墟中发现了一块闪烁之石，
并小心地放进了包里。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What...?
What was
that noise?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什...么？
那是什么声音？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wa...waaaahhhh!

^3355FFUnfortunately, you
were unable to find
anything in the ruins.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF很遗憾，你没能
在废墟中找到任何东西。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhen you come back
to your senses, you
find that nothing is
left in this place.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF当你回过神来，
发现这里已经
什么都不剩了。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh?
What's happening?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？
发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Waaaaahhhh!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇啊啊啊啊！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Haven't you found it yet?
You said that it'd be here!
You told me so many people
are drawn to his place since
Ymir's Heart might really
be buried in this area!
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
你还没找到吗？
你明明说它在这里的！
你告诉我，自从尤米尔之心
可能真的埋在这片区域以来，
很多人都会被吸引到他的地盘！

scripts.text:
[Julian]
I'm pretty sure it's
around here somewhere,
but I need more time to dig!
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
我很确定它就在
附近某个地方，
但我需要更多时间挖掘！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
I understand why you wanted
to follow me here, but there's
no way to confirm its existence
in this area without digging
it up. Plus, I'm still worried
about the ''Shinokas'' issue...
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
我理解你想跟着我
来这里的原因，但如果不挖出来，
就无法确认它是否
存在于这片区域。而且，我还在担心
“希诺卡斯”的问题...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Shinokas?

[Alex]
We couldn't find
Ymir's Heart inside
the village, either...
Why don't you just--
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
我们在村庄里
也没找到尤米尔之心...
你为什么不干脆——

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Yeah, you think you can do
everything yourself since
you're so much better than
me, huh?! I'm the black sheep
of the family, and father loves
you more than me, right?!
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
是啊，你觉得你
什么都比我会做，
所以可以一个人搞定，对吧？！
我是家里的黑羊，神父
更爱你而不是我，对吧？！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
You already know that.
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
你心里清楚。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Wha--?!
Why... I...!
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
什——么？！
为什么...我...！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Geez, you're impatient.
Listen, your ambitions
can ruin everything. You're
not planning on defying me,
are you? Because if you are...
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
真是的，你太急躁了。
听着，你的野心
会毁掉一切。你
不会打算违抗我，
对吧？因为如果你敢...

scripts.text:
[Julian]
You can never understand
why I want to find Ymir's
Heart! I'm not going to give
up looking for it, so just
leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
你永远无法理解
我为什么想找到尤米尔之心！
我不会放弃寻找它的，
所以别管我了！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
I know you better than
yourself, and I can do
everything better than you
can. Forget Ymir's Heart for
now. Giantes is our highest,
most important priority!
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
我比你更了解你自己，
而且我做的每件事
都比你好。暂时忘掉尤米尔之心吧。
巨人族才是我们
最高、最重要的优先事项！

scripts.text:
[Julian]
You always...!
...............................
Wait... You hear that?

[Alex]
We'll continue this
conversation later.
scripts.translation:
[亚历克斯]
我们稍后再
继续这个话题。
